title: Data Scientist
description:
Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working — across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop — down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on.

Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, Adanola and Huel use Fospha up to 25 times a day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform — and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.

About the role

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join Fospha's Data Science team in London.

Fospha builds marketing measurement products for ecommerce brands — attribution, marketing mix modelling, incrementality testing, and brand impact measurement. Our Data Science team owns the models behind all of it, from methodology through to production code. You will work across our technical stacks and own maintaining and growing the codebases that power our product and solutions.

This role suits an established data scientist who wants to own things properly. You'll lead larger production projects, choose the modelling approach rather than being handed it, and talk to clients as the modelling expert in the room — supported by a team that reviews each other's work seriously, and a company that rewards high agency with ownership.

Team: Data Science

Level: Career (Data Science Career Development Framework)

Location: London

What you'll do

  • Lead larger production projects end to end — scoping, building, and shipping production-level code, rather than working through tickets someone else has specified
  • Choose the modelling approach — independently selecting and applying the right method within our suite, across attribution, marketing mix modelling, incrementality testing, and brand impact. You will be given time to keep up-to-date on the latest methodologies in the industry
  • Resolve bugs and queries independently — including in parts of the codebase you didn't write, without needing to route them upwards
  • Use AI as leverage, not as a crutch — solving coding tickets quickly, unblocking yourself on product and engineering dependencies, and building automation workflows that save the team time
  • Work with QA properly — using our automated tooling efficiently and flagging the gaps in it rather than working around them
  • Communicate as a modelling expert — confidently and independently, with clients and with colleagues, including when the message is that a number they like is wrong
  • Help develop the people around you — code review, methodology critique, and hands-on support for less experienced colleagues. Breaking down tickets and helping those more junior is essential

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Solid commercial data science experience — typically 3–5 years, with a track record of shipping models into production
  • Strong ML knowledge across multiple algorithm families, and the judgement to pick the right approach for the problem rather than the one you know best
  • Strong Python and SQL, with the ability to lead on production-level code and set the standard others work to
  • Able to debug and resolve issues independently across unfamiliar repositories, using AI tooling to accelerate rather than to guess, while still understanding the problem fully
  • Strong AI fluency — you solve tickets quickly with it, you unblock cross-department dependencies with it, you build automation workflows with it, and you never send AI-assisted output without checking it
  • Confident, independent communication with clients and stakeholders as the technical authority on the work
  • Emerging mentorship — you're ready to develop junior colleagues, and you want to
  • Initiative in accepting and planning your own work, rather than waiting to be allocated it
  • Genuine attention to detail — much of this work involves noticing when a number is wrong

Nice to have

  • Bayesian modelling experience, particularly hierarchical models
  • Experience with AWS or comparable cloud tooling
  • Familiarity with automated QA tooling and test coverage practices
  • Experience with marketing, ecommerce, or advertising data

Not required

Experience with attribution methodology, MMM, incrementality testing, or Bayesian modelling is genuinely an advantage at this level — but it isn't a filter. Our stack takes time to learn regardless of what you arrive with, and we'd rather hire strong modelling judgement and teach the domain.

How you'll grow

We run a published Data Science Career Development Framework with six levels. You'd join at Career, where the expectations are:

AI Fluency & Tooling: Leverages AI to solve coding tickets quickly; consistently unblocks themselves on cross-department dependencies, especially product and engineering; never sends AI-assisted communication without checking quality; expert at using AI to build automation workflows.

Machine Learning & Modelling: Strong ML knowledge across multiple algorithm families; independently chooses and applies the right modelling approach within Fospha's suite.

Engineering & Codebase: Leads on larger coding projects and tickets with production-level code; resolves queries and bugs efficiently and independently; master at using supplied AWS tooling through AI; uses automated QA tools efficiently and flags gaps to the QA team.

Stakeholder & Communication: Confidently and independently communicates with clients and colleagues as a modelling expert; assists with the development of junior members of staff.

Job Complexity: Consistent contributor and respected knowledge holder, with emerging collaboration and mentorship abilities.

Supervision: Demonstrates initiative in accepting and planning work.

Progression to Advanced level is against explicit, published criteria — taking on almost any ticket efficiently, building and planning production repositories, collaborating with product on project outcomes and estimates, actively developing junior colleagues, and representing Fospha as a trusted external voice on modelling in senior client and partner conversations. You'll know what you're working towards from your first week.

Throughout, we look for the same core behaviours: concise communication, collaboration, problem solving, critical thinking, growth mindset, attention to detail, time management, and initiative.

Why Fospha

  • Real methodological depth. Bayesian attribution, MMM, geo lift testing, and causal inference are our day job, not a side project. You'll be working on all of it, not adjacent to it.
  • Ownership at the methodology level. At this level you're choosing the approach, not implementing someone else's choice.
  • Published career framework. No guessing what the next level requires or when you'll get there.
  • A team that reviews each other's work properly. Code review and methodology critique from people who care about getting the model right.
  • Direct client impact. The models you build and maintain drive real budget decisions at brands you'll recognise.

By submitting your CV you understand that we have a legitimate interest to use your personal data for the purposes of assessing your eligibility for this role. This means that we may use your personal data to contact you to discuss your CV or arrange an interview, or transfer your CV to the hiring manager(s) of the role you have applied for. title: Construction Materials Testing Technician II/III (VDOT Certified)
description:
We're looking for an experienced Construction Materials Testing Technician II or III to join our growing field services team.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who already has experience in construction materials testing or inspection and wants to continue developing their technical skills and certifications.

We're not looking for someone who knows everything. We're looking for someone who has a strong foundation, takes pride in their work, and can perform field testing and inspections safely, accurately, and professionally.


What You'll Do

  • Perform field testing and inspection of soils, aggregates, concrete, asphalt, and other construction materials.
  • Conduct soil compaction testing, concrete sampling and testing, and other materials evaluations in accordance with applicable ASTM, AASHTO, and VDOT standards.
  • Observe construction activities and document compliance with approved plans, specifications, and applicable testing requirements.
  • Perform construction inspections on commercial, residential, and transportation-related projects.
  • Prepare accurate daily field reports documenting testing results, observations, and potential deficiencies.
  • Communicate professionally with contractors, project managers, engineers, and other project personnel.
  • Maintain testing equipment and follow established calibration and safety procedures.
  • Identify and communicate potential construction quality concerns.
  • Work independently or with other field technicians depending on experience and assignment.
  • Continue developing technical skills and obtaining additional industry certifications.


What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of experience in construction materials testing, construction inspection, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience performing field testing of soils, concrete, asphalt, or similar construction materials.
  • At least one current, relevant VDOT, ACI, WACEL, or NICET certification.
  • Familiarity with construction plans, specifications, and standard testing procedures.
  • Ability to prepare accurate field reports and communicate effectively.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel to assigned project sites.
  • Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions and safely perform the physical requirements of the position.

Preferred Qualifications

Candidates with any combination of the following certifications or experience are encouraged to apply:

  • VDOT Soils and Aggregate Compaction
  • VDOT Asphalt Field Level I or II
  • VDOT Concrete Field
  • ACI Concrete Field Testing Technician – Grade I
  • WACEL Concrete or other relevant WACEL certifications
  • NICET certifications in construction materials testing
  • Nuclear Density Gauge Safety
  • OSHA10
  • VDOT Work Zone Traffic Control
  • Experience with VDOT transportation or roadway construction projects

Candidates do not need to hold every certification listed. We welcome applicants who have relevant field experience, existing certifications, and an interest in advancing their qualifications.


Benefits

  • 8 Paid Holidays
  • 15 days of PTO
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage including a low cost employee medical option
  • HSA and FSA plans available
  • Employer paid Short Term, Long Term, Life and AD&D Insurance plans
  • 401k plan with up to 5% match
  • Continuing education and certifications provided
  • And many more great benefits including numerous sponsored company events


The compensation range for this position is $20 to $30/hourly, commensurate with experience, education and certifications. The provided range is a good faith estimate based on the requirements described within the job description. We notice that we receive a wide variety of applicants and recognize that the person selected may be less experienced or more experienced. If so, the actual salary range may vary from the estimate provided.

title: IT Manager
description:

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on IT Manager to take full ownership of our IT infrastructure. You will keep our servers, network, email, and business applications running smoothly, protect company data, and lead a small support team. You should be comfortable with both day-to-day troubleshooting and planning, vendor management, and reporting.

Servers and Network

  • Maintain LAN, Wi-Fi, switches, and routers, and coordinate with ISPs on connectivity issues.
Security and Backup

  • Set up new systems, install software, and provide remote support.

Management

  • Negotiate with vendors and follow up on service commitments.
  • Guide the IT team and share regular IT reports with management.

Who You Are

  • 8 to 15 years of IT experience, with at least 3 years as IT In-charge, IT Manager, or System Administrator
  • Graduate or diploma in IT / Computer Science / Hardware and Networking (CCNA or MCSE preferred)
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with a focus on minimum downtime
  • Clear communicator who works well with staff, management, and vendors
  • Reliable, organised, and ready to handle urgent issues
  • Experience in schools, design/media, real estate, or manufacturing is a plus

What We Offer

  • Stable, full-time role with ownership of the IT function
  • Salary as per experience and industry standards
  • Support for certifications and skill growth

title: AI Applied Scientist
description:
About the Science and AI Team

The Science and AI team is at the heart of Maki People. It builds the science and AI behind our platform, from job analysis and assessments to AI interviews and predicting performance. Led by our Head of Science, Aiden Loe, and working closely with our COO, Paul-Louis Caylar, the team brings together business psychologists, psychometricians and AI scientists. Together, they make sure every hiring decision on our platform is accurate, consistent and fair.

As Maki grows, the Science and AI team’s job is to show, with evidence, that our approach leads to better hiring decisions.

About the Role

The AI Applied Scientist turns our science into results for clients. Most of your time goes on client projects: adapting our AI scoring to each client’s roles, analysing their data, and showing them what it means. The rest goes on improving the scoring systems that every client relies on.

1. Client projects

  • Adapt AI scoring for structured interviews, job-specific skills and multilingual proficiency to each client’s roles and needs.

  • Analyse client assessment and performance data to show how scores relate to job performance and retention.

  • Set and review cut-offs and thresholds with clients, backed by evidence.

  • Present findings and recommendations directly to clients, in a way non-technical audiences can act on.

  • Work closely with implementation and customer success teams from setup to go-live.

2. Testing scoring quality

  • Compare AI scores with expert ratings to check accuracy and reliability before anything goes live.

  • Test robustness to prompt variation, input noise and adversarial behaviour such as prompt injection.

3. Fairness in practice

  • Run bias checks across demographic groups for each client project.

  • Apply mitigation techniques such as reweighting and calibration without losing model performance.

  • Support fairness reports and compliance documentation for clients.

4. Improving our scoring systems

  • Help choose the right models and prompts for production, balancing accuracy, speed and cost.

  • Support the move onto self-hosted open-weight models, including fine-tuning on expert-rated data.

  • Work with engineering to roll out scoring changes safely.

As one of Maki People’s early employees, you’ll help shape the team’s future.


Our Ideal Candidate

Required

  • MSc or PhD in data science, machine learning, psychology or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.

  • Hands-on experience with LLM-based scoring or evaluation.

  • Strong Python or R skills, with solid statistical analysis.

  • Experience presenting data-driven findings to clients or senior business stakeholders.

  • Able to manage several projects at once and keep to deadlines.

Preferred

  • Experience in consulting, people analytics or assessment.

  • Working knowledge of psychometric concepts such as reliability, validity and IRT.

  • Experience testing AI systems for fairness and bias.

  • Experience fine-tuning language models, for example with LoRA.

  • Working knowledge of ethical AI and compliance, such as the EU AI Act.

Application Process

  • Stage 1 - Screening assessment (25 min)

  • Stage 2 - Power skill assessment with our AI agent (15 min)

  • Stage 3 - Hiring manager interview (45 min)

  • Stage 4 - Executive interview (45 min)

  • Stage 5 - Deep-dive technical interview (60 min)

  • Stage 6 - Interview with Co-founder (30 min)

title: Retail Floor Lead
description:
The role of Retail Store Floor Lead at Vuori is to lead the retail sales team by example, forging connections with customers while communicating Vuori’s brand values through insightful product knowledge and a happy, optimistic outlook. Also, encouraging the team on how to maintain Vuori’s standards in retail sales and customer experiences. The Floor Lead is a key part of the store leadership team and as such supervises the retail floor and takes initiative, delegates work and is a “go to” person. Under the direction of the General Manager, the floor lead position assists in any leadership duties that arise, thereby working directly with both the General Manager and Assistant Store Manager.

What you'll get to do:

Create an unforgettable customer experience

  • Works with the sales team to ensure each customer receives the best experience possible.
  • Takes ownership of the sales floor and sales team to ensure customer experience is the first priority.
  • Prepare the fitting rooms, find sizes, and provide honest knowledgeable feedback to customers regarding merchandise style and fit.
  • Forge lasting relationships with customers by engaging with them about product details, new product and replenishment and invite them to upcoming events.
  • Be knowledgeable on what’s new and what’s selling well and shares with both the customer and team.

Be the business

  • Leads the team on the day-to-day operations of the store when the General Manager or Assistant Store Manager is not in.
  • Motivates the sales team and achieves sales goals in a team-based commission environment.
  • Seek new product knowledge in the broader fashion landscape and active-wear specifically to serve as an expert for the customer.
  • Leads the team in the completion of projects while keeping the focus on customer experience.
  • Communicate inventory needs to support the business goal

Leadership/Ownership

  • Works with Retail General Manager on daily maintenance, sales strategy, community and team management to ensure the business runs smoothly and successfully.
  • Leads the team in daily maintenance of the store including restocking product, maintaining visual merchandising and cleaning.
  • Utilizes the utmost responsibility, attention to protocol and safety standards in closing/opening the store daily.
  • Under the guidance of the Retail General Manager, encourages employees to give 100%, adhere to punctuality and role responsibilities at all times.

Who you are:

  • Available morning and/or evening, work 8 hour shifts, 5 days/week, available at least 1 weekend day.
  • Must be a leader in punctuality and attendance, adhering to scheduled shifts.
  • Ability to develop relationships with customers and colleagues.
  • A customer service expert, creates experiences and develops relationships with customers, embraces the social aspect of sales and the ability to positively and proactively handle customer concerns.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to quickly learn new procedures and processes.
  • Strong organizational skills and follow through skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • High level of ownership, accountability and initiative.
  • Eager to develop new skills and responsive to feedback.

Willingness Requirements:

  • Willingness to lift and move products and equipment and boxes weighing up to 30 lbs
  • Willingness to stay active and move throughout the store during each shift
  • Willingness to reach, bend, and use a step stool or ladder when needed
  • Willingness to work in an environment with bright lights and music
  • Willingness to work as part of a team in a fast-paced retail environment

Our investment in you:

At Vuori, we’re proud to offer the following to our employees:

  • Health Insurance
  • Savings and Retirement Plan
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Generous Vuori Discount & Industry Perks
  • Paid Time Off
  • Wellness & Fitness benefits

The hourly range for this role is $20/hr - $23/hr, plus team pooled commission.

Vuori is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Survey Technician (m/f/d) - Construction & Engineering Surveying
description:
Survey Technician (m/f/d), Dresden

We seek to move the world forward through innovative thinking. Woolpert is an award‑winning, global leader in architecture, engineering, and geospatial services. We blend design excellence with cutting‑edge technology to deliver exceptional client value, and as a certified Great Place to Work®, we embrace progress and innovation to create limitless opportunities for career growth.

As part of Woolpert, Murphy Geospatial – A Woolpert Company contributes deep geospatial expertise across Europe, supporting complex infrastructure, property, manufacturing, utilities, and natural‑environment projects through world‑class data capture, verification, and governance.

Position Overview

Due to continued growth, we are seeking a Survey Technician - Construction & Engineering Surveying (m/f/d) to join our Special Projects Division based in Dresden, Germany.

In this role, you will be involved in a long-term semiconductor construction project, supporting major building construction (Hochbau) and industrial construction (Industriebau) works. You will carry out a range of surveying activities including construction surveying, setting out, as-built surveys, and engineering surveying using the latest surveying, laser scanning, and geospatial technologies.

This is an excellent opportunity to develop your career while contributing to one of Europe's most significant and technologically advanced construction projects.

What You’ll Do

  • Carry out construction surveying activities on large-scale building and industrial construction projects.
  • Perform setting out and setting out works for structural, civil, and infrastructure elements.
  • Conduct as-built surveys to verify completed works and document project progress.
  • Deliver accurate engineering surveying services in accordance with project specifications and quality standards.
  • Work as part of a surveying team under the guidance of an experienced Geospatial Engineer.
  • Establish and densify survey control networks in line with industry best practices.
  • Operate modern surveying equipment, including Total Stations, GNSS receivers, laser scanners, imaging equipment, GPS systems, and data collectors.
  • Validate survey measurements using GNSS, Total Station, and laser scanning technologies.
  • Prepare and manage setting out data for upload to survey instruments.
  • Process and analyse survey data using software such as AutoCAD, StarNet, and Leica Cyclone.
  • Carry out regular calibration checks and maintenance of survey equipment and accessories.
  • Undertake additional project and surveying-related tasks as required.

What You Will Bring

  • Completed vocational training, diploma, or equivalent qualification in Surveying, Geomatics, or a related field.
  • Experience in construction surveying, engineering surveying, setting out, or as-built surveying would be advantageous.
  • Previous experience working on construction sites within the building construction, industrial construction, or infrastructure sectors is desirable.
  • Understanding of surveying principles, methodologies, and geospatial data collection techniques.
  • Experience working with modern surveying equipment, including Total Stations and GNSS systems.
  • Experience with laser scanning technologies and related software (e.g. Leica Cyclone) would be beneficial.
  • Eligibility to work in Germany.
  • Good communication skills in English; German language skills would be advantageous.
  • Highly motivated, quality-focused, responsible, and able to work effectively as part of a team.

Benefits You Will Love

At Murphy Geospatial – A Woolpert Company, you’ll join a collaborative and innovative team where your expertise makes a real impact. Our benefits include:

  • Competitive salary with a comprehensive benefits package aligned to your experience
  • Access to cutting‑edge geospatial technology and industry‑leading tools
  • Flexible working options designed to support work–life balance
  • Enhanced wellbeing support, including employee assistance initiatives
  • Opportunities within a growing, globally connected organisation through our partnership with Woolpert
  • Principal Programme: Earn the opportunity to become an owner of the firm.
  • Performance‑related bonus scheme that rewards your contribution
  • Fitness and Wellbeing reimbursement programme.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Applicants requiring accommodation during recruitment may contact MGS.talentteam@woolpert.com (https://mailto:MGS.talentteam@woolpert.com)

title: Executive Director of Product Management , Resiliency
description:
The Executive Director, Product Management – Supply Chain Resiliency reports to the VP, Product Management and owns the full product development lifecycle and go-to-market execution for GHX's Supply Resiliency Platform — the cross-application layer spanning two use-case tracks: Procure-to-Pay (hospital) and Order-to-Cash (manufacturer/supplier) workflows. This is a build-and-commercialize role: the Executive Director owns the platform requirements, product launch, and forward-deployed pilot through general availability, driving pilot customer selection and execution, product requirements and roadmap, commercial packaging and pricing, and cross-functional GTM alignment across Engineering, forward-deployed teams, Sales, Marketing, Implementation, Professional Services, Customer Care and Finance.

Areas of focus include, but are not solely limited to: pilot program design and stage-gate governance; product definition, roadmap execution, and technical alignment; commercial packaging, pricing, and profitability; competitive positioning; cross-functional consensus building; and executive/steering-committee reporting.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Healthcare supply chain resiliency is now a contested category: well-funded, AI-native challengers are selling point solutions directly to hospitals. This role is chartered to win that fight — turning GHX's two-sided network of 600+ connected providers and their suppliers into a resiliency platform that out-executes single-sided competitors on speed, breadth, and proven customer outcomes. The Executive Director owns that competitive outcome end to end, from platform definition through GA and beyond.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Working with a broad group of stakeholders and partners — across GHX product pods, Forward-Deployed Engineering, current and prospective pilot customers, and the executive leadership team — the Executive Director develops and leads GHX Product Management execution for the Supply Resiliency use case. Responsibilities also include identification and qualification of future use case prioritization.

Specific responsibilities include:

  • Own end-to-end product development lifecycle (PDLC) for GHX Orchestration, from forward-deployed pilot and prototype through GA commercialization, across both use-case tracks (Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash).
  • Design, govern, and continuously refine the pilot selection engine: Layer 1 binary hard gates (data access, SME time, on-site access, feedback cadence, executive sponsor) and the Layer 2 weighted scorecard used to rank and select pilot candidates.
  • Own pilot cohort selection and all stage-gate decisions (entry, mid-pilot, exit), including go/kill/reallocate calls on stalled accounts.
  • Partner directly with the Forward-Deployed Engineering team to scope on-site pilot engagements, define track-specific entry criteria and success metrics, and translate pilot learnings into a repeatable deployment playbook.
  • Own product-level success criteria and report progress against exit bars: P0/P1 issue resolution, GA-candidate certification, referenceable-logo targets, and quantified ROI proof points, by persona and by track.
  • Lead product's input into the GTM execution plan, keeping the commercial (pricing/packaging), pilot delivery, and marketing workstreams synchronized against the shared milestone schedule and dependency chain.
  • Define and evolve the tiered commercial model (Foundation / Agentic / Outcome-Premium) and the hybrid pricing approach (base subscription plus metered/outcome layer); partner with Finance and Deal Desk on SOW structure, platform-level contracting, and pilot-to-GA conversion terms.
  • Translate persona- and value-based requirements (executive sponsor, operational champion, SME end-users, technical/integration owner, data steward) into a technical roadmap in partnership with Engineering.
  • Drive product-boundary clarity across adjacent and overlapping offerings (e.g., Price Workbench, Industry Data Alignment, Data Connect, Managed Services, and Resiliency Center capability) and own the resulting customer-facing positioning, flow documentation, and sales-enablement materials.
  • Analyze market trends and the competitive landscape — including well-funded, AI-native point-solution entrants — to defend and advance GHX's “orchestration” category positioning, and to win head-to-head competitive evaluations.
  • Build and sustain executive-level relationships with pilot customers and internal sponsors to unblock data access, named SME time, on-site access, and rapid structured feedback.
  • Lead through influence across Sales, Marketing, and Professional Services to execute and deliver the roadmap and optimize product efficiency for implementation, supportability, and system reliability.
  • Develop and mentor Product Owners and Product Managers supporting the platform.
  • Utilize effective change management practices to execute the product roadmap and communicate progress, risks, and decisions to the executive/steering committee.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • A minimum of 10 years of Product Management experience.
  • Experience leading Product Management initiatives within the healthcare space is required.
  • Demonstrated experience designing or running structured pilot programs, forward-deployed engineering models, or similar early-access/co-development customer AI engagements.
  • Experience developing or executing usage-based, outcome-based, or hybrid commercial pricing models for enterprise software.
  • Ability to clearly communicate; work in team environments, with a minimum of 3 years people management experience.
  • Proven software development experience managing product planning milestones from business concept through launch.

  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Electronic Engineering or a related field

  • Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring experience

  • Proven track record for design closure activities, including timing closure, power and area optimization

title: Senior Strategic Data Analyst, Growth & Placement
description:
Senior Strategic Data Analyst, Growth & Placement


Austin, TX (Onsite 4 days per week)

Note: This is a full-time role. We do not offer C2C or C2H employment and are not able to sponsor visas for this position.


About Acrisure

Acrisure is a global fintech leader empowering millions of ambitious businesses and individuals with the right solutions to grow boldly forward. Bringing cutting-edge technology and top-tier human expertise together, we connect clients with customized solutions across insurance, reinsurance, payroll, benefits, cybersecurity, mortgage services, and more. In the last twelve years, Acrisure has grown in revenue from $38 million to almost $5 billion and employs over 19,000 colleagues in more than 20 countries.


The Role

Acrisure's Growth & Placement Analytics team supporting the executive leadership of our North America Insurance business operates at the intersection of data and business strategy, translating complex data assets into decisions that drive revenue and operational performance. As a Senior Strategic Data Analyst on the Growth & Placement pod, you will operate as a trusted senior individual contributor owning strategically ambiguous, high-stakes analytical questions facing NAI leadership and driving them from initial framing through executive-ready recommendation.


This is not a role where the questions are handed to you. You will independently identify what the business needs to understand, structure the analytical approach, and shape the agenda in partnership with senior executives. Your findings will directly inform decisions with enterprise-wide impact, and the analytical products you build will be used across NAI leadership, operating teams, and downstream analytical functions.


Beyond delivery, you will set the standard for analytical rigor within the team. This is a thought-leadership role: you establish the patterns others follow — how we frame ambiguous problems, how we communicate data limitations, how we integrate AI tooling into production analytical workflows without compromising trust. You are expected to raise the ceiling of what the team can do.


Acrisure is investing significantly in its data infrastructure, most visibly through the adoption of Palantir Foundry as our enterprise analytics and application platform. You will have the autonomy and expectation to shape how those investments translate into analytical value for the business, and to architect the data assets required to answer questions that don't yet have precedent.


How You'll Drive Impact:


  • Own the analytical framing of the most strategically important and ambiguous questions facing NAI leadership — deciding what merits investigation, defining the approach, and driving the work from problem definition through executive-ready recommendation with minimal oversight.
  • Design and deliver enterprise-scale analytical products end-to-end — from metric definition and data modeling through self-service delivery — that serve multiple audiences across NAI leadership, operating teams, and downstream analytical functions.
  • Independently engage senior executive stakeholders to shape the analytical agenda rather than react to it, and to translate ambiguous business questions into structured, defensible answers.
  • Lead multi-quarter analytical initiatives that require sustained investigation, integration of insights across functions, and pattern recognition across large, multi-source datasets.
  • Set the standard for analytical rigor across the team, establishing patterns for how we frame problems, communicate data limitations, and build analytical trust with executive audiences.
  • Write and optimize expert-level SQL against Palantir Foundry; architect the data models and pipelines required to support new categories of analysis; extend dbt models and Palantir Ontology objects where the analysis demands it.
  • Architect and productionize AI-augmented analytical workflows such as Generative AI classification pipelines and integrated analysis that scale analytical capacity while preserving rigorous verification standards. You define what "trustworthy" looks like when AI is in the workflow.
  • Champion intellectual honesty about what the data does and doesn't support — setting the tone for the team on when to say "we don't know yet" and how to make that observation actionable rather than paralyzing.

You May Be a Fit If You Have:


  • 5–8 years of professional experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence, or a strategy-adjacent analytics role, with a clear trajectory of increasing scope and autonomy over that time.
  • Expert command of SQL: you write complex analytical queries fluently across window functions, CTEs, and multi-table joins; you optimize your own queries; and you can architect data logic that others build on.
  • A demonstrable track record of owning end-to-end analytical products that serve broad stakeholder populations — from metric definition and data modeling through self-service delivery, not just contributing to work owned by others.
  • Deep experience with a modern cloud data warehouse and hands-on data modeling experience with dbt or an equivalent transformation framework.
  • Proven ability to independently frame ambiguous business problems, structure the analytical approach, and drive multi-quarter initiatives with minimal oversight.
  • Executive-grade communication — you can walk into a C-suite conversation, set the terms of the discussion, and defend your analytical position in real time. Written and verbal fluency at that altitude are both expected.
  • The intellectual honesty and confidence to say 'the data doesn't fully answer this question, and here's why' — and to make that observation productive rather than deflating.
  • Experience integrating AI or ML into analytical workflows at production quality — for example, Gen AI classification pipelines, prompt-engineered analytical automation, or Claude/LLM-integrated analytical products.
  • Experience with a BI or visualization tool (Tableau, Power BI) and a track record of delivering to multiple audiences from a single data foundation.
  • A genuine interest in developing deep expertise in Palantir Foundry and the intellectual openness to become one of the team's Foundry authorities.
  • A skeptic's relationship with AI tools — you use them, you benefit from them, but you validate their outputs rigorously before letting them inform business decisions or ship to production.
  • A bachelor's degree in a quantitative or analytical field, or equivalent professional experience. Advanced degrees in analytics, data science, or a related field are welcomed but not required.

Nice to Have:


  • Direct hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry, including Ontology modeling or Workshop application development.
  • Python proficiency, particularly for analytical automation, data transformation, or ML/AI pipeline development.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services, or other complex B2B commercial environments.
  • Prior experience directly presenting findings to C-suite audiences and defending analytical recommendations in executive forums.
  • Experience establishing analytical standards, playbooks, or reusable patterns adopted by a broader analytics team.
  • Exposure to agile development practices, Git-based workflows, and project tracking tools like Jira.

Candidates should be comfortable with an on-site presence to support collaboration, team leadership, and cross-functional partnership.

description:
Head - Investments | Global Funds, AIF & PMS

Location: Mumbai, India

Preferred Experience: 08 - 15+ years

About the Opportunity

We are representing a distinguished boutique investment firm with an exceptional track record of delivering consistently strong investment returns over the past decade. The firm has established a strong position in the investment management space through its disciplined investment philosophy, research-led approach and focus on superior investment performance.

The firm is seeking an accomplished investment leader to head its investment function, drive investment strategy across AIF and Portfolio Management Services (PMS), and strengthen its global investment capabilities.

This is a senior leadership opportunity for an investment professional who combines deep expertise in Indian and international financial markets with a demonstrated ability to generate consistent, superior risk-adjusted returns.

Role Overview

The Head - Investments will be responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership across the firm's investment activities, including AIF, PMS and global investment portfolios.

The individual will lead a team of research analysts and investment professionals, oversee portfolio construction and asset allocation, identify investment opportunities across domestic and international markets, and ensure disciplined execution of the firm's investment philosophy.

Key Responsibilities

1. Investment Strategy & Leadership:

- Define and drive the firm's overall investment strategy across AIF, PMS and global investment mandates.

- Lead investment decisions, portfolio construction and asset allocation in alignment with the firm's investment philosophy and return objectives.

- Identify opportunities across equity markets, sectors, asset classes and geographies.

- Strengthen investment processes, governance frameworks and performance-monitoring mechanisms.

2. AIF & PMS Management:

- Provide hands-on leadership in managing both Alternative Investment Funds (AIF) and Portfolio Management Services (PMS).

- Oversee investment selection, portfolio allocation, position sizing, portfolio rebalancing and performance evaluation.

- Ensure strong investment discipline, risk-adjusted portfolio performance and adherence to applicable regulatory and governance requirements.

- Demonstrate a proven ability to manage investment portfolios through different market cycles.

3. Global Funds & International Investments:

- Drive the firm's global investment strategy, identifying and evaluating opportunities across international financial markets.

- Demonstrate experience in global funds, international equities, offshore investment portfolios and cross-border investment structures.

- Possess a sound understanding of investment opportunities and market dynamics across the USA, UK, Europe, Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan and other developed and emerging markets.

- Evaluate global asset allocation opportunities, international portfolio diversification and country-specific investment risks.

- Experience in managing or overseeing international investment portfolios through offshore funds or GIFT City structures will be valuable.

4. Research & Investment Analysis:

- Lead and mentor a team of research analysts and investment professionals.

- Establish a strong research-driven investment culture supported by fundamental analysis, financial modelling, valuation and market intelligence.

- Oversee investment recommendations, due diligence, sector analysis and portfolio reviews.

- Ensure investment decisions are supported by robust research, independent judgement and disciplined risk assessment.

5. Risk Management & Performance:

- Monitor portfolio performance, market exposure, concentration risks and downside protection.

- Establish appropriate risk-management frameworks and investment controls.

- Consistently evaluate portfolio performance against relevant benchmarks and investment objectives.

- Demonstrate a track record of generating superior and sustainable risk-adjusted returns.

Candidate Profile

Educational Qualifications:

- Chartered Accountant (CA) is mandatory.

- MBA in Finance, Investment Management or a related discipline from a premier institute is strongly preferred. Candidates from reputed institutions such as IIMs, ISB, XLRI, SPJIMR, FMS or other nationally recognised premier business schools will be preferred.

- CFA qualification will be an added advantage but is not a substitute for the mandatory CA qualification.

Professional Experience:

- 8 - 12+ years of relevant experience in investment management, asset management, AIF, PMS or global investment management.

- Mandatory hands-on experience in managing or leading both AIF and PMS investment activities.

- Demonstrated experience in global funds and international investment markets, including international equities, offshore funds or global portfolio management.

- Strong understanding of domestic and international financial markets, portfolio construction, asset allocation, valuation and investment research.

- Proven experience in leading and developing research analysts and investment teams.

- A consistent track record of delivering superior investment performance and managing portfolios across different market conditions.

Preferred Industry Background:

- Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs)

- Portfolio Management Services (PMS)

- Asset Management Companies (AMCs)

- Global investment management firms

- Boutique investment houses

- Family offices and institutional investment platforms

Additional Advantage:

- Exposure to GIFT City / International Financial Services Centre (IFSC) structures and the associated investment ecosystem.

- Experience with international fund structures, offshore investment vehicles and cross-border portfolio management.

Ideal Candidate:

The ideal candidate will be a seasoned investment professional with strong investment judgement, intellectual depth and the ability to combine global market perspectives with disciplined portfolio management.

The individual must have personally driven investment decisions, managed AIF and PMS portfolios, understood international investment opportunities and successfully led research teams.

This position is intended for a genuine investment leader with a demonstrable investment track record - not merely a professional whose experience is limited to fundraising, product development, investor relations or fund operations.

Position Details:

Designation: Head - Investments

Location: Mumbai, India

Experience: 8 - 12+ years

Qualification: CA mandatory; MBA from a premier institute strongly preferred

Mandate: AIF, PMS, Global Funds & International Investments

Confidentiality: The organisation's identity and further details of the investment mandate will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

As a cloud data engineer, you will collaborate with our Regulatory business to drive development in our high-priority trading area. As part of our cross-functional team, you will work across requirements, testing, development and deployment, engaging stakeholders in discussions about solutions. title: Project Executive
description:
At NewGround, we believe the right environment can change how people work, connect, and succeed. As a leading design and delivery firm, we partner with financial institutions, healthcare providers, and corporations to turn vision into reality. Our work is powered by clear communication, true collaboration, bold innovation, service-driven thinking, and a commitment to excellence, all centered in our defining core values. In the role, Project Executive, you’ll be a key contributor to that mission, helping shape projects, teams, and experiences that truly make a difference.

The Project Executive is responsible for the overall performance and successful delivery of assigned projects from early project development through construction and closeout. Serving as a senior point of contact for clients and a leader of the project team, this position coordinates internal teams, consultants, contractors, and other project stakeholders while overseeing project financial performance, schedules, contracts, risk, quality, and deliverables. The Project Executive works closely with the Director of Build Operations and partners across NewGround to maintain alignment, resolve issues, develop team members, and ensure NewGround delivers on its commitments to clients.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide leadership and oversight for multiple assigned projects, maintaining accountability for scope, schedule, budget, profitability, quality, risk, and client satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Establish, develop, and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a senior point of contact and trusted resource while ensuring client expectations, project requirements, and NewGround commitments remain aligned.
  • Lead and coordinate project teams, establishing clear objectives, responsibilities, milestones, communication expectations, and accountability while creating a positive and collaborative working environment.
  • Direct, mentor, and develop Construction Project Managers and other assigned project personnel, providing guidance, performance oversight, and support throughout project delivery.
  • Partner with Business Development and other internal teams during project pursuits as needed, providing construction and project delivery expertise, supporting proposals and interviews, and helping evaluate project opportunities.
  • Support the development, review, presentation, and negotiation of project proposals, Project Development Agreements, contracts, and related project documents within established authority.
  • Develop and oversee project execution plans, schedules, milestones, staffing requirements, budgets, forecasts, and project controls to ensure work progresses in alignment with contractual commitments and financial expectations.
  • Monitor project financial performance, including fees, costs, forecasts, commitments, change orders, and other financial indicators, taking appropriate action to address variances and protect project profitability.
  • Proactively identify project risks, constraints, and potential impacts to scope, schedule, cost, quality, or client expectations and coordinate appropriate mitigation and resolution strategies.
  • Oversee contractual administration for assigned projects, including subcontracts, purchase orders, change orders, contractual modifications, and other agreements affecting project scope, budget, or schedule.
  • Provide oversight of project due diligence, permitting, entitlements, jurisdictional requirements, external consultants, and other development or regulatory activities required to advance assigned projects.
  • Coordinate and direct external consultants, contractors, design professionals, and other project partners to ensure responsibilities, deliverables, schedules, and contractual requirements are understood and fulfilled.
  • Oversee project deliverables and ensure documentation, communications, decisions, and reporting remain current, accurate, and aligned with project requirements and contractual obligations.
  • Conduct and support project kickoff, progress, client, and coordination meetings to maintain alignment, resolve issues, advance decisions, and keep project stakeholders informed.
  • Monitor construction activities and project performance to ensure compliance with plans, specifications, contracts, applicable codes, safety requirements, and NewGround quality expectations.
  • Work with owners, contractors, trade partners, design professionals, consultants, and internal teams to resolve construction issues, project challenges, complaints, delays, and other matters affecting successful delivery.
  • Support projects through completion, punch list, turnover, warranty, and closeout, ensuring contractual obligations and client expectations are fulfilled.
  • Maintain effective communication with the Director of Build Operations regarding project performance, significant risks, client concerns, resource needs, financial issues, and other matters requiring leadership awareness or support.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen client relationships and expand the value NewGround provides, coordinating with Business Development and other internal leaders as appropriate.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

EXPECTATIONS

  • Lead through a servant leadership approach that motivates, supports, develops, and holds project team members accountable while putting the success of the client, project, team, and NewGround first.
  • Demonstrate sound judgment, accountability, and a solutions oriented approach when navigating complex project challenges and making project decisions.
  • Build trusted, collaborative relationships with clients, employees, contractors, trade partners, consultants, and other project stakeholders.
  • Communicate clearly, proactively, and professionally, ensuring project teams and stakeholders have the information needed to make timely decisions and successfully advance projects.
  • Demonstrate strong business and financial acumen with an understanding of how project decisions affect scope, schedule, cost, profitability, risk, and client satisfaction.
  • Foster a positive, collaborative, and accountable project environment that reinforces NewGround's core values and commitment to excellence.
  • Navigate conflict, difficult conversations, and challenging project situations with confidence, professionalism, respect, and sound judgment.
  • Demonstrate initiative, adaptability, organization, and the ability to effectively manage multiple complex projects and competing priorities.
  • Maintain a strong commitment to safety, quality, client service, and continuous improvement throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Exhibit integrity, credibility, professionalism, and a commitment to NewGround's mission and core values.
  • Travel 30% to 50%, or as needed, to support clients, projects, project teams, and business needs.

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE PREREQUISITES

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in construction management, design and construction, project delivery, or an owner's representative environment.
  • Significant experience leading complex commercial construction projects through the full project lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated experience leading project teams and developing Construction Project Managers or other construction professionals.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial construction means, methods, best practices, plans, specifications, contracts, and related building systems.
  • Demonstrated experience managing project budgets, forecasts, cost controls, schedules, staffing requirements, contract modifications, and change management.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop, evaluate, and manage CPM and critical path project schedules.
  • Strong understanding of project risk identification, assessment, mitigation, and resolution.
  • Experience working with clients, owners, contractors, trade partners, architects, engineers, consultants, and other project stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with construction management and reporting technology, including Microsoft Office, Microsoft Project, Procore, or similar project management platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Revit, AutoCAD, and other design technology platforms preferred.

As Maki grows, the Science and AI team’s job is to show, with evidence, that our approach leads to better hiring decisions.

About the Role

The AI Research Scientist works at the intersection of AI, psychometrics and research, ensuring that Maki’s automated scoring systems are scientifically robust, fair, and continuously improving.

1. Evaluating and testing LLMs for scoring

  • Assess the accuracy and reliability of LLMs used for automated scoring, such as structured grids, job-specific skills and multilingual proficiency (written and spoken).

  • Benchmark closed- and open-source models across assessment types and languages.

  • Test robustness to prompt variation, input noise and adversarial behaviour such as prompt injection.

  • Explore prompt engineering and model optimisation, and recommend which models and prompts go into production.

2. Building our own scoring models

  • Move our scoring onto self-hosted open-weight models, and fine-tune them on expert-rated data where they can beat frontier models.

  • Check every model switch keeps accuracy, reliability and fairness at least as good as today's.

3. Comparing AI with human judgement, and calibrating psychometric models

  • Design studies that compare AI scores with expert ratings, against both individual experts and expert averages, to establish agreement and validity.

  • Develop hybrid scoring pipelines with engineering that combine human oversight with AI scoring.

  • Evaluate and calibrate psychometric models for validity and comparability across populations and test forms.

4. Bias and fairness analysis

  • Detect and analyse bias in AI-generated and psychometric scores across demographic groups, including subgroup analysis.

  • Apply mitigation techniques such as reweighting and calibration without losing model performance.

  • Contribute to fairness dashboards and compliance documentation that support transparent model governance.

5. Predictive analytics and performance insights

  • Model the relationship between candidate scores and job performance and retention, using large assessment and performance datasets.

  • Develop and test models that estimate success probabilities or identify behavioural and linguistic predictors of performance.

  • Work with data science, implementation and customer success teams to turn findings into recommendations for clients and colleagues.

6. Research output

  • Publish reports, papers and conference presentations, internal and external.

  • Explain technical findings clearly to non-technical colleagues and clients.

As one of Maki People's early employees, you'll help shape the team's future.

Our Ideal Candidate

Required

  • PhD or MSc in machine learning, computational linguistics, data science or psychology.

  • A track record of publications, such as peer-reviewed papers or conference papers.

  • Hands-on experience evaluating LLMs: designing benchmarks, measuring agreement with human raters, and testing consistency and robustness of model output.

  • Experience testing AI-driven decisions for fairness and bias.

  • Proficiency in Python or R, with experience in statistical analysis.

  • Clear communication of results to scientific and business audiences.

Preferred

  • Experience with NLP techniques for automated scoring.

  • Experience fine-tuning language models, for example with LoRA.

  • Experience working with cloud databases and large datasets.

  • Working knowledge of psychometric concepts such as reliability, validity and IRT, and how they apply to assessment design and validation.

  • Working knowledge of ethical AI, data governance and compliance, such as the EU AI Act.

  • Experience working with engineering, product and content teams.

Application Process

  • Stage 1 - Screening assessment (25 min)

  • Stage 2 - Power skill assessment with our AI agent (15 min)

  • Stage 3 - Hiring manager interview (45 min)

  • Stage 4 - Executive interview (45 min)

  • Stage 5 - Deep-dive technical interview (60 min)

  • Stage 6 - Interview with Co-founder (30 min)

About Stackgini

How do you govern 20,000 applications when nobody in the building still knows which of them do the same thing? How do you get faster to market and leaner at the same time, when business units ship AI prototypes in days and the regulatory load grows every quarter?

Stackgini is the AI operating system for Autonomous Enterprise IT. Our system understands our customers' enterprise tech landscape from the ground up: from technical configuration to application documentation, from a single tech demand to the dependencies across the entire portfolio. With the depth of knowledge of a senior tech expert and the speed of a machine. Some of the largest organizations in the world work with us, including DAX-40 and Fortune-500 customers like Siemens Healthineers and REWE.

We're a small, talent-dense team, building what we believe will change how the world's largest companies operate. We are growing fast, and the people joining now are the ones who set the standard - for the product, the culture, and our category. Stackgini will be the place where you will do the most meaningful work of your career.

About the role

As an Enterprise Engagement Manager, you own what Stackgini actually becomes inside our customers. You take over once the deal closes and guide the organization from the first target-picture discussion to the point where tech demand management runs differently than it did before.

This is advisory work with a product behind it. You sit with CIOs, IT business partners, and enterprise architects, understand how their demand process works today and where it breaks, and design a target picture they can defend internally. You measure what it delivered and turn that into the basis for the next year.

Unlike consulting, you don't walk out after the final presentation. You stay with the accounts you own and see, over years, what became of your work.

Areas of ownership

  • Strategic advisory. You are the trusted advisor to tech leaders in DAX-40, Fortune-500, and ambitious mid-market organizations. You show them what best-practice AI-first demand management looks like and bring an outside view they can't get internally. Out of that you develop the target picture with them, from the end-to-end process concept to how Stackgini fits into the existing IT toolchain.

  • Value realization. You define the KPIs you will be measured against together with the customer, baseline them, and prove the effect. You guide them through portfolio optimization and build the business cases behind it. Realized value is not a story for the QBR here, it is the number the role hangs on.

  • Stakeholder engagement. You make the champions inside the customer's organization successful. You give them the arguments, the evidence, and the backing they need to carry Stackgini into business units, IT governance, architecture, procurement, and information security.

  • Adoption and enablement. You make power users and multipliers capable through trainings, best practices, and workshops, and you feed what you learn back into our methodology.

  • Account growth and expansion. Identify and drive expansion opportunities by developing growth plans across new use cases, teams, and units, and spot risk before it surfaces in a renewal.

  • Build our customer value engine. You work hands-on on daily operations, expand the Stackgini Academy into a best-in-class enablement hub, and develop thought leadership assets: playbooks, point-of-view content, best practice guides.

  • Partner cross-functionally. Bring structured customer insights into Product and Engineering, shape our roadmap with use-case-driven evidence, and support Sales on key strategic deals.

Who you are

  • 2+ years in enterprise tech or consulting. Strategy or management consulting, IT transformation, or an enterprise tech function such as IT governance, architecture, or tech demand management. What matters is that you owned an outcome at a customer, not a workstream.

  • You structure ambiguity. You break down complex problems, shape them into clear options, and build processes that work without you.

  • You hold your own up to C-level. Precise in writing, structured in speech, composed in front of executives. In German and English.

  • AI-native, not AI-curious. You can describe concretely how you use LLMs, agents, or custom workflows in your daily work. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to be credible in a room with one.

  • Ownership over scope. You move things forward without waiting to be assigned, and client-facing work energizes you rather than drains you.

What's a plus

  • A real understanding of how enterprise tech organizations work, ideally with exposure to enterprise architecture, IT governance, software asset management, or IT procurement

title: Payment Specialist
description:
About FunnelFox

FunnelFox is a complete growth solution for subscription apps. With visibility across 1,000+ apps and $2B in processed revenue, our growth agent shows you how to get your next 10x, and our platform gives you everything to make it happen: AI-built web2app funnels, analytics, A/B testing and our own payments infrastructure.

About the team

The Solutions team helps subscription apps set up payment providers, launch their web funnels and solve billing issues. Clients rely on us as their payments experts, and our goal is to make sure every client’s payment setup brings them as much revenue as possible.

Why we’re hiring

Payments is one of the fastest-growing parts of FunnelFox. Every new client brings its own mix of markets, payment providers and risks, so no two setups are the same.

We’re looking for a senior payments expert who enjoys solving exactly these puzzles. You’ll look at a client’s numbers after launch and see what nobody has noticed yet, and then help the client earn more from every payment. This is a client-facing role: you’ll lead calls with clients, walk them through your findings and help them put your recommendations into practice.

You’ll also shape how FunnelFox works with payments. Your audits, playbooks and training will turn your expertise into something the whole team can use, so proactive optimization becomes the standard for every client. We expect you to come in and tell us what we’re missing.

What you’ll do

  • Run payment audits for clients: break approval rate, fraud and dispute rates down by provider, country, BIN, payment method and paywall version to identify the key drivers behind performance changes.

  • Turn findings into clear recommendations, walk clients through them on calls and follow through until the change is live and the effect is measured.

  • Optimize proactively: review new clients’ payments in the first weeks after launch and spot problems before the client does.

  • Help clients choose and set up the right payment providers, orchestration and local payment methods for their markets.

  • Keep fraud and chargebacks under control, and help clients prevent and handle provider restrictions.

  • Build the team’s expertise: train Solutions and Customer Success, and consult on complex cases.

  • Write playbooks, guides and best practices, and automate recurring checks and reports, so payment optimization becomes a repeatable process.

  • Pitch in on client onboarding, provider integrations and billing investigations when the team needs an extra pair of hands.

You’ll be a great fit if you have

  • 3–5 years of hands-on payments experience in a product company with subscriptions: mobile apps, web2app, SaaS or digital products. Medium-to-large companies are a plus.

  • Experience with several payment providers or a payment orchestrator, including launching new providers and local payment methods.

  • Deep understanding of what drives card approval rates: 3DS, anti-fraud, chargebacks and provider risk policies. You know how to prevent and handle account restrictions while staying fully compliant.

  • Strong analytics: you break a problem down into numbers, calculate it yourself and don’t trust the first answer. You can show the revenue impact of your work.

  • Hands-on data skills: you can work with raw data on your own (SQL over transaction logs and provider exports), and you can also work through Data Engineering and BA: you know which data to ask for, write a clear request and check what comes back.

  • An AI-native way of working: you use LLMs and agents every day for SQL, analysis and writing, but you know where they go wrong (made-up numbers, wrong joins, double counting, confident but wrong conclusions), so you check their output against the data and correct it.

  • A preference for automation over manual work: if a check or report has to be done twice, you turn it into a script, a scheduled query, a dashboard or an agent instead of repeating it by hand.

  • A technical mindset: you’re not afraid of APIs, webhooks, logs and integrations.

  • Confidence in client-facing work: you lead calls, explain complex payment topics simply, handle difficult conversations and get clients to act on your advice.

  • Strong spoken and written English: you’ll work with clients and colleagues around the world.

Nice to have

  • Experience at a payment orchestrator or payment provider, for example as an account manager or payments consultant.

  • Experience working with products that have complex payment infrastructure and high payment processing volumes.

  • Experience negotiating fees and contracts with payment providers.

  • Experience building playbooks or training others.

What you may expect from working with us:

  • Flexible remote work: Work from anywhere with a schedule that fits your life. Our core team operates in Europe, and we welcome candidates worldwide using .

  • High ownership and real impact: You’ll actively influence product and technical decisions, not just execute predefined tasks.

  • Fast-moving startup environment: We value speed, autonomy, and practical problem-solving over rigid corporate processes.

  • Direct communication: We keep things simple and transparent, ensuring you focus on what matters most — getting things done.

  • Professional Support: We provide a monthly budget that you can allocate based on your personal and professional priorities — including language learning, professional development, mental health support, sports, or health insurance.

As AUTODOC continues to scale its operations across Europe, our business processes and People & Culture structures are continuously evolving. To keep pace with this dynamic environment, we need to adapt our systems, rethink our existing implementations, and design solutions that scale effectively across our global organization.

To achieve this goal, we are hiring an HRIS Product Owner to manage, configure, and maintain our current HRIS landscape. You will run and improve our current core HRIS (Workday: HCM, Time Tracking, Absence Management and Advanced Compensation) and shape the architecture, integrations and roadmap of our wider HR tech ecosystem.

In this role, you will analyze complex People & Culture requirements and determine whether solutions can be delivered directly within core platform other times it means integrating with external systems or bringing in other tools. Operating with high autonomy in a flexible Jira-driven environment, you will translate business needs into scalable technical architecture and drive continuous system improvements.

This is an exciting opportunity for a proactive problem solver to take end-to-end ownership of critical HR technology in a fast-growing e-commerce leader. You will directly influence how our people processes run, optimize workflows, and bring innovative solutions to life for thousands of AUTODOCers across Europe.

What you will do

  • Own the HR systems landscape and roadmap: the core HRIS, connected applications, integrations and data flows.
  • Define and maintain the HR data model (organizational structures, job architecture, compensation, time and absence) so it stays consistent, scalable and system-agnostic.
  • Analyze People & Culture business requirements, evaluate system feasibility, and design scalable technical solutions both inside and outside HRIS.
  • Manage business process security policies, domain security policies, and user/role-based access controls in accordance with company standards.
  • Partner with People & Culture stakeholders, Finance, and cross-functional teams to translate operational needs into clear system deliverables and Jira project roadmaps.
  • Ensure robust data integrity and quality control across systems through rigorous testing, audit routines, and workflow improvements.

  • At least 2 years of hands-on Workday administration and configuration experience (5+ years in HRIS environments preferred).
  • Solid grasp of HR system architecture: data models, integrations (APIs, middleware/iPaaS, file-based interfaces) and how HR data flows to payroll, Finance and IT systems.
  • Demonstrated expertise or functional working knowledge in at least one key module: Time Tracking, Absence Management, or Advanced Compensation.
  • Proven ability to design end-to-end technical solutions and look beyond out-of-the-box system constraints to solve complex business challenges.
  • Solid understanding of Workday security frameworks, including domain and business process security policies.
  • Experience working in an agile environment utilizing Jira for task, project, and ticket management.
