The Exercise Coach® - Palm Beach County is hiring part-time Stretch & Health Coaches for our North Palm Beach and Jupiter studios.

If you have a strong interest in health and fitness with a lot of enthusiasm, a positive attitude and good communication, we have a fun and fulfilling Strength/Stretch/Health Coach Position just for YOU! As a Coach at The Exercise Coach® you will be:

  • Lead individual and semi-private strength training sessions
  • Provide coach-assisted stretching sessions
  • Use evidence-based, state-of-the-art fitness technology
  • Track client goals and fitness results
  • Grow the business through acquisition and retention of clients
We provide all training and certifications—paid and included as part of the path to becoming certified at The Exercise Coach® - Palm Beach County.

Certification includes:
  • Certified Exercise Coach: human physiology, exercise science, nutrition science, fitness technology, and proprietary training methods
  • Certified Stretch Coach: physiology of flexibility, and advanced applications of assisted stretching techniques
Qualifications for a Health and Fitness Coach at The Exercise Coach®:

  • Passion for Health & Fitness: Living a healthy and fit lifestyle with the passion to inspire others.
  • Strong Communication Skills: Enjoy conversing in-person and on-the-phone. Conduct yourself in a professional manner and deliver clear instructions during training sessions.
  • People Skills: LOVE working with clients and teammates. The ability to convey your passion with excitement and energy.
  • Health and Fitness Education: Demonstrate a fundamental knowledge of exercise science, human biology and nutrition. A college degree in Exercise Science and/or Kinesiology is preferred.
If you would like to inspire and empower people to enjoy strength, we’d love for you to consider joining our team!


About The Exercise Coach®:

The Exercise Coach® - Palm Beach County (Boca Raton, Jupiter, North Palm Beach) is committed to leading a workplace where Coaches love to work! Our goal is to create a workplace fueled by passion and driven by our purpose to transform the way people age. Aging should be a journey marked by vitality, strength, and independence. This mission drives us, along with our team, to innovate and provide solutions that address not just the length of life but, most importantly, its quality.

We promise to cultivate an environment where you are valued, supported, and inspired to bring your best to every client interaction.
We offer:

  • Growth Opportunities. We promote from within. As our business grows, our Coaches grow. We offer opportunities to engage with prospects and clients, learn about operating a fitness business and increase hours with added responsibilities.
  • Innovation. We are hiring to expand our team as we introduce groundbreaking approaches to fitness which include: Exerbotics Strength Training, Concentrated Cardio, and Coach-Assisted Stretching.
  • Proprietary Equipment. Our bio-sensitive training technologies make it possible to measure unique muscular and metabolic makeup and prescribe client-specific workouts.
  • The Exercise Coach method
Compensation: $20 per hour for your time in the studio, regardless if you are coaching a client.

The Exercise Coach® is a professional and distraction-free health facility! We offer clients what would be more accurately described as clinical exercise, rather than the latest fitness craze in a crowded, intimidating environment. The Exercise Coach® is dedicated to helping women and men of all ages achieve their health and fitness goals through customized physical conditioning programs and the use of our proprietary technology. We pride ourselves on the safety, effectiveness, and efficiency of The Exercise Coach® where coaches are an essential piece.




This franchise is independently owned and operated by a franchisee. Your application will go directly to the franchisee, and all hiring decisions will be made by the management of this franchisee. All inquiries about employment at this franchisee should be made directly to the franchise location, and not to The Exercise Coach, USA Corporate.

title: VP, Procedural Areas (Warner Robins)
description:
Be inspired. Be rewarded. Belong. At Emory Healthcare.

At Emory Healthcare we fuel your professional journey with better benefits, valuable resources, ongoing mentorship and leadership programs for all types of jobs, and a supportive environment that enables you to reach new heights in your career and be what you want to be. We provide:

  • Comprehensive health benefits that start day 1
  • Student Loan Repayment Assistance & Reimbursement Programs
  • Family-focused benefits
  • Wellness incentives
  • Ongoing mentorship, development, and leadership programs
  • And more

Work Location: Warner Robins, GA (Minimum of 3 days, onsite)

The VP of Procedural Areas leads in developing the philosophy, goals, and objectives for procedurals areas at dedicated facility to include Perioperative services.

  • Functions as part of an OR Steering/Executive Committee team consisting of the Anesthesiology Chief, Surgery Medical Director, Chief of Surgery, and Perioperative Director
  • Provides administrative and financial accountability for planning, directing, staffing, coordinating, and controlling functions and activities of all phases of the Perioperative Services Department and Procedural areas including: Operating Room, Pre-/Postoperative Units, Anesthesia Preoperative Clinic, GI, Endoscopy, and Sterile Processing
  • Provides administrative oversight and hospital executive connection to the hospital based procedural areas operated by the Service Lines and Core Services including Cardiology, Cath Lab, COA, procedural Radiology, and the Labor and Delivery Operating Suites
  • As part of OR Committee, designs, develops, organizes, directs, measures, and promotes Perioperative Services and Procedural area programs to the medical staff and community
  • Promotes increased case volume/market share through development and provision of operationally marketable surgery program, assurance of positive relations with Surgeons, provision of patient service- oriented surgical program, development, promotion, and implementation of new surgical procedures with individual Surgeon groups or surgical sections that will result in financially viable increased case volume
  • Manages the overall operations of the Procedural areas in accordance with Hospital administered policies, standards of nursing practices, and governmental regulations providing excellent care for all patients
  • Provides nursing and operational accountability for the quality improvement program in collaboration with the OR Executive Committee
  • Implements standards and administers clinical practice, evaluates clinical outcomes, and maintains patients' clinical records
  • Works collaboratively with other members of the OR Committee, the medical staff, Heart and Vascular Service Line, Cancer Service Line, other Hospital Departmental Managers, and Hospital Administration
  • Plans, directs, coordinates, implements, delegates, controls, and evaluates the continuity of care, quality of care, and customer services consistent with departmental best practice standards and objectives
  • Designs, develops, organizes, directs, measures, and promotes Procedural Area programs to the medical staff and community
  • Establishes systems for care management including assessments, care planning, and discharge planning
  • Makes necessary changes to procedures and programs to promote practices that are responsive to patient's needs
  • Monitors and assures compliance with regulatory and accrediting organizations and Hospital policies for the safe and efficient delivery of quality patient care
  • Completes and approves annual operations and capital expense budgets; directs necessary analysis, factoring financial need into budget projections, and presents proposed budgets to the governing body for final approval
  • Develops, implements, monitors, and measures programs for staff recruitment and retention
  • Participates in all standing committees
  • Communicates with Physicians and works closely with the Medical Directors to maintain a high standard of medical care and development of client relationships with Surgeons
  • Collaborates with associates in the development and review of recommended changes of policies and procedures and quality improvement indicators
  • Possesses knowledge of professional standards, principles, and procedures. Demonstrates excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • Possesses knowledge of Joint Commission guidelines and state/federal regulations and standards
  • Demonstrates strong financial, marketing, and personnel management skills
  • Demonstrates strong project management and change managements skills
  • Demonstrates strong strategic planning skills
  • Demonstrates leadership skills with emphasis on staff retention
  • Demonstrates knowledge of computer systems and software

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Registered Nurse (RN) with valid state licensure required
  • Master's degree in nursing, health administration, or business administration required
  • Seven years OR experience with progressive OR management experience required
  • Three - five years Director experience preferred
  • Currently licensed as a registered nurse in the state of Georgia (or eligible)
  • Strong communication and organizational/planning skills with demonstrated leadership abilities
  • Extensive experience in overseeing Perioperative and Cardiology service line and nursing practice in a complex fast paced academic hospital system preferred

Emory is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by state or federal law.

Emory Healthcare is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities upon request. Please contact Emory Healthcare’s Human Resources at careers@emoryhealthcare.org. Please note that one week's advance notice is preferred.

title: Apartment Make Ready Technician
description:
Now Hiring: Make Ready Technician – AMLI Lex on Orange

Glendale, CA | $24.50 per Hour + Monthly & Year-End Bonuses

Schedule: Tuesday–Saturday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM

Love Working with Your Hands? Put Your Skills to Work at AMLI!


Are you skilled in drywall repair, painting, and general home maintenance? Do you take pride in transforming a space and making it look its best?

AMLI Residential is hiring a Make Ready Technician at AMLI Lex on Orange, our luxury apartment community in Glendale.

In this hands-on role, you'll prepare apartment homes for new residents by completing repairs, painting, and finishing touches that make every apartment feel like new.


Whether your background is in apartment maintenance, handyman services, residential remodeling, or general property repairs, this is a great opportunity to put your skills to work with an established company that values quality workmanship and teamwork.


Benefits and Compensation:

  • $24.50
  • Monthly and Year-End Bonus Opportunities
  • Tuesday–Saturday, 8 AM–5 PM
  • On-call rotation for evenings and weekends every couple of weeks
  • Apartment Rent Discounts at AMLI Communities
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • 20 Days of PTO + 9 Paid Holidays
  • Career Growth and Development Opportunities

What You'll Do

Your primary responsibility is to get vacant apartments ready for new residents, ensuring every home meets AMLI's quality standards.

  • Drywall & Painting: Patch holes, repair drywall, match textures, prepare surfaces, and complete interior painting.
  • Apartment Repairs: Repair or replace doors, windows, screens, locks, shelves, baseboards, mirrors, blinds, and other interior components.
  • Basic Plumbing: Repair faucets, drains, toilets, and plumbing fixtures.
  • Basic Electrical: Replace switches, outlets, light fixtures, and ceiling fans.
  • Carpentry & Finishing: Repair cabinets, countertops, closets, trim, and other apartment features.
  • Appliance Maintenance: Complete minor appliance repairs and replacements.
  • Apartment Inspections: Inspect vacant homes, complete make-ready checklists, and ensure apartments are ready for scheduled move-ins.
  • Locks & Keys: Change locks and prepare keys for incoming residents.
  • Property Upkeep: Assist with maintaining clean, attractive common areas and community grounds.
  • Teamwork: Collaborate with the maintenance team to complete apartment turns efficiently and maintain a safe working environment.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience in apartment maintenance, handyman services, residential repairs, painting, or remodeling.
  • Strong drywall repair, patching, texturing, and painting skills.
  • Working knowledge of basic plumbing, electrical, carpentry, and appliance repairs.
  • Ability to troubleshoot problems and complete repairs independently.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Availability to work Tuesday–Saturday, 8 AM–5 PM and participate in an evening and weekend on-call rotation.
  • HVAC experience is a plus but not required.


AMLI Residential is a leader in sustainable, LEED and ENERGY STAR-certified luxury apartment communities and is an equal employment opportunity employer committed to personal and professional development.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

AMLI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Company may utilize artificial intelligence, as permitted by law, in its recruitment, hiring, promotion, discipline, discharge, or other employment-related activities. Any artificial intelligence used will not have the effect of subjecting employees to discrimination on the basis of any protected class under federal, state, or local law, nor will the artificial intelligence use zip code data as a proxy for protected class information.

title: Senior Data Scientist
company: o9 Solutions Management India Private Limited

At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.

This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.

About the Role


We are looking for a Sr. Data Scientist with strong expertise in Retail Demand Forecasting and

Supply Chain Analytics. In this role, you will design and implement advanced machine learning and

statistical models to improve forecasting accuracy and enable intelligent decision-making for global retail

organizations.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams including clients, solution architects, consultants, and

data engineers to build scalable AI/ML solutions that drive measurable business impact.

ensemble learning, neural networks, time series forecasting, and optimization models.

title: Principal Operations Research Scientist(Gurobi/CPLEX/Xpress)(Python/Java/C++/C#/ Go)(12+years) - 11780
description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.
Why join Coupa?
  • Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
  • Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
  • Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

The Impact of Principal Operations Research Scientist to Coupa:

At Coupa, we are building the smartest Business Spend Management (BSM) platform in the world. Our Supply Chain and Sourcing engineering teams develop advanced tools that help global enterprises design resilient supply chains, optimize procurement events, and maximize the value of every dollar spent. The Operations Research team is at the heart of this mission. As a Principal Operations Research Scientist, you will act as the principal hands-on architect for our core optimization engines, driving technical excellence and turning complex mathematical theories into scalable, production-ready enterprise software.

What You’ll Do

  • Algorithmic Leadership: Take end-to-end technical ownership of complex
    optimization features. Formulate, prototype, and implement advanced
    mathematical models (MIP, LP, NLP, Network Flow, and custom heuristics) to
    solve strategic sourcing and supply chain challenges.
  • Architecture & Scalability: Partner with software architects to integrate
    optimization models into Coupa’s high-throughput, multi-tenant SaaS platform.
    Ensure the code is modular, well-tested, and built to handle massive enterprise
    datasets.
  • Solver Tuning & Optimization: Bench-test, profile, and tune commercial solvers
    (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, Google OR-Tools) to dramatically improve performance,
    solve times, and memory footprint under strict application SLAs.
  • Technical Mentorship: Act as a force multiplier by mentoring senior and junior
    engineers/scientists. Establish code review standards and run design sessions to
    elevate the team's mathematical and engineering practices.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product Managers and Senior
    Engineering leaders to define feature requirements, translate business objectives
    into technical specifications, and manage algorithmic trade-offs.
  • Empirical Validation: Design robust validation frameworks and simulation
    environments to thoroughly test model behavior, ensuring stability and
    mathematical correctness against highly variable, messy real-world data.

What You Will Bring to Coupa

  • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering,
    Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or a closely related field.
  • 12+ years of industry experience applying operations research methods and
    deploying production-level optimization models in commercial environments at
    scale.
  • Expert knowledge of mathematical programming and deep experience with
    authoring model formulations for commercial solvers (such as Gurobi, CPLEX, or
    Xpress).
  • Strong programming proficiency in Python, Java, C++, C# or Go, with a solid
    understanding of software design patterns and object-oriented programming.
  • Deep understanding of computational complexity, advanced data structures, and
    algorithmic design.
  • Excellent communication skills, with a proven ability to explain highly complex
    mathematical behaviors to product and business leaders.
  • You are an elite mathematical modeler who also loves writing clean, production-
    grade code.
  • You are highly analytical, self-driven, and excel at converting ambiguous, high-
    level business constraints into structured, elegant algorithms.
  • You enjoy mentoring others and are passionate about cultivating a highly
    collaborative, intellectually rigorous engineering culture.
  • You embody Coupa’s core values: Ensure Customer Success, Focus on Results,
    and Strive for Excellence.
What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)
  • Deep domain expertise in Supply Chain Network Design, Inventory Optimization,
    Production/Scheduling Optimization, Routing Optimization, Strategic
    Procurement, and/or Logistics.
  • Experience utilizing Machine Learning techniques (e.g., forecasting, clustering) in
    tandem with mathematical optimization models.
  • Experience with PySpark, SQL, and processing large-scale datasets in
    distributed computing environments.
The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.
At Coupa, we are 100% committed to creating and nurturing an environment that supports your physical, mental, and community well-being. We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help you and your family thrive:
Global Well-Being Perks (For All Employees Globally)
  • Global Wellness Days: Enjoy two designated, company-wide paid wellness days off each year (typically the first Friday in March and the last Friday in September) so the entire global team can unplug, step away, and recharge together .

  • Business Travel Protection: Travel with peace of mind. Zurich Travel Assist provides medical, safety, pre-trip planning, and emergency support during any business travel .
  • Referral Bonus Program: Share the Coupa experience! Receive generous monetary referral bonuses when you successfully refer talented friends or acquaintances who are hired into open roles .
Please note: In addition to these global well-being perks, Coupa offers highly competitive, location-specific benefits packages (which include comprehensive medical/dental insurance, retirement/pension plans, and life or accident protection) tailored to your primary work location. Your recruiter will walk you through the specific regional benefits package for this role during the interview process.

Location

Hybrid in Palo Alto, California.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About ODAIA

ODAIA (noun) · o·da·ia | oh-day-yeah: an Ancient Greek word referring to ōdē, the word for song and the root of melody, harmony, and orchestra. We chose it deliberately: the best commercial intelligence doesn’t just inform, it orchestrates.

ODAIA delivers AI-powered commercial intelligence for life sciences, unifying data, accelerating results, and helping commercial teams deepen engagement to enhance care for providers and patients. Our AI platform transforms complex data into predictive, personalized insights, enabling commercial leaders to understand their customers, anticipate prescribing behaviors, and make the informed, strategic decisions that bring therapies to patients faster.

Our Mission

Reducing patients’ time to therapy by facilitating meaningful interactions with healthcare providers, through human-centric software powered by AI.

We’re also on a mission to build an innovative, diverse, and ego-free business, where trust, innovation and ownership are valued. You’re on a mission too? We’re here for it. We put an emphasis on career development for our employees, and the opportunities to grow are extensive.

What’s on Offer

We’re looking for a Software Engineer t to join our engineering team. You’ll work across the full stack to build and ship features that directly impact how pharma commercial teams engage with healthcare providers. You’ll work closely with senior engineers, product, and design to turn well-scoped requirements into shipped, working software, while growing your ownership over time.

How we build

We work AI-first. Coding agents like Claude Code do a large share of the hands‑on implementation, and engineers spend their time on problem framing, direction, review, and integration. You stay fully accountable for what ships. We want someone who is already moving beyond prompting a single agent: you orchestrate agents across multiple tasks and set up codebases so agents can do good work in them.

Where we’re headed

We want engineers who build real expertise in the systems they work on and use it to find new ways to change how the industry works.

What You Will Do

  • Own well-defined product capabilities end-to-end, from understanding the user problem through implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Work AI-first: use Claude Code and other coding agents across the development lifecycle, orchestrate agents across multiple tasks, structure codebases so agents work well in them, and review and integrate their output.
  • Build accessible, responsive React and TypeScript experiences, including data-rich workflows and interfaces that handle large data sets.
  • Design and maintain APIs and backend services that connect ODAIA’s data, ML, analytics, and agentic capabilities to customer-facing products.
  • Build, deploy, and operate applications on AWS and Kubernetes, working across Snowflake, PostgreSQL, third-party APIs, and embedded engines like DuckDB and DataFusion.
  • Ship incrementally with automated testing, CI, feature flags, and instrumentation that shows how features behave in production.
  • Take part in technical design, code review, and architecture discussions: assess designs, flag risks and trade-offs early, and propose improvements.
  • Work with product, design, and ML engineering, build life sciences expertise, and bring ideas that push the product forward.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of professional software development experience, with ownership across frontend and backend systems.
  • Hands‑on experience using coding agents as a primary way of building: giving clear context, directing work across multiple tasks, reviewing multi-file changes, catching bad assumptions, and owning the final result.
  • Strong React and TypeScript, including browser fundamentals, state management, accessibility, and performance with large data sets and dashboards.
  • Experience building and operating APIs or backend services in Python, TypeScript, or a comparable technology, including integrating third‑party APIs with resilient handling of rate limits, retries, and failures.
  • Strong fundamentals: modular design, automated testing, maintainable code, and the judgment to tell a good system from a weak one and explain why. A working understanding of distributed systems concepts such as caching, queues, and asynchronous processing.
  • Clear communication, including surfacing ambiguity and explaining trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

title: FoDM - Subchapter Lead Insights Center of Excellence EMEA Mature
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The regional Center of Excellence (CoE) Insights team serves as the primary Insights partner for all affiliates across the region, operating within the global Strategic Insights Chapter. Combining regional leadership, affiliate partnership, and global coordination, the team serves as the crucial bridge translating global intelligence strategy into local market adoption, standardizing analytical ways of working, and systematically channeling critical field intelligence back to global research and solutions teams.


As Subchapter Lead, Center of Excellence, you will lead a regional team of distributed Country Insights Business Partners while reporting directly to the global Chapter Lead, Strategic Insights. Physically based in the region and embedded in local markets, your primary purpose is to balance global standards with local market leadership. You will hold regional-level scope of impact across all affiliates in the region, directly shaping the local adoption of standard data products, enhancing affiliate commercial decision-making, and driving measurable operational efficiencies and strategic alignment across approximately 45% strategic initiatives and 55% operational execution.


The Opportunity


  • Affiliate Partnership & Strategic Advisory (35%): Serve as the primary trusted Insights partner to affiliate leadership (Heads of Marketing, Strategic Marketing Leads, Product Managers), establishing service SLAs, monitoring affiliate satisfaction, and supporting strategic planning cycles, launch readiness, and portfolio prioritization with market and competitive intelligence.
  • Team Leadership & Talent Cultivation (30%): Directly manage, coach, and develop a high-performing regional team of Country Insights Business Partners (spanning ~5 to 15 FTEs depending on regional scope, e.g., EMEA-Mature, EMEA-Growth & Emerging, APAC, China, or Americas), driving individual capability, business acumen, and consultative credibility.
  • Field Intelligence & Global Coordination (20%): Systematically capture local field signals—including competitive moves, customer feedback, and local market dynamics—and channel them back to global Strategic Insights, Global Insight Solutions, and CoE peers to inform global research priorities as the regional "voice of the customer."
  • Insight Solutions, Innovation & Digital Adoption (15%): Champion the regional rollout and adoption of standard Insights data products, partner with digital marketing and RDT to implement self-service analytics platforms, train affiliate teams, and escalate regional product gaps for global roadmap consideration.
  • Translation & Regional Customization: Translate complex, global market models, competitive assessments, and advanced analytics into locally relevant, actionable commercial insights while respecting diverse local market realities and regulatory environments.
  • Financial & Resource Governance: Influence the strategic allocation of insights resources across regional affiliates, develop regional insights budgets within the overall Insights chapter P&L, and recommend investments in local research and capability building in alignment with the Chapter Lead.
  • Cross-Functional Stakeholder Leadership: Regularly represent regional insights and market trends before DIA Divisional Leadership, Regional Customer Area Business Leads, and affiliate governance forums, resolving competing affiliate priorities and navigating complex matrix interfaces.

Who You Are


  • Education & Foundational Track Record: You hold a Bachelor's degree (Master's, MBA, or PhD preferred) in business, life sciences, economics, or a quantitative discipline, paired with at least 10 years of experience in market research, commercial insights, or business strategy, including at least 3 years in regional or matrix leadership roles.
  • Healthcare & Commercial Acumen: You bring deep industry experience within life sciences, diagnostics, medtech, or pharmaceuticals, with substantial affiliate- or country-level commercial exposure and an understanding of affiliate planning cycles (Roche Diagnostics organization knowledge preferred).
  • Regional Market & Cultural Fluency: You demonstrate comprehensive familiarity with the region competitive landscape, customer base, and regulatory context, with the adaptability to navigate diverse affiliate maturity levels, languages, and business dynamics.
  • Strategic Translation & Data Literacy: You possess strong data literacy to interpret complex analytics and digital products for senior commercial stakeholders, balancing multi-year strategic capability roadmaps with pragmatic, day-to-day operational problem-solving.
  • Executive Communication & Matrix Influence: You are an exceptional communicator in written and spoken English (with relevant regional languages preferred), skilled at managing stakeholder expectations, driving organizational change, and building cross-functional trust across global, regional, and local teams.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Back up Scan
description:
Overview

If you’d be excited to work in a field that specializes in attention to detail, all while learning about new products, consider a Back Up Scan Coordinator position at Sprouts Farmers Market. As one of the fastest growing natural foods retailers, we’re looking for team members who are detail-oriented and passionate about inspiring our customers to make healthier choices through positive shopping experiences.


Overview of Responsibilities

At Sprouts Farmers Market, the Back Up Scan Coordinator requires a significant level of accuracy and responsibility to maintain the overall price integrity in their assigned store. This position conducts daily, weekly and monthly price changes, including changing shelf signs and tags, promotional signs and ensuring compliance with all company and governmental compliance regulations. The Back Up Scan Coordinator verifies weekly ad price changes, promotional price accuracy and pricing signage in all departments. The Back Up Scan Coordinator must be able to work quickly with accuracy to support pricing integrity in our stores. If you’re someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you!


Qualifications

To be a Back Up Scan Coordinator at Sprouts Farmers Market you must:

  • Be at least 18 years of age, have a high school diploma or equivalent and 1-3 months related experience and/or training; or acceptable combination of education and experience.
  • Must have strong analytical and organizational skills in order to analyze total scanning programs, and to properly maintain necessary reports and schedules, and be able to understand and effectively use billing and accounting principles and processes.
  • Must possess excellent mathematical skills and a working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
  • Have and show an outgoing, friendly behavior with a positive attitude and the ability to interact with our customers, employees, and vendors.

The pay range for this position is $15.55 - $21.30 / hour. Sprouts Farmers Market determines pay based on applicable experience and qualifications of the applicant.

title: Master Data Management Engineer
description:
Position Title:

Master Data Management Engineer

Position Type:

Regular - Full-Time

Grade:

Grade 05

In every role, McCainers are ambitious, curious, and passionate about creating exceptional work experiences - together. With a customer-first mindset, we make doing business with McCain easy.

About The Role. McCain is seeking an MDM Technical Process Engineer, Product and Material, to support our global data governance and digital transformation priorities. In this role, you will help govern Product and Material master data within the SAP S/4HANA environment, ensuring information is accurate, standardized, compliant, and managed consistently across regions.

As a member of the Data and Platform Governance team, you will configure and support master data governance processes, workflows, validation rules, and system integrations. You will combine strong SAP Master Data Governance expertise with a working knowledge of ABAP concepts to investigate issues, improve data quality, and support the continued development of McCain’s global master data landscape.

What You’ll Be Doing.

Maintain Product and Material master data governance processes, from initial definition and implementation through ongoing execution and continuous improvement.

Configure and support SAP Master Data Governance and SimpleMDG capabilities, including data models, business rules, approval workflows, validations, and governance processes.

Implement global data governance policies, standards, frameworks, and procedures within the SAP S/4HANA environment.

Support the implementation and integration of master data management, data governance, and data quality tools with systems such as SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce, and McCain’s Enterprise Data Platform.

Monitor integrations between the MDM platform and connected systems, investigating failures and coordinating appropriate remediation.

Perform root cause analysis of master data and workflow issues and ensure that corrective actions align with established governance policies and standards.

Develop metrics, reports, audit methods, and automated validation approaches to monitor master data quality, integrity, and compliance.

Analyze ABAP programs, Business Add-Ins, user exits, custom logic, SAP tables, CDS views, and data models associated with SAP MDG processes.

Collaborate with ABAP developers and SAP technical teams to troubleshoot custom code, workflows, validation logic, derivations, and integration issues.

Conduct impact assessments for system changes, upgrades, data model changes, and SAP S/4HANA transformation activities.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful.

A bachelor’s degree in Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

At least ten years of experience in data management or data governance, including experience with data quality, data protection, or related disciplines.

Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA and SAP Master Data Governance, including configuring data models, governance processes, workflows, business rules, and validations.

Experience implementing master data management solutions across multiple organizations, business units, or technology environments.

Experience governing Product and Material master data within complex global systems.

Working knowledge of ABAP development concepts, including Business Add-Ins, enhancement frameworks, user exits, custom logic analysis, debugging, and code review.

The ability to analyze SAP tables, CDS views, data models, and custom developments that support master data processes.

Experience integrating MDM and data governance platforms with SAP S/4HANA and other enterprise systems.

Experience harmonizing systems, data, and processes across business areas, functions, or regions.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to conduct root cause analysis and assess downstream impacts of master data changes.

Experience working as part of an Agile team in a virtual and geographically distributed environment.

The ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver effectively with limited supervision in a fast-paced environment.

An SAP Master Data Governance certification, such as MDG100, would strengthen your candidacy.

Experience with Product Information Management, data catalogs, data governance platforms, and other MDM systems would be considered an asset.

Knowledge of the consumer packaged goods industry, including product hierarchies, SKU proliferation, and regulatory data requirements, would be considered an asset.

About The Team. You will join McCain’s global Data and Platform Governance team, which enables regional and global business functions to use trusted, high-quality data. The team establishes and maintains the policies, standards, processes, and technology capabilities needed to manage data consistently across McCain.

In this individual-contributor role, you will work with data owners, business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, ABAP developers, integration teams, and other technology partners. You will help connect global data governance requirements with the technical capabilities that support Product and Material master data across the organization.

40% Implement email fundraising, prospecting, and cultivation campaigns.

  • When prioritized, support the production of regularly scheduled emails including newsletters, member communications, solicitation and cultivation emails, updating and building audience segments, and creating and updated email content as required.

40% Create and update online giving forms, website landing pages and other assets required to support digital campaigns.

  • Coordinate the production of assets as required to support digital campaigns, ensuring images, copy, links, etc. are all ready in time for campaign launch.

  • Work with the team and external vendors to execute and troubleshoot digital solicitation and testing strategies, assist with production work required to support testing strategies, and report back on test results.

This is a hybrid role with most work done remotely and occasional onsite work required. Most work takes place during regular weekday business hours but may occasionally require availability outside of normal hours.

  • Writing and copy-editing skills.

  • Flexibility, proactive communication, and strong organizational skills.

Preferred (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and Attitudes):

  • Project management tools or techniques
  • Familiarity with basic graphic design, photo and video editing tools
  • Experience with report development or data analysis

title: Senior Manager, Quality
description:
Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

The Role:

The Senior Manager, Quality owns program quality end to end and leads the Quality Engineering team that supports it. You will build and lead a team of Quality Engineers across the program's process areas, owning requirements into our AS9100D quality management system, and be the single point of accountability for whether product is built to spec, on schedule, and with the objective quality evidence to prove it.

What You'll Do

• Team leadership — build, lead, and develop the Quality Engineering team supporting the project across sheet metal, welding and forming, NDT, foundry and forging, machining, and additive manufacturing.

• Staffing and coverage — close the open QE positions on the program, set priorities, and ensure every process area has quality coverage.

• Development and standards — coach QEs, set consistent standards of practice, and grow special-process competency (welding, NDT) across the team.

• Cross-functional partnership — represent quality with Build Engineering, Operations, and the program team, and serve as the escalation point for quality decisions on Nautilus.

• Program quality for Nautilus — first-article inspection (AS9102), product qualification, and quality across the build from receipt to delivery.

• Non-conformance and corrective action — control non-conforming material and customer escapes, drive root-cause and corrective action to closure, and own escape management for the program.

• Supplier and receiving quality — flow requirements to suppliers, verify certifications and OQE at receipt, and build receiving capability for controlled material.

• Audit readiness — prepare for and lead customer, and AS9100 audits for the program, and own the internal-audit posture that keeps it compliant.

• Metrics and reporting — quality KPIs, escape trends, and program quality status to leadership.

What We’re Looking For

• 8+ years in quality within defense, marine, nuclear, or aerospace manufacturing, including direct people-management of a quality team.

• Proven command of AS9100 / ISO 9001 and hands-on experience integrating customer and regulatory requirements into a QMS.

• Track record building quality processes and teams in a fast-scaling or startup manufacturing environment.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance; U.S. person under ITAR.

What Will Set You Apart

• Background at a submarine prime or shipyard (e.g., General Dynamics Electric Boat, HII Newport News) or a qualified SUBSAFE supplier.

• Knowledge of NAVSEA and SUBSAFE / Material Level I requirements (objective quality evidence, controlled material, traceability, cleanliness).

• AS9100 / ISO 9001 lead-auditor certification; familiarity with welding and NDT special-process controls (Nadcap).

• CQE, CMQ/OE, or equivalent quality certification.

• Experience standing up program quality from the ground up — writing the system, not just running it.

    401k

  • Flexible vacation policy

  • Equity

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. description:

title: Software Engineer
description:
IBM is seeking an engineer to strengthen the incident management foundation supporting Confluent Cloud. This role combines hands-on ownership of operational tools with incident data analysis, helping engineering teams respond effectively and use reliable information to improve service resilience.

About The Company

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions by building AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape business and society. Our history of innovation offers IBMers opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact around the world. Software teams work across technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver products that support digital transformation. With a culture grounded in curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning, IBM Software gives employees the opportunity to contribute to products and technologies with global reach.

About The Role

Confluent Cloud processes millions of events per second across AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Microsoft Azure. When incidents occur, the systems and processes behind response must reliably notify the right people, track each incident through resolution, and capture useful information for future analysis. As an Incident Management Tooling and Reliability Engineer, you will own and improve this operational foundation, with primary responsibility for PagerDuty and Rootly.

Approximately 75% of your time will be focused on hands-on engineering, including configuration, automation, integrations, and data quality. The remaining time will involve partnering with engineering teams and incident commanders. You will join Cloud Architecture and Reliability - Supportability, a horizontal team responsible for reliability standards and tooling across engineering. The global team uses follow-the-sun coverage and structured handoffs to support sustainable working hours.

Qualifications

Required qualifications include at least four years of experience in site reliability engineering (SRE), production operations, DevOps, or a related engineering role; practical administration experience with incident or on-call tools such as PagerDuty, Rootly, Opsgenie, or incident.io; and proficiency in Python, Go, or a comparable language for scripting and API integrations. You should also bring strong SQL and data analysis skills, experience building dashboards with tools such as Looker, Grafana, or Tableau, and hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, GCP, or Azure.

Clear written communication is essential for producing runbooks, defining metrics, and preparing reports for engineering leaders. Familiarity with incident severity frameworks, post-incident reviews, service-level objectives (SLOs), and error budgets is preferred, as is experience serving on call or as an incident commander. Experience with BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse, Kafka, or distributed systems is also an advantage.

Applicants must be authorized to work in Canada without sponsorship. The role involves technology covered by export regulations and sanctions. Foreign nationals from sanctioned countries and regions identified in the applicable regulations who are working under a permit are not eligible for this position.

Responsibilities

Own and maintain Rootly and PagerDuty configurations, including workflows, escalation policies, schedules, services, form fields, and severity definitions. Build and support integrations across Rootly, PagerDuty, Jira, Confluence, Slack, and the service catalog. Define and document consistent incident metrics, including mean time to detect (MTTD), mean time to mitigate (MTTM), mean time to resolve (MTTR), and incident volume by severity, team, and root cause.

Create dashboards and recurring reports that reveal incident trends, repeat issues, and detection gaps. Audit incident records for missing or inconsistent information, and automate corrections where practical. Support incident commanders and on-call engineers with tooling guidance, onboarding, and documentation. Develop vendor API automations that reduce manual work and improve incident response processes.

Benefits

This full-time role offers the opportunity to work with a global engineering organization, contribute to reliability practices across multiple teams, and develop expertise in cloud operations, incident management, and data analysis. IBM's learning-focused culture supports ongoing professional growth. Compensation is based on a full-time schedule; the final salary within the applicable range will depend on job-related skills and experience.

Equal Opportunity

IBM is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. Employment decisions are made without discrimination and in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. IBM values diverse perspectives and seeks to create an inclusive workplace where employees can contribute, learn, and grow.

title: Quality Compliance Engineer, SUBSAFE
description:
Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

The Role:

The SUBSAFE Compliance Engineer owns Hadrian's SUBSAFE and Material Level I (L1/SS) compliance: the processes, documentation, material controls, and audit posture that let us procure, receive, build, and deliver submarine-safety material without compromise. You will be the single point of accountability for whether Hadrian's SUBSAFE work is compliant, defensible, and audit ready.

What You'll Do

• Material Level I / SUBSAFE material control — procurement flow-down, receipt inspection, identification, segregation, storage, movement, and disposition of L1/SS material and its remnants, per NAVSEA 0924-062-0010 and applicable customer requirements.

• Objective Quality Evidence (OQE) — establish and audit the records package (chemical, mechanical, and performance test data; certifications; traceability) that proves conformance and ensure OQE is complete before material is released or delivered.

• Certification boundary integrity — define what falls inside the SUBSAFE boundary for each part, and ensures controls, documentation, and personnel qualifications are applied accordingly.

• Procedures and work instructions — author and maintain SUBSAFE / L1 procedures (material handling, cleanliness, traceability, non-conforming material, escapes), integrated with Hadrian’s AS9100D quality management system.

• Non-conformance and escapes — control non-conforming SUBSAFE material, drive root-cause and corrective action, and own the escalation path to Central Quality and the customer.

• Audit and qualification readiness — prepare for and support NAVSEA and customer audits and the activity qualification and authorization process (NAVSEAINST 4855.34), and own internal SUBSAFE audits.

• Supplier and receiving controls — flow SUBSAFE / L1 requirements to suppliers, verify certifications at receipt, and build out receiving capability to handle SUBSAFE material as volume ramps.

• Training — qualify Hadrian personnel who handle SUBSAFE material and build the workforce awareness the program depends on.

What We’re Looking For

• 5+ years in quality within a defense, marine, nuclear, or aerospace manufacturing environment, including direct SUBSAFE and/or Material Level I responsibility.

• Working command of SUBSAFE requirements and the governing NAVSEA documentation (0924-062-0010; NAVSEAINST 4855.34), OQE, controlled-material handling, traceability, and cleanliness.

• Experience building or running material-control and non-conformance processes in a regulated, audited environment.

• Ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance; U.S. person under ITAR.

What Will Set You Apart

• Background at a submarine prime or shipyard (e.g., General Dynamics Electric Boat, HII Newport News) or a qualified SUBSAFE supplier.

• AS9100 / ISO 9001 lead-auditor experience; familiarity with welding and NDT special-process controls.

• CQE, CMQ/OE, or equivalent quality certification.

• Comfort standing up a program from the ground up in a fast-moving environment — writing the procedure that does not exist yet, not just enforcing one that does.

Benefits for Full-time Employees

  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees
    401k

  • Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need.

  • Flexible vacation policy

  • Equity

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Use of AI in hiring

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy.

Consideration of Criminal History

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

Hadrian Is An Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Lead Software Engineer - Cards Servicing
description:

OneMain Financial is seeking a Lead Software Engineer to lead the technical direction and evolution of backend capabilities across Cards Servicing, spanning cardholder account management, card lifecycle operations, and integrations with core servicing platforms. Operating across teams and system boundaries, this engineer drives architectural decisions, addresses systemic challenges in reliability and data integrity, and builds reusable capabilities that enable the servicing platform to evolve without adding unnecessary complexity.


The Lead Engineer partners with Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, Product, and Architecture to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and lead engineering initiatives from design through production. Combining deep hands-on expertise with strong technical judgment, this leader drives engineering excellence, resolves complex technical challenges, establishes sound engineering practices, and mentors engineers to strengthen their technical capabilities and independently own solution design and delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Technical Leadership: Lead the design, development, testing, deployment, and operation of complex backend applications, APIs, and microservices supporting Cards Servicing.
  • Backend Engineering: Drive the development of scalable, high-performance services using Node.js, TypeScript, and REST APIs, establishing robust API contracts and integration patterns.
  • System Architecture: Own end-to-end technical design for complex initiatives, including service boundaries, data models, distributed systems, and architectural trade-offs.
  • Cloud Engineering: Architect and implement cloud-native solutions using AWS services, including EKS, Lambda, SQS, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and RDS, balancing scalability, resilience, cost, and operational efficiency.
  • Engineering Excellence: Establish and champion engineering standards across code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, security, observability, performance, and production readiness.
  • Technical Ownership: Take accountability for technical outcomes from design through production, proactively identifying risks, resolving complex dependencies, and driving sustainable solutions.
  • Cross-Team Leadership: Partner with Product, Architecture, Frontend, Platform, Data, Security, and DevOps teams to influence technical decisions, resolve cross-system challenges, and align engineering execution with business priorities.
  • Mentorship and Talent Development: Mentor engineers, lead design and code reviews, delegate meaningful technical ownership, and develop engineers capable of independently designing and delivering complex solutions.
  • Operational Excellence: Provide technical leadership in resolving critical production issues, drive root-cause analysis, and implement systemic improvements to reliability and maintainability.

title: ML Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Machines learned to understand language. We’re teaching them to understand matter.

Forty percent of global manufacturing happens through physical and chemical processes inside pipes, tanks, and reactors. Despite decades of industrial automation, much of what happens inside them remains remarkably invisible. Manufacturing is the most ubiquitous and foundational sector in global economy, yet the way factories are fundamentally run have used the same control philosophies, manual operations, and legacy software for the past 60 years.

Laminar deploys state-of-the-art patented sensors and edge hardware directly into live production environments, generating data that didn’t previously exist to build foundation models deployed in factory floors that understand chemistry, composition, quality, and material state in real time. We use that understanding to run autonomy and rethink how things are made.

The last generation of industrial automation taught machines to execute instructions reliably. The next will teach them to understand the processes they control and run autonomously, adaptively, and agentically: higher quality, safety, more efficiently, sustainably, and productively.

That future is already taking shape. Today, Laminar works with 7 of the world’s 10 largest food and beverage manufacturers and operates across hundreds of factories globally across six continents. Our systems have materially reduced waste, cut manufacturing downtime, saved water, chemicals, energy, and helped prevent safety and quality failures. Our technology has gained international recognition, from being selected as a 2026 World Economic Forum Technology Pioneer, Gold 2026 Edison Award, Unilever Startup of the Year, to Innovator Awards by both Coca-Cola and AB InBev, and more.

We are backed by tier-one investors in physical AI to make intelligent, self-improving production the new standard for industry.

Join us to build what makes matter intelligible, and the intelligible controllable.

The Role

As our company grows and scales, we are excited for a ML Infrastructure Engineer to join the team! We are looking for a thoughtful and hard-working infrastructure engineer who wants to play an integral role in bringing AI to fluid & process manufacturing. As a ML Infrastructure Engineer, you will own the development of infrastructure and tooling that helps ML researchers train, evaluate, and deploy models at scale. Your work will directly power the vertical and horizontal scalability of Laminar’s ML models across domains including (bot not limited to): CIP (clean-in-place), product changeovers, material identification, product filtration, and emerging use-cases.

You will interface with ML researchers and data engineers to build infrastructure that allows researchers to frictionlessly train models on large-scale data, evaluate them on unseen data, and deploy champion models to run on the factory floor across edge devices. Your tooling will be fundamental to making our research-to-production ML pipeline faster and more hands-free, ensuring a seamless experience for researchers. Your work will be instrumental to hyper-scaling Laminar’s solutions and deepening our competitive moat by empowering researchers to deliver state-of-the-art technological advancements.

What You Will Do

  • Develop computer orchestration tooling for researchers to seamlessly launch modeling jobs on large-scale data – training, fine-tuning, inference.
  • Design model testing environments that automatically evaluate model performance without a human in the loop through semi-supervised metrics and process-aware priors.
  • Build model registries and automated deployment pipelines that support large-scale model tracking, versioning, and deployment on edge devices.
  • Develop monitoring tools for deployed models: detect model drift or anomalies, then trigger continuous training (CT) pipelines as needed.
  • Work with ML researchers, ML developers to design systems that meet their needs; work with software engineers to design systems that interact gracefully with existing infrastructure.
  • Build for our unique use-cases and problems – not for the average problem.

About You

  • Highly experienced using cloud platforms (AWS, Databricks) to train and evaluate ML models on large-scale data.
  • Experienced using off-the-shelf tools (MLflow, wandb) for experiment tracking and model lifecycle management (versioning, artifact registry, deployment, monitoring).
  • Highly experienced with Python and relevant SDKs (boto3, databricks-sdk, mlflow); familiar with modern ML frameworks (jax, pytorch).
  • Familiar accessing data through SQL, Databricks/Apache Spark, and raw parquet formats.
  • An engineer who thrives on building easy-to-use tools that researchers love to use.
  • Highly detail-oriented: you understand the nuances in our workflows and respect the challenges that come with large-scale ML training and deployment to edge devices.
  • Open-minded and independent thinker – well-versed in building tailor-made solutions that address real pain points.
  • An executor who can both independently complete technical project objectives and provide domain expertise to guide engineering design decisions.

Preferred (if any)

  • Chemical engineering, process engineering, or manufacturing domain knowledge (highly valued).
  • Past experience working with spectral data, time-series data, or sensor data.
  • Experience building or evaluating custom ML models.
  • Experience building real products and practicing user-centric design.

Benefits

  • Direct impact on product and culture.
  • Comprehensive benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability, Transportation benefit, Health and Wellness benefit, and more.
  • 401k plan with employer matching
  • Equity
  • Competitive salary and bonus opportunities.
  • Dynamic and inclusive work environment.
  • Opportunities for growth and professional development.
  • Access to Greentown Labs' extensive network of cleantech startups.
  • Transportation benefit for your commute
  • A team that celebrates together from rooftop lunches, ping pong matches, Lunch & Learns, and regular team events

Learn How We Think

  • Learn about our startup journey: Our Journey
  • How we're combating climate change: AI-Powered Climate Tech
  • A customer story: Unilever uses Laminar precision automation to cut time & water usage
There are many easier places to work on AI. Laminar is for people who want the hardest version of their discipline. Models here must survive contact with physics. Hardware must survive years of continuous industrial operation. Software must integrate with machinery built decades ago. Everything we build ultimately has to work on a factory floor.
We believe exceptional people should be given exceptional amounts of ownership. At Laminar, you will have the context to form your own view, the permission to challenge ours, and the resources to pursue the right answers, whatever technical or organizational boundaries stand in the way. There are few layers between identifying something important and changing it.
We’re fortunate to work with a small polymathic team of hardware and software engineers, chemists, AI researchers, factory operators, and go-to-market wizards who are unusually capable, curious, rigorous, ambitious, and low-ego. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you.

Our Interview Process
1. Phone screen with Laminar HR/Recruiter (15-20 minutes)
2. Intro call with Hiring Manager (30 minutes)
3. On-site interview, overview of tech, and interview/presentation with the Hiring Manager and a few team members. Depending on the role, a skills exercise that should take no longer than an hour to prep, would be sent ahead of time. We record your skills exercise to share with any team members who could not join the interview and/or with Founder's ahead of their Founder's Interview. If you are not local, we can conduct this virtually.
4. Finalists for Full-Time positions will have a Founder’s Interview in-person
Final steps:
Two professional references are requested, ideally one from your current organization and one who served as your Manager
If an Offer Letter is extended, a Background check is conducted
Laminar is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. Even if you are unsure you are a perfect fit, we strongly encourage you to apply! If you're ready to play a key role in scaling a game-changing company that’s transforming the industrial sector and advancing sustainability, we want to hear from you.
* Please ensure you add the domain to your safe senders list to ensure you receive our communications.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About Ornn

Ornn is building the financial infrastructure for AI compute. Our price indices are live on Bloomberg Terminal. We structure and trade compute hedging instruments. And we're building products that make compute capacity easier to price, finance, reserve, and trade. We're a lean team in New York, backed by leading venture and strategic investors.

About the Role

As a Markets Engineer, you’ll be working on the research, analysis, and data science behind Ornn Data and our markets business.

This is a hands-on technical role, not a reporting job. You will write production code in our data repositories, build the datasets and models that explain what is happening in the compute market, and turn that work into indices, forward curves, research, and analysis that customers, traders, and our own team rely on.

You will sit with the markets team and work closely with engineering, the index team, and the people selling Ornn Data. On any given day that might mean tracking a new GPU cluster coming online, working out why B200 prices moved, adding a new source of offer data, or building the model behind a new analytics product.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain datasets on providers, data center capacity, hardware, offers, and executed transactions, including scrapers and integrations for new sources.

  • Develop the models behind Ornn's forward curves, payback periods, total cost of ownership, and residual value analysis.

  • Ship analysis as code: write, test, and review changes in Ornn's data repositories so research becomes a durable product rather than a one-off spreadsheet.

  • Track the market and competitive landscape, including other indices, exchanges, and new supply announcements, and flag what matters to the team quickly.

  • Help design and sanity-check index methodology, from which transactions count to how outliers and new chip types are handled.

  • Turn findings into clear charts, notes, and research that the markets, sales, and comms teams can use with customers and in public.

  • Own projects end to end, from the first question through data collection, modeling, and publication.

What We're Looking For

Requirements

  • Strong Python and SQL skills, and comfort working in a shared codebase with version control and code review.

  • Experience in data analysis, data science, quantitative research, or a similar role where your analysis informed real decisions.

  • Solid statistics, and the judgment to tell when data is noisy, biased, or incomplete.

  • Ability to take a vague question about a market and turn it into a clear, defensible answer.

  • Clear written communication, including explaining technical findings to non-technical teammates and customers.

  • Curiosity about how markets work and a real interest in AI infrastructure.

  • Ability to operate independently in a lean, fast-moving team.

Nice-to-Haves

Experience in quantitative trading, market making, commodities, energy, or financial data.

Experience building scrapers or data pipelines, or working with messy and inconsistent sources.

Knowledge of GPUs, cloud or neocloud markets, data centers, or power.

Why This Role Matters

Ornn's data is only valuable if it is right and someone can explain what it means. Markets engineers do both: they find the signal in fragmented market activity and turn it into numbers and research the market can trust.

The compute market is moving faster than any commodity market before it. New chips, new data centers, and new buyers change prices every week, and someone has to see those changes first, measure them properly, and explain them clearly.

Your work will shape the indices that futures settle against, the research customers pay for, and how the market understands the price of compute.

Compensation and Benefits

Benefits include competitive salary, meaningful equity, health coverage, free meals, and additional benefits. This is a high-ownership role with significant influence over Ornn's research agenda, data products, and how the market understands compute pricing.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Ornn is committed to building a diverse team. We evaluate candidates based on their ability to do the work, not on pedigree or background. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences.

title: Driving Jobs Watab MN
description:

Position Overview

These Driving Jobs Watab MN are built around a simple loop: report in St. Cloud, take the wheel of a company-provided Amazon DSP delivery van, and spend the day covering assigned stops that regularly reach north into Watab. Fast Track Delivery Company is an independent Amazon Delivery Service Partner (DSP). Pay is $24.00 per hour, issued weekly. Full-time drivers work a 4-day work week with shifts of about 10 hours that typically start around 11:00 AM, including one weekend day. If a shorter week of weekend work fits better, a part-time option is available on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, still at 10-hour shifts. Paid training and a local operations team come with the role.

Never held a package delivery job? That is not a problem. Instruction, equipment, and the Amazon Flex app are all provided so you can learn the work the right way.

A job hunt for Driving Jobs Watab MN, driving jobs in Saint Cloud, Amazon DSP Delivery Driver openings, Amazon DSP jobs, or package delivery jobs on the north side of St. Cloud may end here.

The first hour is always at the station in St. Cloud: vehicle prep, package organization, and a look at the map before the wheels move.

After you are loaded, the assigned drive commonly threads north through Watab and nearby St. Cloud-area streets. From the company-provided Amazon DSP delivery vehicle you will walk packages to porches, apartment entries, business docks, and other customer locations, using the Amazon Flex app to navigate and to close each stop.

Driving Jobs Watab MN are physical as well as mobile. Expect a long stretch of independent driving mixed with walking, carrying, and constant on-and-off movement. Dispatch and operations remain a call away if a stop does not go as planned.
