title: Inwonend technisch gebouwbeheerder Onderhoud & Techniek Lees verder
description:
Voor PIH Antwerpen zijn we op zoek naar een inwonend technisch gebouwbeheerder. In deze veelzijdige functie zorg je mee voor het dagelijkse beheer van de site.

Je bent een echte duizendpoot: je voert kleine herstellingen uit, houdt toezicht op veiligheid en orde, ontvangt leveranciers en techniekers en bent een aanspreekpunt voor medewerkers en bezoekers.

Met jouw praktische ingesteldheid en verantwoordelijkheidszin draag je mee bij aan een veilige, nette en goed functionerende omgeving.

Wie zijn wij?

Je komt terecht bij het Departement Leefmilieu – APB Provinciaal Instituut voor Hygiëne (PIH). Het PIH voert analyses, metingen en onderzoek uit rond milieu, gezondheid en hygiëne. Met een team van deskundige collega’s werken we dagelijks aan betrouwbare resultaten en kwaliteitsvol advies.

Als inwonend technisch gebouwbeheerder zorg je mee voor een veilige, nette en aangename omgeving waarin onze medewerkers hun werk kunnen doen. Je oefent deze functie uit samen met een andere inwonend technisch gebouwbeheerder, zodat jullie samen instaan voor het dagelijkse beheer en de goede werking van de site. Het gebouw waarvoor je als gebouwbeheerder zal werken omhelst naast het PIH ook een secundaire school met eigen technische dienst en de Vlaamse Milieumaatschappij waarvoor je ook enkele technische taken zal uitvoeren.

Wat zal je doen?

Als inwonend technisch gebouwbeheerder ben je een belangrijke schakel in het dagelijkse beheer van de site. Je zorgt ervoor dat het gebouw en de omgeving veilig, netjes en goed functionerend blijven. Je combineert technische en praktische taken met toezicht, opvolging en het helpen van medewerkers, bezoekers en leveranciers buiten de reguliere openingsuren.

Je bent een praktisch aanspreekpunt en vertrouwd gezicht op de site. Je merkt problemen snel op, steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen en zoekt zelfstandig naar oplossingen. Waar nodig volg je technische interventies of externe werken verder op.

Technisch en praktisch beheer

  • Kleine herstellingen uitvoeren aan het gebouw en de installaties.
  • Technische defecten tijdig signaleren, melden en opvolgen.
  • Controleren of installaties en ruimtes veilig en in goede staat zijn.
  • Externe firma’s en techniekers ontvangen en begeleiden bij onderhoud of werken.
  • Instaan voor allerlei praktische klusjes en kleine herstellingen.

Dagelijks beheer en toezicht

  • Je maakt elke avond een controleronde door het gebouw.
  • Een oogje in het zeil houden op orde, netheid en veiligheid.
  • Sleutels, lokalen en toegangen beheren.
  • Leveranciers, techniekers en bezoekers ontvangen en verder helpen.
  • Een aanspreekpunt zijn voor medewerkers bij praktische of technische vragen.
  • Problemen die je niet zelf kunt oplossen, correct doorgeven en verder opvolgen.

Als inwonend technisch gebouwbeheerder is je job tweeledig. Gemiddeld zal je 50% van je tijd bezig zijn met het technisch en praktisch beheer en 50% met het dagelijks beheer en toezicht. Afhankelijk van de permanentieregeling zit hier wekelijks variatie op.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die graag de handen uit de mouwen steekt en zich verantwoordelijk voelt voor zijn/haar omgeving.

Je:

  • bent praktisch ingesteld en technisch aangelegd;
  • bent handig en houdt ervan om problemen op te lossen;
  • kunt zelfstandig werken, maar bent ook een collegiale teamspeler;
  • hebt oog voor veiligheid, orde en netheid;
  • neemt verantwoordelijkheid en ziet werk liggen;
  • bent betrouwbaar en discreet;
  • blijft rustig wanneer er onverwachte situaties of problemen ontstaan;
  • bent flexibel en denkt graag mee over oplossingen;
  • gaat respectvol en behulpzaam om met medewerkers, bezoekers en leveranciers.
  • communiceert helder naar zowel je collega’s, bezoekers als partners.

Ervaring met en kennis van gebouwbeheer, onderhoud, elektriciteit, sanitair, verwarming of andere technische installaties is uiteraard een pluspunt.

Tenslotte:

  • Je hebt een diploma secundair onderwijs of je hebt minimum 1 jaar ervaring en je bent geslaagd voor de capaciteitsproef op secundair niveau.
  • Je bent lichamelijk geschikt en in goede gezondheid (Je wordt bij indiensttreding onderworpen aan een medisch onderzoek bij een externe geneeskundige dienst.)

Samen met je collega inwonend technisch gebouwbeheerder zal je doorheen het jaar de conciërge taken in een beurtrol opnemen (week om week). Tijdens de vakantieperiode organiseren jullie dit in onderling overleg.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Het PIH gevestigd in hartje Antwerpen. We plannen te verhuizen naar ons nieuwe gebouw vanaf begin 2029. Momenteel zijn we op zoek naar een inwonend technicus/ gebouwbeheerder met een voltijdse contractuele arbeidsovereenkomst tot aan de verhuis naar onze nieuwe locatie.

Je start in salarisschaal C1: het bruto maandsalaris ligt tussen de 2.493,20 euro en 4.563,20 euro. Bij je aanwerving gaan we na hoeveel jaar ervaring je in eerdere functies hebt opgebouwd. Die ervaring wordt meegenomen in de berekening van je brutosalaris. Bekijk onze loonsimulator om een gedetailleerde inschatting te maken van je bruto- en netto maandsalaris.

Bijkomende vergoedingen

  • Gepresteerde uren op weekdagen na 22u en voor 6u worden in overloon (+25%) en aan nachtvergoeding (+25%) vergoed.
  • Gepresteerde uren op zaterdagen worden in overloon (25%) en met een zaterdagvergoeding (25%) vergoed. Na 22u en voor 6u is een nachtvergoeding (25%) van toepassing.
  • Gepresteerde uren op zondagen of feestdagen worden met een zondagvergoeding (100%) vergoed. Na 22u en voor 6u is een nachtvergoeding (25%) van toepassing.

Met extralegale voordelen:

  • 36 vakantiedagen per jaar en flexibele werktijden.
  • Een hospitalisatieverzekering voor jou en voordelige aansluitmogelijkheden voor je gezin
  • Een aanvullende ziekteverzekering
  • Laptop en smartphone met abonnement
  • Maaltijdcheques van € 8 per gewerkte dag
  • Gratis openbaar vervoer van en naar het werk, of fietsvergoeding en de optie voor een leasefiets
  • Afwisselend opleidingsaanbod
  • Een tweede pensioenpijler (extralegaal pensioen)
  • Vakantiegeld en eindejaarstoelage
  • Toegang tot kortingen op evenementen, cultuur, pretparken en meer via onze personeelsvereniging.

Huurwoning:

  • Je huurt een appartement (113 m² + kelderruimte van 30 m²), in hartje Antwerpen gelegen in de Kronenburgstraat 45, 2000 Antwerpen.
  • Het appartement bestaat uit:
    • een leefruimte (65 m²) met een zithoek, bureau, eetplaats, open keuken (excl. toestellen) en gang.
    • een badkamer (11 m²) met douche, bad en lavabomeubel.
    • 2 slaapkamers (13m² + 16m²).
    • apart toilet en berging.
  • De huurprijs van de woning is inkomensafhankelijk en bedraagt maximaal 30% van je netto-inkomen bij voltijdse tewerkstelling, met een bovengrens van € 880 per maand.

Hoe verloopt jouw sollicitatie?

  • Solliciteer ten laatste zondag 6 december 2026. De selectieprocedure verloopt in het Nederlands. Overtuig ons met een krachtige motivatiebrief en cv in het Nederlands waarom deze job jou op het lijf geschreven is.
  • Cv-screening, waar op basis van motivatie, relevante ervaring en affiniteit met het functieprofiel maximaal 10 kandidaten naar het volgende selectieonderdeel doorgaan.
  • Online persoonlijkheidsvragenlijst en online integriteitstest (adviserend en niet eliminerend).
  • Opdracht ter plaatse en een competentiegericht interview: maandag 14 december 2026 in het PIH. Houd deze datum alvast vrij in je agenda.
  • Rondleiding door het gebouw en het appartement op de dag van het interview.
  • Meer informatie over deze onderdelen kan je hier lezen.

Praktisch

  • Je zal werken in het Provinciaal Instituut voor Hygiëne (Kronenburgstraat 45, 2000 Antwerpen), vlot bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer.
  • Voor meer info over de inhoud van de functie kan je terecht bij Steve Berghmans (03 259 12 09 of steve.berghmans@provincieantwerpen.be).
  • Voor meer info over de selectieprocedure, de verloning en de extralegale voordelen kan je terecht bij Marie Leestmans, HR-medewerker via (marie.leestmans@provincieantwerpen.be).

title: Lead Database Platform Engineer
description:
CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi-trillion-dollar insurance economy, creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we’re making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We’re pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at .


The Role

CCC Intelligent Solutions is seeking a highly skilled Lead Database Platform Engineer to drive the strategy, architecture, reliability, and modernization of our enterprise database ecosystem. This role will serve as the technical leader for a team of database engineers responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting mission-critical data platforms that power our products and business operations.

The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on expertise with technical leadership, helping shape the future of CCC's database technologies across cloud and hybrid environments. This position is based in the Chicago area with a hybrid work model.

As a key member of the infrastructure and platform organization, you will partner closely with Engineering, SRE, DevOps, Architecture, and Product Development teams to ensure our database platforms are secure, highly available, scalable, and operationally efficient. The role also participates in a 24x7 operational support model, including incident response, change management, disaster recovery planning, and platform modernization initiatives.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the technical leader and subject matter expert for CCC's database platform strategy and roadmap.
  • Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise-scale database solutions across SQL Server and cloud-native database technologies.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and leadership to a team of database engineers and offshore resources.
  • Partner with Product Development, Architecture, SRE, and DevOps teams to design highly available and scalable database solutions.
  • Drive automation initiatives that improve deployment, monitoring, performance tuning, database provisioning, and operational support.
  • Champion the use of AI and intelligent automation to increase team productivity and reduce manual operational tasks.
  • Lead major platform initiatives including database upgrades, migrations, cloud transformations, and performance optimization efforts.
  • Establish best practices for database administration, operational excellence, security, compliance, and resiliency.
  • Collaborate with vendors and technology partners to evaluate solutions and support strategic platform decisions.
  • Participate in incident management, root cause analysis, problem management, and service restoration activities.
  • Develop and maintain operational documentation, architecture standards, support procedures, and disaster recovery plans.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce platform complexity, improve reliability, and increase operational agility across the database ecosystem.
  • Balance strategic initiatives, platform engineering, and operational excellence to ensure continuous delivery of database services.


Requirements:

Leadership & Technical Expertise

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 8+ years of experience supporting enterprise-scale, mission-critical database environments.
  • Proven experience leading technical teams and mentoring engineers in complex operational environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction and drive cross-functional initiatives.
  • Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts to a variety of audiences.
  • Experience leading complex infrastructure, cloud, or database modernization initiatives.
  • Experience managing database upgrades, patching strategies, and platform lifecycle management.
  • Experience supporting audit, compliance, and security controls, including SOC-related requirements.
  • Strong knowledge of disaster recovery planning, business continuity, and high-availability architectures.

Database & Cloud Technologies

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience administering and optimizing Microsoft SQL Server environments.
  • 5+ years of experience with cloud-hosted database technologies including AWS Aurora, AWS RDS, Azure SQL PaaS, and Azure Hyperscale.
  • 5+ years of experience supporting workloads in AWS and/or Microsoft Azure.
  • Deep expertise managing large-scale OLTP environments with demanding performance and availability requirements.
  • Experience monitoring, maintaining, and optimizing hundreds of database instances in enterprise environments.
  • Experience with database performance tuning, capacity planning, indexing strategies, and operational monitoring.
  • Familiarity with automation, Infrastructure as Code, observability platforms, and DevOps practices.
  • Experience partnering with SRE and platform engineering teams to improve reliability and operational efficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cloud database modernization and migration programs.
  • Experience leveraging AI-powered tools to automate database administration and operational workflows.
  • Knowledge of modern observability, monitoring, and database performance management platforms.
  • Experience building self-service database platforms and platform engineering capabilities.
  • Industry certifications in Microsoft Azure, AWS, SQL Server, or related cloud technologies.



Interview Policy & Privacy Notice:

A video interview is required for this position. Video interviews are transcribed. Transcriptions are retained and may be reviewed by CCC and our recruiters. Candidates are not permitted to use generative AI or automated assistance during the interviews unless explicitly allowed by the interview team for a specific exercise. Our Job Applicant Privacy Notice is available HERE.


About CCC's Commitment to Employees:

CCC Intelligent Solutions understands that our employees play an integral role in our vision to shape a world where life just works. Our team is defined by our values of Integrity, Customer-Focus, Innovation, Inclusion & Diversity, Tenacity, and Connection. Through diverse perspectives, purposeful innovation, and the strength of connections, our technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most.

At CCC, together everyone can thrive as we innovate and collaborate, creating employee experiences that just work. We are committed to providing opportunities for our people to make real-life impacts, advance in their careers, and contribute to CCC’s success.

title: Building Steward
description:
Job Title: Building Steward
FLSA Status: Part-Time (20-25 hours anticipated)
Reports to: Fleet and Facilities Logistics Manager
Work Location: Marion Barry Avenue Market, 1303 Marion Barry Avenue SE, Washington, DC 20020
Compensation: $22.37 - $23.73 per hour

Dreaming Out Loud, Inc.

Dreaming Out Loud’s mission is to create economic opportunities for the DC metro region’s marginalized communities through building a healthy, equitable food system. We are rebuilding urban, community-based food systems through cooperative social enterprise: increasing access to healthy food, improving community health, supporting entrepreneurs and cooperatives from low-income communities, and creating opportunities for at-risk residents to earn sustainable, family-supporting wages and build wealth. We believe that all communities deserve equal access to fresh, healthy food choices, but that achieving this requires moving beyond the “access” paradigm to a focus on community self-determination and food sovereignty. Utilizing the food system as a catalyst, we are working to create an integrated pipeline to jobs, economic opportunity, and community wealth-building for our most marginalized communities.

Position Summary

The Building Steward contributes to the overall aesthetic, cleanliness, and efficiency of the Food Hub by ensuring all spaces, especially our kitchen, preparation, and dining areas, are consistently clean, sanitized, and ready for use. This role is ideal for someone who takes pride in maintaining a high standard of cleanliness in food-handling environments.

Key Responsibilities

General Cleaning & Dusting
  • Dust all rooms, furniture, and surfaces.
  • Clean and polish metal fixtures, light fixtures, table surfaces, counters, shelves, office equipment, and door handles.
  • Wash windows and dust windowsills.
  • Wipe down and clean the walls.
Floor Care
  • Vacuum carpets and rugs.
  • Mop all hard floors throughout the building, with extra attention to kitchen, preparation, and dining spaces.
  • Sweep and clean the patio area; wipe down patio furniture.
  • Sweep the front walkway and parking area.
Kitchen & Food-Prep Area Cleaning
  • Wash dishes, utensils, and small equipment to food-safe standards.
  • Wipe down, sanitize, and maintain kitchen countertops, prep tables, sinks, and shelving.
  • Regularly clean and sanitize high-touch and high-use areas in the kitchen, including appliance exteriors (e.g., refrigerators, ovens, microwaves).
  • Ensure all kitchen cleaning is done in accordance with health and safety standards.
Waste Management & Recycling
  • Empty waste baskets and transport trash to the dumpster.
  • Collect and properly handle recyclable materials.
Restroom Maintenance
  • Clean, sanitize, and restock restrooms.
  • Scrub toilets and toilet seats.
  • Wipe down and sanitize sinks and the exterior of toilets.
  • Clean all fixtures, including paper towel and toilet paper dispensers.
  • Ensure toilet paper, paper towels, and soap are fully stocked.
Laundry & Building Support
  • Transport laundry, run wash and dry cycles, and fold laundry as needed.
  • Assist with inventory control.
  • Move furniture, equipment, and supplies as needed.
  • Clean and shovel patios, walkways, parking areas, and entryways as needed.
  • Clean exterior HVAC vents.
  • Attend departmental staff meetings and essential safety and security training.
Security & Reporting
  • Follow all security protocols and immediately report potential security weaknesses.
  • Report any damage, burned-out light bulbs, or plumbing problems.
  • Lock and unlock the building as required, ensuring it’s secure when unoccupied.
  • Check for unlocked doors and turn off all lights before leaving an unoccupied building.
The duties and responsibilities contained herein are representative of the essential functions of this position. The dynamic nature of our work requires flexibility and our collaborative environment necessitates cross-functional support. Employees are expected to adapt to our ever-evolving organizational and community needs and perform other duties as assigned to contribute to Dreaming Out Loud’s success.

Required Skills and Experience
  • Minimum of 1 year of relevant experience in janitorial/custodial or environmental services, with hands-on kitchen or food-prep area cleaning preferred.
  • Comfort and experience working and communicating with people from various backgrounds.
  • Independent, hardworking, and dependable.
  • Experience engaging in successful teamwork.
  • Ability to work in various weather conditions.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to perform physically strenuous work including lifting, pushing, pulling, reaching, bending, stooping, and utilizing ladders and step stools.
  • Ability to stand for 4 or more hours.
  • Ability to wear a mask, gloves, and other protective wear for 4 or more hours.
  • Hepatitis B vaccination required due to the high risk of exposure to biological material (cost covered by Dreaming Out Loud).
  • Ability to work evenings and weekends.
Benefits
  • Monthly Cell Phone Stipend
  • Transit Assistance through SmartBenefits
Equal Employment Opportunity

Dreaming Out Loud Inc. provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Dreaming Out Loud complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the organization has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, and transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

India

title: Senior Backend Engineer, NIRA

What you’ll bring to Circle


Core Requirements

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, or compliance, including meaningful experience with third party or vendor security assessments.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex security assessments and evaluate control effectiveness beyond questionnaire or compliance-based reviews.
  • Technical depth across areas such as cloud security, API security, network architecture, identity and access management, and cryptography.
  • Hands-on experience using AI, GenAI, automation, or internally developed tooling to improve security, risk, or compliance workflows.
  • Experience modernizing security, risk, or compliance programs through automation, improved methodologies, or process redesign.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience in financial services, fintech, digital assets, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Familiarity with third party risk and security frameworks or standards such as DORA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or relevant regulatory guidance.
  • Familiarity with blockchain and digital asset technologies, including crypto-native vendors, wallets, smart contracts, or decentralized infrastructure.

Position Summary

The Senior Specialist, International Tax will support the Company's global tax function, with primary responsibility for international tax compliance, transfer pricing, VAT/GST compliance, tax accounting, and cross-border business initiatives. This role will partner closely with Finance, Accounting, Customs & Trade, Supply Chain, Procurement, Treasury, and Legal teams to ensure compliance with global tax regulations while supporting the Company's international growth strategy.

The ideal candidate possesses a strong foundation in international taxation, transfer pricing, and indirect taxes, along with the analytical, communication, and project management skills necessary to succeed in a dynamic multinational environment.

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

International Tax Compliance:

  • Support U.S. international tax compliance, including preparation of information returns and supporting workpapers.
  • Coordinate international tax compliance activities for foreign subsidiaries with external advisors and service providers.
  • Analyze foreign tax credits, withholding taxes, and other international tax attributes.
  • Support tax reporting related to global operations and cross-border transactions.
  • Monitor international tax law developments and evaluate potential impacts on the business.

Transfer Pricing:

  • Prepare and maintain transfer pricing documentation and supporting analyses.
  • Support intercompany pricing reviews and benchmarking studies.
  • Review intercompany transactions to ensure alignment with transfer pricing policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with Finance and Accounting teams to support implementation of transfer pricing arrangements.
  • Assist with transfer pricing audits, documentation requests, and tax authority inquiries.

VAT and Indirect Tax Compliance:

  • Coordinate VAT, GST, and other indirect tax compliance activities across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Prepare, review, and support the filing of VAT and indirect tax returns.
  • Identify VAT recovery opportunities and manage foreign VAT refund claims.
  • Support indirect tax registrations and ongoing compliance obligations.
  • Review procurement, supply chain, and commercial transactions for indirect tax implications.
  • Maintain indirect tax documentation, records, and supporting schedules.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable, Procurement, and Logistics teams to ensure proper indirect tax treatment of transactions.
  • Assist with VAT audits and tax authority examinations.

Customs and Cross-Border Tax Support:

  • Collaborate with Customs & Trade teams on tax and customs issues affecting import and export operations.
  • Support customs valuation, import VAT, and duty-related analyses.
  • Review supply chain structures and cross-border transaction flows for tax and customs considerations.
  • Research tax implications of contract manufacturing, distribution, and supply chain arrangements.

International Tax Planning:

  • Support tax planning initiatives related to legal entity structures, supply chain design, and global expansion projects.
  • Analyze tax implications of new business models and operational changes.
  • Assist with legal entity restructuring and intercompany transaction planning.
  • Support implementation of tax-efficient operating models.
  • Conduct technical tax research and prepare memoranda on international tax matters.

Tax Accounting:

  • Support income tax accounting under ASC 740 and IFRS (IAS 12), including current and deferred tax calculations.
  • Assist with quarterly and annual tax provision processes and related reporting requirements.
  • Prepare tax account reconciliations and deferred tax analyses.
  • Support tax-related financial statement disclosures and audit requests.
  • Maintain documentation supporting tax accounting positions, controls, and compliance requirements.

What you’ll bring

You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, or related field.
  • Master's degree in Taxation preferred.

Certifications:

  • CPA preferred.
  • Additional international tax, transfer pricing, or indirect tax certifications are a plus.

Experience:

  • 8+ years of experience in international taxation, corporate taxation, public accounting, or a combination thereof.
  • Experience with transfer pricing and cross-border transactions.
  • Experience with VAT, GST, and foreign indirect tax compliance.
  • Experience supporting multinational business operations.
  • Experience with ASC 740 and IFRS (IAS 12) tax accounting.
  • Manufacturing, automotive, or industrial industry experience preferred.

Technical Skills:

  • Strong knowledge of U.S. international tax concepts and reporting requirements.
  • Understanding of transfer pricing principles and OECD guidelines.
  • Familiarity with VAT, GST, and foreign indirect tax regimes.
  • Knowledge of withholding taxes, tax treaties, and permanent establishment concepts.
  • Experience with ASC 740 and IFRS (IAS 12) income tax accounting.
  • Experience with tax provision software and ERP systems such as SAP.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Strong tax research, analytical, and financial reporting capabilities.

Competencies:

  • Strong organization and project management skills.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. title: Delivery Jobs Le Sauk Township MN
description:
Delivery Jobs Le Sauk Township MN – Fast Track Delivery Company

Pay: Starting at $24.00 per hour

Position Overview

Northwest of St. Cloud, Le Sauk Township sits along routes Fast Track Delivery Company runs from the station every week. We are an independent Amazon Delivery Service Partner (DSP) with Delivery Jobs Le Sauk Township MN for drivers who will take Amazon packages to homes, apartments, businesses, and other customer sites in Le Sauk Township and across the greater St. Cloud, Minnesota area.

The report point does not change: you start in St. Cloud, in person, then take the Amazon DSP delivery vehicle we provide on an assigned course that often turns northwest into Le Sauk Township. Starting pay is $24.00 per hour, paid weekly. Full-time delivery work follows a 4-day work week of about 10-hour shifts that generally begin around 11:00 AM, with one weekend day required. A weekend part-time option is available on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday at the same 10-hour length. Paid training is included, and a local operations desk stays with you after you leave.

Nothing in the hiring process demands a prior last-mile job. We walk new drivers through the tools, the van, and the Amazon Flex app so a township-and-city route is actually runnable on day one.

Readers comparing Delivery Jobs Le Sauk Township MN with driving jobs in Saint Cloud, Amazon DSP Delivery Driver listings, Amazon DSP jobs, or package delivery jobs on the northwest side of St. Cloud will find the work, the pay, and the towns named here.

What You’ll Do

Le Sauk Township routes still begin under the station roof in St. Cloud. Vehicles are prepped, packages are grouped, and the northwest-bound plan is reviewed before departure.

Once you are rolling, Delivery Jobs Le Sauk Township MN commonly thread Le Sauk Township roads together with nearby St. Cloud-area stops. Packages leave the company Amazon DSP van at driveway ends, apartment entries, small business doors, and other customer locations. The Amazon Flex app is what you use for navigation and package delivery.

The stretch between the first stop and the last is independent work. You will walk, carry, and climb in and out of the vehicle often, with dispatch and operations available if a township address or a routing change needs a second look.

Someone pursuing an Amazon DSP Delivery Driver role that serves Le Sauk Township and St. Cloud should expect a full day of driving, outdoor movement, and backup from a team that already knows this northwestern edge of the metro.

Responsibilities

  • Hold a safe standard with the Amazon DSP delivery vehicle the company provides, including on quieter township roads.
  • Get Amazon packages to customers in Le Sauk Township, in St. Cloud, and in the communities that sit between them.
  • Group, load, and arrange freight at the St. Cloud station so the northwest-bound route can leave in good order.
  • Use the Amazon Flex app, with GPS navigation, to identify each stop and to mark it complete.
  • Stay inside traffic laws, safety expectations, and company procedures wherever the route goes.
  • Do the required vehicle walk-around before you depart and after you return.
  • Lift and carry items of up to 50 pounds from the van to the stop.
  • Step in and out of the vehicle repeatedly as you work Le Sauk Township-area deliveries.
  • Handle packages carefully and complete each drop-off accurately.
  • Give customers friendly, professional attention.
  • Keep dispatch updated while you work the Le Sauk Township and St. Cloud route.
  • Bring operations in when a stop or a routing question needs extra help.

Build and experiment

Data and measurement

Lead

  • Scope, design and oversee technical projects from start to finish.

  • Lead and mentor a team of thoughtful, fast-moving engineers through rigorous design and code reviews.

  • Set standards for developer workflows, including how the team uses AI coding tools effectively and safely: when to lean on them, how to review AI-generated code and how to keep quality high while moving faster.

  • Make sound build vs. buy decisions, including third-party and AI-powered tools.

  • Help hire and grow the team.

Our stack: C#, .NET, SQL, MongoDB, ElasticSearch, React and AWS (including SQS).

Analytics and engagement tools: Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Segment, Amplitude, Intercom, Appcues and Datadog.

What You Bring

Before you read this next section, we want you to know that we know the "ideal candidate" doesn't exist. Everybody has a unique background and skill set. Even if you don't check every box below, we'd love for you to apply. We are building for the future and growth potential is a priority for us!

  • Hands-on, daily use of AI-assisted development tools (such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot), and a clear point of view on how to use them well on a team.

How you lead

  • You create clarity from ambiguity and mentor developers through rigorous design and code reviews.

  • You help engineers get real value from AI tools, coaching them on good habits instead of just handing them a license.

Nice to have

🎉 Collaborative and social team culture – work in a supportive environment with regular team events and company-wide celebrations that keep things fun and connected

description:

Job Description:

Role Summary

We are seeking a Senior CPU Design Verification Engineer to own block‑ and subsystem‑level DV for advanced out‑of‑order (OoO) CPU cores. You will work closely with micro‑architects and RTL designers to verify complex Front end Designs includes branch prediction, Instruction decodes, execution pipelines, memory systems, and coherence protocols using modern, coverage‑driven methodologies.

Key Responsibilities

Verification Planning & Ownership

    • Drive verification for key OoO CPU blocks, such as:

    • Front‑end: fetch, branch prediction, decode.

    • Rename and register mapping.

    • Issue queues / schedulers and execution units.

    • Reorder buffer (ROB), retirement, exceptions, and flush/replay.

    • Load‑store unit (LSU), store buffer, atomics/LR‑SC, fences.

    • L1 caches, TLBs, MMU interfaces, and coherence interfaces.

    • Derive verification plans from architecture and micro‑architecture specs, with emphasis on:

    • Speculative execution flows and pipeline hazards.

    • Memory ordering / consistency model compliance.

    • Interaction with cache hierarchy and coherence.

Testbench & Environment Development

    • Develop and maintain SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches:

    • UVM agents, monitors, scoreboards, reference models.

    • Constrained‑random stimulus and directed tests for OoO corner cases.

    • Implement self‑checking mechanisms for:

    • Instruction retirement and architectural state.

    • LSU / memory ordering, atomics, and fence behavior.

    • TLB, page‑table, and privilege/protection flows as needed.

Coverage & Quality

  • Define and track functional, code, and assertion coverage; identify gaps and add tests/monitors to close them.

    • Create and maintain assertions (SVA) for key micro‑architectural properties:

    • No deadlock/livelock in scheduler, ROB, LSQ.

    • Correct handling of mispredicts, exceptions, interrupts, and flush paths.

    • Correct data forwarding and hazard resolution in the pipeline.

  • Analyze regression results, triage failures, and drive issues to closure with design and architecture teams.

Debug & Collaboration

    • Debug complex failures in:

    • Speculation / replay (e.g., wrong‑path side‑effects, partial flushes).

    • Load‑store ordering and memory consistency violations.

    • TLB / MMU corner cases and privilege/protection issues.

    • Collaborate with:

    • Micro‑architecture & RTL on fixes and design clarifications.

    • Performance / modeling teams to align micro‑architectural behavior and verification scenarios.

    • Post‑silicon / validation teams to correlate pre‑ and post‑silicon issues.

Methodology & Mentoring

  • Contribute to DV methodology improvements (UVM components, coverage strategies, regression flows).

  • Provide guidance and code reviews to junior engineers on testbench design, stimulus generation, and debug.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.

    • Experience:

    • Typically 5–10 years of ASIC/SoC/IP design verification experience.

    • Direct experience verifying out‑of‑order or superscalar CPU cores (or closely related high‑performance pipelines).

    • Technical Skills:

    • Strong proficiency in System Verilog and UVM (or equivalent class‑based DV methodology).

      • Solid understanding of CPU micro‑architecture, including:

      • Fetch/decode, rename, ROB, issue/execute, bypassing, commit.

      • LSU, store buffer, atomics/LR‑SC, fences, and memory ordering.

      • L1 caches, TLBs, page‑table walkers, and basic coherence concepts.

      • Hands‑on experience with:

      • Constrained‑random and coverage‑driven verification.

      • Writing and debugging SVA assertions.

      • Industry‑standard simulators (e.g., VCS, Xcelium, Questa) and debug tools (e.g., Verdi/DVE).

    • Soft Skills:

    • Strong problem‑solving and debug skills on complex, corner‑case bugs.

    • Effective communication and teamwork across DV, design, and architecture.

    • Ability to work independently on complex blocks while contributing to a larger project.

Additional Information:

This position requires a successful background and reference checks and satisfactory proof of your right to work in:

India

Any offer of employment for this position is also contingent on the Company verifying that you are a authorized for access to export-controlled technology under applicable export control laws or, if you are not already authorized, our ability to successfully obtain any necessary export license(s) or other approvals.

title: Bioprocess Technician (Production & Operations)
description:
About us

Primogene is an innovative biotech company developing advanced bioprocesses for the production of functional ingredients. We support human health through all stages of life and across industries including nutrition, pharma, and personal care.

About the role

As a Bioprocess Technician (Production & Operations) you will support our day-to-day production and bioprocessing activities. You will work hands-on with our team across different production steps, from preparing and running bioprocesses to filtration, spray drying and logistics to keeping materials, samples and shipments moving.

This is a practical, hands-on position for someone who enjoys working with equipment and being directly involved in production.

Key responsibilities

- Prepare and operate bioprocess and production equipment.
- Support the set up, running and monitoring of bioprocesses (enzymatic reactions, fermentation/bioreactor runs) according to batch records and SOPs.
- Carry out downstream processing steps, in particular filtration and drying processes.
- Prepare buffers, media and raw materials.
- Support filling, packaging, labeling, and storage of finished products.
- Clean, assemble and maintain production equipment.
- Take in-process samples and perform basic analytics.
- Document all activities accurately and in line with good manufacturing practice guidelines/quality requirements (batch records, logbooks, deviations)
- Support scientists and engineers in process development, scale-up and tech-transfer projects
- Support inventory management, material handling, shipping, receiving, and general production logistics.

Qualifications

You should bring

- Completed vocational training as a laboratory or production technician (BTA, CTA, Chemikant, Pharmakant, Fachkraft für Lebensmitteltechnik), a degree in biotechnology, bioprocess engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant practical experience.
- Proven hands-on work experience in a production, pilot plant, or bioprocess laboratory environment is required.
- Hands-on mentality and willingness to support wherever needed
- Ability to work carefully, reliably, and according to written procedures
- Experience with filtration and/or spray drying is a strong plus
- Familiarity with working under GMP or other quality standards (ISO, HACCP) is an advantage
- A structured way of working and reliable documentation
- Good communication skills in English, German is a plus

What we offer

- A hands-on position in a fast-growing biotechnology startup
- The opportunity to work with innovative bioprocessing technologies and contribute directly to real production activities
- A diverse role with exposure to multiple technologies, processes, and equipment

- A friendly, supportive, and entrepreneurial team with an open and collaborative working culture
- Amazing team and colleagues

title: Product Manager
description:
About the job

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our small, hands-on Product team and take ownership of a major area of the IONIX platform.

IONIX is growing fast, and so is our product – driven by AI and agentic capabilities that change how security teams find and fix exposures. You will own your area end-to-end: from spotting the opportunity, through defining and shipping it, to making it a commercial success with customers. The exact focus will be shaped together with you, based on your strengths and where the business needs you most.

This role is ideal for an experienced cybersecurity PM who loves going deep with engineers and security researchers, is just as comfortable in front of customers and prospects, and brings the customer, market, and competitive perspective into every product decision.

About IONIX

IONIX is the leader in External Exposure Management (EASM). We protect enterprises from the next wave of mass-scale, AI-driven attacks by building the first self-healing attack surface: we continuously find what's exposed, confirm what's exploitable, and fix it automatically - before an attacker gets there.

We're a fast-moving, dynamic startup, and our team is growing alongside our customer base. Global leaders including BlackRock, Warner Music Group, Infosys, Sompo, The Telegraph and E.ON trust IONIX to protect their complex, ever-changing attack surfaces.

Responsibilities

  • Own your product area end-to-end – strategy, roadmap, prioritization, execution, and measurable business results.
  • Be a product leader in the field – meet customers and prospects, present vision and roadmap, support key sales opportunities and proofs of value, and bring what you learn into every product discussion.
  • Lead product discovery – user and stakeholder interviews, competitive research, data analysis, and fast validation with prototypes before committing engineering effort.
  • Shape AI-driven and agentic capabilities – define how autonomous agents should behave, how their output is validated and trusted, and how customers operate them day-to-day.
  • Make evidence-based decisions – define success metrics, track adoption and impact, and iterate based on what the data and customers tell you.
  • Turn direction into clear, testable requirements – work daily with Engineering, Design, Security Research, and Data to scope, prioritize, and deliver, with sharp definitions of done.
  • Own the launch, not just the build – partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success on positioning, packaging, pricing, enablement, and documentation.
  • Keep teams moving – make timely, well-reasoned decisions on incoming requests from Sales, Customer Success, Support, and Engineering.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management – in B2B SaaS, owning product areas or major capabilities from discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Rich technical cybersecurity expertise – gained in a cybersecurity company, with a strong understanding of security products, security practitioners' workflows, and the competitive landscape.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI – building agentic systems or products, or operating AI agents in real-world workflows.
  • Outbound and go-to-market experience – customer and prospect meetings, demos, and supporting sales opportunities, with a solid understanding of how an enterprise B2B sales process works, including proofs of value.
  • Proven product discovery skills – customer interviews and other qualitative and quantitative methods to validate problems and guide roadmap decisions.
  • Strong technical depth – comfortable going deep with engineers and researchers on how things actually work, and hands-on with data and analysis.
  • Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal) – clear product documentation, and confident presentations to customers and executives.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership – across Engineering, Research, Design, Sales, and Customer Success.
  • Advantages: domain expertise in vulnerability management, vulnerability research, exploit validation, or offensive security; experience with exposure management, attack surface management, or application security products; experience with pricing, packaging, and sales enablement for new products or add-on modules; experience working with large enterprise security teams; background as a security practitioner, security researcher, or solutions engineer.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Edge Platform
description:
Machines learned to understand language. We’re teaching them to understand matter.

Forty percent of global manufacturing happens through physical and chemical processes inside pipes, tanks, and reactors. Despite decades of industrial automation, much of what happens inside them remains remarkably invisible. Manufacturing is the most ubiquitous and foundational sector in global economy, yet the way factories are fundamentally run have used the same control philosophies, manual operations, and legacy software for the past 60 years.

Laminar deploys state-of-the-art patented sensors and edge hardware directly into live production environments, generating data that didn’t previously exist to build foundation models deployed in factory floors that understand chemistry, composition, quality, and material state in real time. We use that understanding to run autonomy and rethink how things are made.

The last generation of industrial automation taught machines to execute instructions reliably. The next will teach them to understand the processes they control and run autonomously, adaptively, and agentically: higher quality, safety, more efficiently, sustainably, and productively.

That future is already taking shape. Today, Laminar works with 7 of the world’s 10 largest food and beverage manufacturers and operates across hundreds of factories globally across six continents. Our systems have materially reduced waste, cut manufacturing downtime, saved water, chemicals, energy, and helped prevent safety and quality failures. Our technology has gained international recognition, from being selected as a 2026 World Economic Forum Technology Pioneer, Gold 2026 Edison Award, Unilever Startup of the Year, to Innovator Awards by both Coca-Cola and AB InBev, and more.

We are backed by tier-one investors in physical AI to make intelligent, self-improving production the new standard for industry.

Join us to build what makes matter intelligible, and the intelligible controllable.

The Role

We’re looking for an exceptional Senior Software Engineer, Edge Platform to own components of and build out Laminar’s next-generation edge computing platform. You’ll shape how our software, ML models, and LLM workloads run on Linux-based edge devices and factory-deployed servers. This is a hands-on role with ownership from early architecture and prototyping through production deployment. We’re looking for someone who can turn open-ended challenges into reliable systems, make thoughtful technical decisions, and help other engineers grow along the way.

What You Will Do

  • Linux Systems Engineering: Develop and maintain production edge Linux environments, including provisioning, networking, service management, storage, security, and performance tuning.
  • Virtualization & Workload Management: Design bare-metal server infrastructure and use virtualization and containers to deploy, isolate, and manage applications.
  • Edge AI Deployment: Work with data and ML teams to deploy and operate ML models and LLMs locally, accounting for compute, memory, latency, and hardware acceleration.
  • Industrial Integration: Build on the interfaces that connect Laminar to customer systems, including MES integration and industrial communication protocols like Ethernet/IP, OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus, etc. Make it easy for a customer to integrate our system with what they have running.
  • CI/CD: Build automated provisioning, remote updates, rollback, logging, and monitoring capabilities. Design for intermittent connectivity, power interruptions, and limited physical access.
  • Security Engineering: Implement secure device access, identity management, software delivery, and communication between edge systems and cloud services.
  • Technical Leadership: Mentor junior engineers, review code and designs, and document architecture and engineering decisions.

About You

  • 4+ years of experience building production systems software, with meaningful work on Linux systems, infrastructure, or distributed systems.
  • Track record of owning the design, implementation, and success of significant components within a larger system.
  • Comfortable defining technical direction, taking ownership, and delivering in a fast-paced product iteration cycle.
  • Deep Linux experience, covering administration, networking, filesystems, troubleshooting, and performance analysis.
  • Experience shipping software into environments you don’t control: into on-prem, edge, embedded, robotics, or similar.
  • Practical experience with bare-metal infrastructure, hypervisors, virtual machines, and containers.
  • Strong experience in languages such as Rust, Python, C/C++, or Go, with experience building automation and system tooling.
  • Familiarity with deploying ML models and LLMs on edge hardware, including inference runtimes and resource constraints.
  • Experience with deployment automation, monitoring, system recovery, and secure software updates.
  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Benefits

  • Direct impact on product and culture.
  • Comprehensive benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability, Transportation benefit, Health and Wellness benefit, and more.
  • 401k plan with employer matching
  • Equity
  • Competitive salary and bonus opportunities.
  • Dynamic and inclusive work environment.
  • Opportunities for growth and professional development.
  • Access to Greentown Labs' extensive network of cleantech startups.
  • Transportation benefit for your commute
  • A team that celebrates together from rooftop lunches, ping pong matches, Lunch & Learns, and regular team events

Learn How We Think

  • Learn about our startup journey: Our Journey
  • How we're combating climate change: AI-Powered Climate Tech
  • A customer story: Unilever uses Laminar precision automation to cut time & water usage
There are many easier places to work on AI. Laminar is for people who want the hardest version of their discipline. Models here must survive contact with physics. Hardware must survive years of continuous industrial operation. Software must integrate with machinery built decades ago. Everything we build ultimately has to work on a factory floor.
We believe exceptional people should be given exceptional amounts of ownership. At Laminar, you will have the context to form your own view, the permission to challenge ours, and the resources to pursue the right answers, whatever technical or organizational boundaries stand in the way. There are few layers between identifying something important and changing it.
We’re fortunate to work with a small polymathic team of hardware and software engineers, chemists, AI researchers, factory operators, and go-to-market wizards who are unusually capable, curious, rigorous, ambitious, and low-ego. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you.

Our Interview Process
1. Phone screen with Laminar HR/Recruiter (15-20 minutes)
2. Intro call with Hiring Manager (30 minutes)
3. On-site interview, overview of tech, and interview/presentation with the Hiring Manager and a few team members. Depending on the role, a skills exercise that should take no longer than an hour to prep, would be sent ahead of time. We record your skills exercise to share with any team members who could not join the interview and/or with Founder's ahead of their Founder's Interview. If you are not local, we can conduct this virtually.
4. Finalists for Full-Time positions will have a Founder’s Interview in-person
Final steps:
Two professional references are requested, ideally one from your current organization and one who served as your Manager
If an Offer Letter is extended, a Background check is conducted
Laminar is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. Even if you are unsure you are a perfect fit, we strongly encourage you to apply! If you're ready to play a key role in scaling a game-changing company that’s transforming the industrial sector and advancing sustainability, we want to hear from you.

title: Head of Talent
description:
About Ornn

Ornn is building the financial infrastructure for AI compute. Our price indices are live on Bloomberg Terminal. We structure and trade compute hedging instruments. And we're now building a platform that brings exchange-grade mechanics like order management, matching, scheduling, and settlement to how compute capacity gets reserved and allocated. We're a lean team in New York, backed by leading venture and strategic investors.


About the Role

Ornn is growing quickly, and we're looking for a Head of Talent to help us find and hire the best people to build what's next. You'll own recruiting from the first conversation through the offer, while putting the processes in place to help a lean team hire thoughtfully and move fast.

This is a hands-on role for someone who has recruited at a fast-growing startup and likes being close to the work. You'll partner directly with leadership on hiring priorities, attract exceptional candidates, and make sure every candidate and interviewer has a strong experience.


What You'll Do

  • Own hiring pipelines across engineering, markets, go-to-market and operations, from sourcing and outreach through interviews, offers and closing.

  • Build talent attraction strategies that get exceptional people interested in Ornn, including proactive sourcing, referrals, employer branding and candidate outreach.

  • Partner with leadership and hiring managers on headcount planning, hiring priorities, role requirements and recruiting timelines.

  • Run recruiting events and other opportunities to introduce Ornn to high-caliber talent.

  • Build consistent interview processes, train interviewers, improve scorecards and keep hiring decisions well calibrated.

  • Own talent reporting, including pipeline health, conversion rates, time to hire, source effectiveness and progress against headcount plans.

  • Keep candidates informed and engaged while making sure hiring managers have the information they need to make decisions quickly.

  • Improve recruiting tools, workflows and processes as the team grows, without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.


Requirements

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in recruiting or talent acquisition.

  • Experience recruiting at a fast-growing startup, with a track record of hiring in a fast-moving environment.

  • Strong full-cycle recruiting skills, including proactive sourcing, candidate assessment, stakeholder management and closing.

  • Able to manage multiple searches, keep pipelines organized and follow through without constant direction.

  • Comfortable working directly with founders and hiring managers, pushing for clarity and making sound judgment calls.

  • Data-driven and able to turn recruiting metrics into practical improvements.

  • Clear, thoughtful communicator who cares about candidate experience and represents the company well.

  • Based in New York and able to work in person at our office.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Familiarity with Ashby.

  • Experience recruiting software engineers, infrastructure talent or other hard-to-hire technical profiles.

  • Experience building recruiting events, referral programs or employer-brand initiatives.

  • Experience introducing interviewer training, headcount reporting or hiring processes at an early-stage company.


Why This Role Matters

We're building infrastructure for a market that is still taking shape, and the people we hire now will define what Ornn becomes. As our team grows, hiring cannot be something everyone squeezes in between their day jobs. This role makes sure we're reaching the right people, assessing them well, and moving quickly enough to bring them on board. You'll help build the team and the recruiting foundation that lets Ornn scale without lowering the bar.


Compensation and Benefits

Benefits include competitive salary, meaningful equity, health coverage, free meals, and additional benefits. This is an early role with significant impact and equity upside.


Equal Opportunity Statement

Ornn is committed to building a diverse team. We evaluate candidates based on their ability to do the work, not on pedigree or background. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences.

title: Afdelingsleder til Børnehaven i Trørød Børnehus
description:
Praksisnær ledelse, for stærke børnefællesskaber og psykologisk tryghed

Om jobbet

Brænder du for pædagogisk ledelse tæt på praksis, og har du lyst til at stå i spidsen for udviklingen af stærke børnefællesskaber i et stort og levende børnehus? Så er det måske dig, vi søger som ny afdelingsleder for børnehaveafdelingen i Trørød Børnehus.

Trørød Børnehus er et stort og mangfoldigt børnehus med omkring 150 børn fordelt på både vuggestue og børnehave. Hverdagen er præget af liv, leg og læring, og vi arbejder bevidst med at organisere børnene i mindre fællesskaber, hvor relationer, deltagelsesmuligheder og tryghed er i fokus.

Vores pædagogiske arbejde tager afsæt i Den styrkede pædagogiske læreplan og Rudersdal Kommunes Børne- og Ungepolitik, hvor læring, sundhed og trivsel er bærende værdier. I Trørød Børnehus har vi en tydelig VI-kultur, hvor fællesskabets pædagogik er omdrejningspunktet – det, der gavner ét barn, skal komme alle børn til gavn. Vi er inspireret af Nest-pædagogikken og arbejder systematisk med struktur, forudsigelighed, tydelige roller og et fælles fagligt sprog.

Som afdelingsleder i børnehaveafdelingen bliver du en del af et tæt ledelsesteam sammen med den daglige leder og afdelingslederen i vuggestuen. Du varetager en delegeret ledelsesopgave med særligt ansvar for at understøtte og udvikle den pædagogiske praksis i børnehaveafdelingen. Rollen er praksisnær og forudsætter, at du er synlig i hverdagen, har blik for både børn og medarbejdere og bidrager til den samlede pædagogiske retning. Du har instruktionsbeføjelse i forhold til medarbejderne og varetager – inden for aftalte rammer – den daglige ledelse i den daglige leders fravær.

Som en central del af funktionen understøtter du det tætte samarbejde med PPR, hvor du fungerer som bindeled mellem den pædagogiske praksis og det tværfaglige samarbejde med PPR. Du har en koordinerende rolle og agerer tovholder i forhold til indsatser, opfølgning og fælles faglige drøftelser, så viden og anbefalinger omsættes til konkret praksis i hverdagen.

Du har ansvar for at skabe sammenhæng mellem mål, indsatser og den pædagogiske praksis i børnehaveafdelingen. Det indebærer blandt andet koordinering af pædagogiske projekter og udviklingsforløb samt fælles målfastsættelse, hvor du understøtter, at teamet løbende evaluerer og justerer praksis. Gennem faglig sparring, tydelig rammesætning og anerkendende dialog bidrager du til medarbejdernes professionelle udvikling og til et stærkt samarbejde i hverdagen, hvor psykologisk tryghed er en integreret del af arbejdsmiljøet.

Om dig

Vi søger en afdelingsleder, der er uddannet pædagog og har solid erfaring fra dagtilbudsområdet. Du har gerne erfaring med ledelse eller koordinerende opgaver og motiveres af at arbejde med pædagogisk udvikling i tæt samspil med praksis.

Du arbejder struktureret og systematisk og har blik for, hvordan tydelige læringsmiljøer, fælles faglig retning og klare forventninger skaber tryghed og kvalitet for både børn og voksne. Samtidig formår du at skabe følgeskab gennem tillid, dialog og faglig tyngde. Du trives i et forpligtende ledelsesfællesskab og har gode samarbejds- og kommunikationsevner – både i relation til medarbejdere, forældre og ledelseskolleger.

Om Trørød Børnehus

Vi tilbyder et meningsfuldt og spændende ledelsesjob i et børnehus med høje ambitioner for børns trivsel, læring og udvikling. Du bliver en del af en engageret ledelse og en personalegruppe med høj faglighed og lyst til fælles udvikling. Stillingen tilrettelægges med et fleksibelt skema, hvor du understøtter alle miljøerne i børnehaven og har mulighed for at være praksisnær på tværs – uden at være den faste voksne på en stue. I stillingen er der afsat fast kontortid til administrative opgaver. Der er gode muligheder for faglig sparring, kompetenceudvikling og for at sætte dit præg på den pædagogiske praksis i børnehaveafdelingen.

Der er ligeledes mulighed for lederuddannelse.

Uddannelse er en selvfølge - ikke et gode

Vi prioriterer at kompetenceudvikle alle vores pædagoger og pædagogmedhjælpere.

Om Rudersdal Kommune

I Rudersdal Kommune tror vi på, at vi kun lykkes i fællesskab. Derfor er det vores mål, at alle kommunens medarbejdere og ledere i alle opgaver - og i fællesskab - arbejder for at skabe bæredygtige løsninger, der giver værdi for borgerne, virksomheden og det samfund, vi er en del af. Se vores film om Rudersdal Kommunes strategi og værdier ”Vi lykkes kun i fællesskab” HER

Ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på fuldtid og start 1/12-26 eller snarest muligt efter det. Ansættelse sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

Ansøgning, samtale og kontakt

Du søger jobbet ved at klikke på knappen "Søg stilling" nedenfor.

Samtaler: Vi forventer at holde samtaler løbende.

title: ISO Consultant (Part Time)
description:
1. About the Role
Karma Global Solutions (a ~150-person accounting/back-office firm serving US CPA and property-management companies) is hiring a part-time/retainer independent consultant to raise their IT and security posture to audit-grade standard, build and certify an ISMS aligned to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and upskill in-house IT engineers for long-term sustainability. It's explicitly a build-and-transfer role — not a paperwork/template exercise.

2. Mandate / Objectives
Five core objectives:
  1. Diagnose current IT/security posture against ISO 27001:2022 (Annex A controls) and identify real gaps
  2. Build a certifiable ISMS — scope, risk assessment, Statement of Applicability, policies, and technical controls
  3. Harden actual infrastructure (identity, access, endpoints, network, remote access, logging, backup/DR)
  4. Mentor two in-house IT engineers to independently operate and maintain the ISMS
  5. Drive certification through Stage 1 and Stage 2 audits with zero major non-conformities
3. Key Responsibilities & Deliverables
Broken into four areas:
  • A. Assessment & Strategy — Gap assessment, asset inventory, risk assessment, ISMS scope, and Statement of Applicability
  • B. Implementation — Author core policies (access control, incident response, DR, vendor management, etc.) and implement technical controls (MFA, EDR, network segmentation, logging, encryption, DLP, etc.)
  • C. Governance & Audit Readiness — Internal audit programme, management reviews, vendor due diligence, certification body management
  • D. Capability Building — Hands-on IT engineer mentoring, company-wide security awareness training, and leaving behind runbooks/SOPs
4. Required Qualifications
Mandatory:
  • 8+ years in IT/information security with hands-on ISMS implementation experience
  • ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Lead Implementer and/or Lead Auditor certification
  • Personally taken at least one organisation end-to-end through ISO 27001 certification (references required)
  • Strong technical depth in IAM, endpoint/network security, logging, and backup/DR
  • BPO/KPO/ITES or financial services experience handling third-party client data
Strongly Preferred:
  • CISM / CISA / CISSP
  • SOC 2 Type II readiness experience
  • Exposure to US-client delivery environments and US data-privacy expectations

title: Senior Staff Implementation Delivery Manager
description:
Altana is the network for trusted trade. Our AI-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing.

The Opportunity at Altana

As a Global Public Sector Implementation Delivery Manager (IDM), you are the single-threaded technical owner of delivery for one of Altana’s most important public sector accounts or organizations. You blend enterprise architecture, hands-on deployment, and product design and development with the relationship skills to be the trusted technical voice in the room for the mission owners you serve.

You lead a small, account-aligned implementation pod and are accountable for turning a closed-won account into mission outcomes: architecting the deployment, delivering it in secured and regulated environments, keeping it healthy, and finding the next place Altana can create value. You do this hip-to-hip with commercial — partnering with the Technical Account Managers (TAMs) and Program Managers who run the account — using delivery credibility to enable organic growth and inside sales without carrying the commercial number yourself.

This role reports to a GPS Implementation sub-vertical lead (Trade, Resilience, or Policy) within the Implementation function, and is deployed against a named strategic account. For example, an IDM aligned to U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) would report to the Trade sub-vertical lead.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own delivery outcomes for a named strategic account or account groups. Serve as the single-threaded technical owner for implementation and platform delivery to a key public sector account or organization, from post-award through sustainment. Deliver on-time against contractual commitments and hold the technical quality bar.
  • Set and steward the account architecture. Translate mission outcomes into a coherent enterprise/solution architecture across SaaS and regulated PaaS environments. Own the deployment, integration, and data-modeling decisions that let the account scale, through upgrades and change.
  • Blend architecture, deployment, and product development. Personally architect, deploy, and — where the product doesn’t yet do what the mission needs — design and build first-draft capabilities and integrations. Feed working prototypes back to Product and Engineering so they can be hardened and scaled rather than left as one-off custom work.
  • Lead the account implementation pod. Direct the Implementation Delivery Specialists, integration engineers, and matrixed platform/cloud resources assigned to the account. Prioritize ruthlessly, assign owners, remove blockers, and mentor the team.
  • Be the trusted technical relationship for mission and technical leaders. Build and maintain durable relationships with the customer’s architects, engineering leaders, and senior decision-makers. Be the credible technical presence that de-risks delivery and earns the right to shape what comes next.
  • Enable inside sales alongside commercial. In partnership with the account’s TAMs and Program Managers, convert delivery trust and newly-discovered use cases into a qualified pipeline of upsells and expansions. Surface where the platform can unlock new mission value; the commercial team owns the number and the close.
  • Partner on pre-sales, capture, and scoping. Provide technical scoping, level-of-effort, and solution design during the BD motion so we sell only what we can deliver, and so delivery inherits the context it needs to succeed.
  • Own technical health and support obligations. Be accountable for system performance, incident response, and the account’s customer support obligations across the full lifecycle.
  • Meet security, risk, and compliance obligations. Ensure the account’s deployments satisfy their security and compliance requirements in regulated environments (e.g., FedRAMP, DoD IL5, and mission-specific enclaves), balancing compliance with scalability and GTM realities.
  • Enable and Close the field-to-product loop. Ensure that what the account teams learn on the ground makes it into clearly-framed, prioritized product asks — help commercial and implementation resources properly frame product asks so that they leverage existing features and capabilities, leading to shorter build cycles and thus greater refinement .

About You

  • 10+ years of technical experience spanning enterprise/solution architecture, hands-on deployment, and product design and development in a data-intensive or software field.
  • A track record leading complex, customer-facing software deployments end-to-end — ideally on-premise or in secured/regulated environments — and owning delivery outcomes against firm commitments.
  • Enterprise and solution architecture depth across cloud (AWS or Azure, GovCloud and other regulated environments a plus), data engineering (Python, SQL, Spark, Databricks), complex system integrations (REST APIs, SSO/SAML), and containerized deployments (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Comfortable being the trusted technical voice in the room with senior customer stakeholders, and able to translate between mission owners, engineers, and commercial teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to spot and shape expansion opportunities, working alongside commercial counterparts to grow an account through delivered value.
  • Experienced working with sensitive data and navigating complex, highly regulated technology organizations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Able to meet Public Trust eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
  • Availability to work on-site in the DC / Virginia / Maryland area for U.S. Federal accounts such as CBP.

Nice to have, but not required

  • Exposure to trade compliance, supply chain management, shipping and logistics, or a field similarly related to international commerce.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud, FedRAMP, DoD IL5, or other government-managed / accredited environments.
  • People-management experience leading small technical delivery teams.
  • Experience developing and maintaining APIs and ML toolsets (Scikit-learn, NumPy, Pandas, Dedupe).
  • Able to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI

Technologies we love to use at Altana

  • Languages: Python, SQL, TS/JavaScript
  • Tools: AWS, Azure, Claude, Databricks, Docker, Git, K8s, Spark/PySpark, Swagger/OpenAPI
  • Datastores: Delta/Unity Catalog, OpenSearch, Postgres, Redshift, S3

title: Senior Data Engineer: Cloud Ingestion & Integrations Remote
description:
Coderio designs and delivers scalable digital solutions for global companies. We combine strong technical expertise with a product mindset to lead complex software initiatives end-to‑end. We work with international clients, value autonomy and clear communication, and build long‑term partnerships through technical excellence.

More information:

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize scalable, high‑performance data platforms supporting large volumes of financial and transactional data. The ideal candidate has strong expertise in Python, SQL, Apache Spark, AWS, and modern data engineering architectures, with proven experience working with production‑grade systems in fast‑paced environments.

Candidates must reside exclusively in Argentina, Brazil, or Uruguay.

What You Can Expect (Responsibilities)

  • Design, build, and maintain high‑throughput, low‑latency batch and streaming data pipelines to ingest and process financial transactions from diverse global sources.
  • Design, scale, and optimize cloud data warehouse and lakehouse architectures capable of handling massive volumes of structured and unstructured data.
  • Collaborate with Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and Product Managers to understand business needs and translate them into scalable, reliable data solutions.
  • Implement and enforce data quality frameworks, automated testing, monitoring, and alerting to ensure data integrity, reliability, high availability, and compliance with SLAs.
  • Drive the adoption of DataOps practices, including CI/CD, workflow automation, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for data systems.
  • Champion data governance, privacy, and security standards across data storage and compute layers, including GDPR/LGPD compliance.
  • Mentor and guide junior and mid‑level Data Engineers, promoting engineering excellence, best practices, and modern architectural patterns.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Big Data, or related Software Engineering roles, with a proven track record managing high‑volume, production‑grade data systems in fast‑paced environments.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for complex data processing, optimization, and software development; Scala or Java experience is a plus.
  • Hands‑on experience with Apache Spark/PySpark, Delta Lake, and modern lakehouse architectures, including Data Mesh principles.
  • Strong expertise in AWS data services, particularly S3, Glue, Athena, EventBridge, Firehose, and Lambda.
  • Solid experience with data orchestration and warehousing technologies, including Apache Airflow or similar DAG‑based tools and platforms such as Snowflake, AWS Redshift, or Google BigQuery.
  • Experience designing real‑time streaming architectures using technologies such as Apache Kafka or AWS Kinesis, as well as familiarity with modern data transformation and modeling tools such as dbt.
  • Strong knowledge of DevOps/DataOps practices, including Git, Docker, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar), Infrastructure as Code, and cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP.
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, with the ability to communicate effectively in English in both technical and non‑technical contexts.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in Fintech, Payments, E‑commerce, or other high‑growth technology environments, particularly working with financial transactions or highly regulated data.
  • Experience with Databricks and advanced cloud lakehouse architectures.
  • Knowledge of data privacy, governance, and security frameworks, including GDPR/LGPD, as well as experience implementing secure data platforms.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, advanced DataOps automation, and mentoring Data Engineers or contributing to technical architecture decisions.

Benefits

  • 100% remote
  • Long‑term commitment, with autonomy and meaningful impact
  • Strategic, high‑visibility role within a modern engineering culture
  • Collaborative international team with strong technical leadership
  • Career development and growth opportunities within Coderio

Why join Coderio?

At Coderio, we value talent and excellence. While we are primarily a remote‑first company, this specific strategic role offers the opportunity to work directly on‑site to drive high‑stakes initiatives. We are passionate about technology, collaboration, and fair compensation. We offer an inclusive and challenging environment with real growth opportunities. If you are motivated to design solutions that make a difference, we are waiting for you.

title: Director, Progressive Care & Cardiovascular Intensive Care Unit (CVICU), Baptist South
description:
About Baptist Health
Recognized as a top place to work in health care, Baptist Health cares for more patients in Northeast Florida than any other provider, ranking as “most preferred” for more than 30 years. Our centers of excellence include Baptist MD Anderson Cancer Center, Baptist Heart Hospital, Baptist Neurological Institute and Wolfson Children's Hospital.

Director, Progressive Care & Cardiovascular Intensive Care Unit (CVICU), Baptist South


Baptist Health is seeking an experienced and dynamic Director of Progressive Care & Cardiovascular Intensive Care Unit (CVICU) to join the Nursing Administration leadership team at Baptist Medical Center South.


This is an exciting opportunity to play a key leadership role in the development and opening of our new Cardiovascular Intensive Care Unit (CVICU) while providing strategic, clinical, and operational oversight of our Progressive Care Units.


The Director will have 24-hour accountability for nursing operations, patient safety, clinical outcomes, staff development, financial performance, and patient experience. Job Responsibilities:


  • Provide strategic, clinical, and operational leadership for Progressive Care Units and the future CVICU.

  • Collaborate with cardiovascular physicians, hospital leadership, and interdisciplinary teams to support cardiovascular program growth.

  • Oversee recruitment, onboarding, mentoring, performance management, and professional development of nursing teams.

  • Develop and implement quality improvement initiatives focused on patient safety, clinical outcomes, and patient experience.

  • Manage departmental budgets, staffing, productivity, resource allocation, and operational performance.

  • Experience managing staffing, productivity, departmental budgets, and financial performance.

  • Strong knowledge of progressive care, cardiovascular patient management, and critical care principles.

title: Senior Research Scientist
description:

The work draws on DeepHealth's large-scale imaging data and expert feedback loops and includes collaboration with research partners such as Imperial College London.

  • Develop experimental systems to validate research hypotheses and measure progress against scientific goals.
