title: Lead Security Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Lead Security Engineer (m/w/d)

About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 120 employees from a broad range of nations, we continue to grow – and we're now going far beyond our core business, aiming to eliminate bureaucracy and admin in hospitals with a whole portfolio of AI products.

What to expect as our Lead Security Engineer (m/w/d):

  • Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

In this role, you can make an impact and grow with us as Lead Security Engineer (m/w/d):

You'll be our first dedicated security engineer: a senior IC with no team at the start. You join as Deputy CISO, report to our Director of Technology (currently acting CISO), and build security engineering from scratch. The baseline is already in place – ISO 27001, C5 Type II, regular penetration tests, and encryption in the product. AI is adding new surfaces: voice documentation, document generation, and agentic workflows. You build and own the security program, the tooling, and the security story we tell customers.

  • Vulnerability management – scanners and dependency updates across repos, plus the process that gets findings closed.

  • Partner to Platform – review security-sensitive infrastructure decisions and explore options like customer-managed keys or HSMs. Platform still owns architecture.

  • Certifications, technical side – control design and assessments for our ISO 27001 and C5 setup, the security case for a potential upcoming Class IIa medical device (MDR), and pentest scoping and follow-up, with regulation like the EU Cyber Resilience Act on the horizon. This is roughly a quarter to a third of the role, and we say it openly: for the right person in healthcare security, it's a draw, not a chore.

  • Customer security – reusable docs, evidence, and AI-assisted questionnaires, so the tenth enterprise deal costs a fraction of the first. You join the call when a hospital CISO asks something new about our AI architecture.

  • Incident response – process, runbooks, and escalation, and you lead when it's real. We're too small for a SOC, so you design on-call that fits a company our size. Product incidents and platform bugs have their own owners in engineering.

  • Company-wide security – watch the threat landscape, turn this week's supply-chain mess into concrete actions, and set the baselines IT applies to devices and accounts.

How we work:

  • AI-native – our engineers use coding agents every day. Security should too: scanning, evidence, questionnaires.

  • AI is also our attack surface – agent sandboxing, prompt injection, voice data, computer-use automation inside hospitals. We deal with security questions most companies will only meet in a few years.

  • Human-in-the-loop by default – this is healthcare: AI proposes, people stay in control.

  • Ship and observe – we ship continuously and debug from telemetry, including in the open when that's the fastest path.

Requirements

Here's how we picture you as our Lead Security Engineer (m/w/d):

  • You're a hands-on security engineer with 6+ years across software and security engineering, and you can point to a security program (or a big part of one) you've owned.

  • You've been the technical counterpart through at least one ISO 27001, C5, or SOC 2 certification cycle: you've designed controls, faced an auditor, and written the technical side of a Statement of Applicability. This is a hard requirement.

  • You've run vulnerability management somewhere real: scanners, dependency bots, triage, and the follow-through that gets things fixed.

  • You follow the security scene closely (podcasts, advisories, incident write-ups) and usually have an opinion on this week's incident before it reaches the news.

  • You're genuinely curious about AI security – both securing AI systems (agents, sandboxing, data flows) and using AI tooling to work at leverage.

  • You can talk to engineers, auditors, and hospital security teams in English without a slide deck translating for you.

Nice to have:

  • German language skills, since our customers and the C5 world are German-speaking.

  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated domain.

  • Offensive security experience.

  • Security certifications such as OSCP, CISSP, or similar.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Rakenna kanssamme AI-natiiveja data-alustoja, joilla on oikeasti merkitystä!

Loikka on teknologiayhtiö, joka auttaa asiakkaitaan uudistamaan liiketoimintaansa datan, tekoälyn ja digitaalisten palveluiden avulla. Toimimme Turussa ja Oulussa, ja asiakkaitamme on ympäri Suomen, erityisesti pääkaupunkiseudulla, joten tähän rooliin voit tulla myös Helsingistä. Yhdistämme työssämme vahvan liiketoimintaymmärryksen, datan, designin ja uusimman teknologian, jotta ratkaisumme eivät ainoastaan toimi, vaan tuottavat asiakkaalle oikeasti arvoa.

Nyt etsimme datakehitystiimiimme uutta loikkalaista!

Mitä pääset tekemään?

Pääset rakentamaan Loikan AI-natiiveja data-alustoja, joissa tekoäly on mukana alusta asti eikä jälkikäteen lisätty kerros. Rakennat liiketoiminnallista arvoa tuottavia dataintegraatioita, -rajapintoja ja -putkia, ja parhaimmillaan autat asiakasta uudistamaan koko liiketoimintamallinsa järkevämmäksi ja tuottavammaksi. Jos sinulla on myös ohjelmistokehitystaustaa, pääset mukaan entistä monipuolisempiin projekteihin.

Asiakkaamme toimivat muun muassa finanssialalla, teollisuudessa ja vähittäiskaupassa. Juuri nyt useampi asiakkaistamme kasvaa, joten tiimimme tarvitsee vahvistusta. Teemme projektityötä, omistamme asiakkuutemme itse ja rakennamme pitkäjänteisiä asiakassuhteita. Sinä et siis ole vain resurssi jonkun muun projektissa, vaan aidosti mukana vaikuttamassa.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Koulutustaustasi voi olla esimerkiksi tietojenkäsittelystä tai matemaattis-luonnontieteelliseltä alalta. Tärkeintä on kuitenkin osaaminen ja into oppia lisää.

  • vähintään 3 vuoden kokemusta datan parissa työskentelystä
  • vahvaa osaamista SQL- ja NoSQL-tietokannoista
  • kokemusta Databricksistätyöprojekteista tuttuja data lakeja ja automatisoituja datapipelineja
  • ymmärrystä tilastollisten menetelmien soveltamisesta sekä uusien menetelmien suunnittelusta ja analysoinnista
  • kiinnostusta tekoälyyn ja sen hyödyntämiseen dataratkaisuissa. Kokemus esimerkiksi ML-malleista, LLM-integraatioista tai RAG-ratkaisuista on iso plussa
  • hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja suomeksi ja englanniksi, niin asiakkaiden kuin kehittäjien kanssa

Mitä me tarjoamme?

  • Pääset rakentamaan AI-natiiveja data-alustoja ja kasvattamaan AI-osaamistasi oikeissa asiakasprojekteissa
  • Mehiläisen kattava yksityinen työterveyshuolto, johon sisältyvät myös psykologipalvelut
  • Vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus
  • Maanantain yhteiset aamupalat, joilla viikko lähtee hyvin käyntiin
  • Keskiviikon yhteistreenit
  • Monipuoliset asiakasprojektit ja mahdollisuus kehittyä osaamisesi suuntaan
  • Tiimi, jossa autetaan toisia ja jossa jokaisen ääni kuuluu

Heräsikö kysymyksiä?

Soita tai laita sähköpostia, kerron mielelläni lisää!

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Compensation Range:

$90,000 - $100,000



Senior Project Manager, Program Management Office (PMO) – Data Centers Technologies

Job Description: Senior Project Manager, Global Transformation Initiatives – Data Center Technologies

Department: Program Management Office (PMO)

Reports to: Senior Manager, Program Management Office (PMO)

Position Summary

The Senior Project Manager serves as a leader for strategic transformation initiatives within Data Center Technologies, with primary responsibility leading a large-scale ERP implementation across the Americas. The role is accountable for the successful delivery of an end-to-end ERP deployment, ensuring the implementation of a unified business platform supported by standardized processes, harmonized data structures, and sustainable operating models.

As the overall project manager, the Senior Project Manager is responsible for establishing strong governance, driving execution excellence, managing risks, and ensuring alignment between business objectives and project outcomes. The role serves as the central point of coordination across business functions, IT, external partners, and site leadership teams to deliver transformational change while maintaining operational continuity.


Key responsibilities include leading cross-functional project teams through all phases of the project, including planning, data migration, testing, training, cutover, deployment, and stabilization. The Senior Project Manager ensures that project scope, timeline, budget, resource planning, and stakeholder expectations are effectively managed while promoting adoption of global standards and best practices.


The role works collaboratively with Subject Matter Experts, Super Users, Application Specialists, and technical teams to drive decision-making, resolve issues, and ensure readiness across all functional workstreams, including Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Engineering, Procurement, Sales, and Service.


In addition, the Senior Project Manager acts as the primary escalation point for project-related risks and challenges, providing leadership and guidance to secure timely resolution and maintain project momentum. The position is responsible for maintaining comprehensive project governance, reporting, and documentation while actively managing organizational change, stakeholder engagement, and business readiness activities to maximize user adoption and long-term value realization.


Through strong leadership, skilled communication, and disciplined execution, the Senior Project Manager enables successful ERP transformations that improve operational efficiency, data quality, process harmonization, and scalability, while creating a foundation for digitalization, automation, and advanced analytics initiatives across the Business Area.

Candidate Profile

Success in this role requires a structured and disciplined project management approach, strong leadership capabilities, and the ability to lead complex ERP transformation projects across multiple functions, locations, and stakeholder groups. The ideal candidate brings proven experience managing large-scale ERP implementations, business process transformation initiatives, and organizational change in a global manufacturing environment, combined with a strong understanding of operational business processes.


Demonstrated expertise in end-to-end project management is essential, including project initiation, scope and requirements definition, planning, resource coordination, dependency management, risk management, issue resolution, governance, and milestone tracking. The candidate must have a proven ability to deliver projects on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives while effectively managing competing priorities and stakeholder expectations.


Previous experience in leading ERP implementations, process harmonization initiatives, and organizational change programs is a must. The successful candidate understands challenges associated with system adoption and process transformation and can proactively drive stakeholder engagement, readiness, training, and business ownership through the project lifecycle.


Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills are required to coordinate activities across global and regional teams, align diverse interests, and effectively engage both operational and executive leadership. The candidate acts as a trusted advisor and change leader, capable of driving decisions, resolving issues, and maintaining momentum in complex environments.

In addition to formal leadership experience, the role requires a strong ability to lead through influence. This includes building trusted relationships across organizational boundaries, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and motivating teams without relying solely on positional authority.


Core Responsibilities

Planning & Coordinating

Develop and maintain the integrated project plan, ensuring alignment across all functional workstreams, project milestones, and deployment activities. Coordinate activities across all project workstreams, ensuring interdependencies are managed and critical milestones are achieved. Align with project management and report progress, risks and issues regularly.


Stakeholder Management

Acts as the primary liaison between executive leadership, site management, business functions, IT organizations, and external implementation partners, providing clear direction, decision support, and escalation. Ensure stakeholder needs are understood and reflected in the solution design and delivery. Facilitate project steering committees and provide executive-level reporting, recommendations, and decision support.


Scope & Requirements Management

Oversee requirements gathering and validation across all project workstreams, ensuring alignment with global standards and business objectives.Ensure scope is clearly defined and controlled throughout the project life cycle.Collaborate with super users, local process owners, and application specialists to translate requirements into feasible functionality.


Risk & Issue Management

Identify, assess, and manage project-wide risks, issues, dependencies, and escalations across all workstreams.Escalate critical risk impacting project timeline and budget to project management.Develop mitigation and contingency plans with project management.


Resource Oversight

Manage overall project resource planning, ensuring adequate business, technical, and external consulting support throughout all project phases.


Testing & Quality Assurance

Support planning and execution of testing activities throughout the project.Coordinate with team to ensure test cases are aligned with business scenarios.Coordinate defect resolution and retesting activities.


Change Management

Lead organization change management initiatives, including stakeholder engagement, communications, business readiness planning, training oversight, and adoption monitoring. Ensure business ownership and sustainable adoption of new processes and functionalities. Drive alignment with global standards while balancing local business requirements.


Skills & Attributes

Strong executive presence with the ability to influence and drive decisions across all organizational levels.Proven ability to lead organizational change and business transformation in complex global environments.Strong conflict resolution and stakeholder alignment capabilitiesResults-oriented mindset with a focus on business value realization and sustainable adoption.Strong business acumen with the ability to translate project decisions into operational and financial outcomes.


Location

The ideal candidate will be based at one of our manufacturing sites in the Americas, either Daleville, Virginia or Selma, Texas, to enable close collaboration with local leadership teams and support on-site projects.This position follows a hybrid working model, with an expectation of minimum three days per week in the office.


Travel Requirement

Travel between sites in the Americas will be required to support program execution, stakeholder engagement, and collaboration. Requirements will vary depending on project phases and location-specific needs and will be aligned with manager guidance.

title: Sell Side Research Analyst
description:
About Ornn

Ornn is building the financial infrastructure for AI compute. Our price indices are live on Bloomberg Terminal. We structure and trade compute hedging instruments. And we're now building a platform that brings exchange-grade mechanics like order management, matching, scheduling, and settlement to how compute capacity gets reserved and allocated. We're a lean team in New York, backed by leading venture and strategic investors.


About the Role

GPU compute is turning into an asset class, and almost nobody is writing about it with real data. You would be Ornn's first dedicated research analyst, publishing the work that hedge funds, consultancies, lenders and operators read to understand where compute prices are going and why.

You'll sit at the center of Ornn Data. Our index draws on more than 150 providers and roughly 1,000 transactions a day, and you'll turn that into research our clients pay for and our sales and markets teams use in every conversation.

What You'll Do

  • Publish regular research on the compute market: weekly pricing notes, monthly market reports, and deeper pieces on GPU generations, supply coming online, contract terms and residual values.

  • Cover the companies that shape the market: hyperscalers, neoclouds, chipmakers, data center developers and their capex plans.

  • Take calls with institutional clients, consultancies and lenders, and present at client meetings and industry events.

  • Manage our freelance writers and researchers, set the research calendar and hold the bar on quality.


Requirements

  • 1 to 4 years in equity or credit research, commodities research, or a research role at a fund, data provider or consultancy.

  • Strong modeling skills in Excel and comfort working with large datasets.

  • Clear, fast writing. You can turn a messy dataset into a sharp one-page view with a point of view.

  • Real curiosity about AI infrastructure and how compute is bought, sold and financed.

  • Comfortable working independently in a lean team.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Sell side coverage of semiconductors, data centers, cloud or TMT.

  • Experience with commodity markets, benchmarks or index products.

  • Python or SQL.

  • An existing following or published work in the AI infrastructure space.

Why This Role Matters

A market only works when people trust the information about it. Ornn's index, futures work with ICE and data business all depend on being the most credible voice on what compute costs. This role is how that credibility shows up in the world every week, and how Ornn becomes the first place institutions go to understand the asset.

Compensation and Benefits

Benefits include competitive salary, meaningful equity, health coverage, meals, and additional benefits.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Ornn is committed to building a diverse team. We evaluate candidates based on their ability to do the work, not on pedigree or background. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences.

title: FoDM - Subchapter Lead Insights Center of Excellence EMEA Growth & Emerging
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Center of Excellence (CoE) Insights team operates within the global Strategic Insights chapter, serving as the dedicated regional insights partner across all affiliates in the region. Physically located within the market, the team acts as the vital bridge between global research strategy and local execution, translating global intelligence into actionable market context, feeding critical field intelligence back to global teams, and accelerating the adoption of standardized data products and analytics across regional business partners.


As Subchapter Lead, Center of Excellence of the Region, you will lead a regional team of Country Insights Business Partners (ranging from ~5 to ~15 direct FTEs depending on region) to provide strategic, operational, and commercial insights leadership across all regional affiliates. In this role, reporting to the global Chapter Lead, Strategic Insights, you will dedicate approximately 45% of your focus to strategic initiatives—including regional insights roadmaps, capability evolution, and resource allocation—and 55% to operational execution, including affiliate support, SLA monitoring, and data product adoption.


The Opportunity


  • Drive Regional Affiliate Partnership & Advisory (35%): Serve as the trusted, primary Insights partner to affiliate leadership (Heads of Marketing, Strategic Marketing Leads, and Product Managers) by delivering market and competitive intelligence for strategic planning, product launch planning, and portfolio prioritization, while setting SLAs and monitoring service quality.
  • Lead, Develop, and Inspire Regional Talent (30%): Directly manage, hire, and coach a distributed team of Country Insights Business Partners (EMEA-Mature ~15 FTEs, EMEA-Growth & Emerging ~13 FTEs, APAC ~10 FTEs, China ~5 FTEs, or Americas ~13 FTEs), cultivating their market acumen, analytical capabilities, and advisory credibility.
  • Coordinate Field Intelligence & Global Strategy (20%): Systematically gather local field dynamics, competitive moves, and customer signals from affiliates to inform global Strategic Insights and Global Insight Solutions priorities, serving as the regional "voice of the customer" in global forums.
  • Accelerate Insight Solutions & Digital Adoption (15%): Champion the uptake of standardized data platforms and dashboards across affiliates, partnering with digital marketing and RDT to train teams, drive self-service analytics, monitor usage, and escalate regional product gaps to global roadmap owners.
  • Direct Regional Budget & Investment Recommendations: Influence regional insights resource allocation, develop annual regional insights budgets within the broader Chapter P&L, and recommend investments in local research and capabilities in alignment with the Chapter Lead.
  • Engage Senior Stakeholders & Foster Cross-Functional Alignment: Represent Insights in regional leadership forums, deliver presentations to affiliate executive teams and DIA Divisional Leadership (DLT), and balance multi-market interests across Customer Area Business Leads and Life Cycle Teams.
  • Translate Global Intelligence for Local Commercial Impact: Synthesize complex global strategic models and analytical research into practical, locally relevant intelligence that respects diverse market realities and drives measurable commercial results.

Who You Are


  • Education & Professional Experience: You hold an undergraduate degree (Master’s, MBA, or PhD preferred) in business, life sciences, economics, or a quantitative discipline, alongside a minimum of 10 years of experience in market research, commercial insights, or business strategy, with at least 3 years leading teams in regional or matrix structures (life sciences, diagnostics, or pharma strongly preferred).
  • Affiliate & Regional Market Acumen: You possess substantial country-level and regional commercial experience, demonstrating a deep understanding of regional market dynamics, regulatory environments, local customer landscapes, and affiliate planning cycles.

title: Director of Product Management, Public Sector
description:
Altana is the network for trusted trade. Our AI-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing.

The Opportunity

The rules of global trade are being rewritten in real time.

Supply chain transparency requirements are being rewritten; Forced labor enforcement, semiconductor export controls, tariff volatility, secure procurement for defense, allied coordination on economic security all require a new paradigm. Governments around the world are being asked to do something they've never been equipped to do: understand, monitor, and act on the full depth of global commerce, not just the edge of it. To do so they need a deep understanding of the entire production history and to collaborate with the private sector in new ways to ensure compliant trade is facilitated, while questionable activity is identified.

The tools haven't kept pace with the mandate. Customs agencies still orient around transactions and rely on paper-based trusted trader audits, defense resilience was built for a different era of acquisition and slower innovation, and agencies don’t have the tooling nor data to do fact based policy research. The result is a widening gap between what governments need to know and what they can actually see — a gap that bad actors exploit, that allies can't easily close together, and that legitimate traders pay for in delays, uncertainty, and compliance overhead.

Altana exists to close that gap.

As Director of Product Management for Public Sector, you will lead the team defining how governments harness the power of the Altana network — not just to enforce at the border, but to understand the full complexity of global supply chains, collaborate with allies, and shape the trade policy and economic security decisions that will define the next era of globalization. You’ll oversee our three public sector product areas, and coordinate across the broader Altana organization to build our network. You've built innovative products before. You’ve worked in complex data driven environments with multiple competing incentives, and have exposure to policy, enforcement, or government operations. You’ll partner with our internal experts who are deeply familiar with the government operating cadence to help identify the product and roadmap. You're ready to build the system that changes that.

This role sits at the center of one of the most consequential technology problems in the world. The team you lead will define how Altana becomes the operating infrastructure for trusted trade — the platform governments reach for when they need to know not just what crossed a border, but why it matters.

What You’ll Do

Redefine What Governments Can See

  • Own the product vision for Altana’s three public sector product areas;
    • Customs and Border Management For Goods – modern tooling to collaborate with importers, understand trade, and enforce policy decisions at the border
    • Defense resilience and acquisition – defining a new era of defense procurement to foster innovation while maintaining secure and compliant supply chains
    • Economic Security and Policy – helping agencies analyze supply chain information to influence effective policy
  • Engage in how Altana is deployed to governments to meet them where they need us across their varied geographies, security and compliance boundaries.
  • Ensure a unified platform and architecture to meet the needs of multiple governments.
  • Work in collaboration with our other product areas to define and deliver our core mission sets in ways that work for public sector users.

Modernize Customs and Border Management For Goods

  • Help government customers move beyond transaction oriented, repetitive work, and adversarial sampling. Build an agent native intelligence layer that lets border authorities collaborate, review and enforce policies with modern ML and AI.
  • Build automated validation tools that close the "Tax Gap" — catching duty evasion, misdeclared origin, and undervaluation without slowing the flow of legitimate commerce.
  • Own the integration and user workflow layer: how do we coexist with government systems and user flows to bridge the world to a new future. Integrate to make Altana feel like a native capability, not another integration project.

Power Economic Security and Policy

  • Define a new product capability around economic security — giving government users the analytical tools to understand supply chain concentration, map strategic dependencies, model the impact of tariff and export control policy, and coordinate with allied governments on shared risk.
  • Build the "Policy Workbench" that allows trade analysts, national security staff, and senior policymakers to move from raw supply chain data to defensible, evidence-based conclusions — about a sector, a country, a company, or a critical input.
  • Work across the U.S. interagency and with Altana's international government customers to ensure the platform supports the full spectrum of economic security missions — from forced labor enforcement to critical mineral mapping to allied supply chain coordination.
  • Manage a fused data environment that combines Altana’s unparalleled supply chain graph, and enables integration with confidential customer data to support policy analyses.

Defense Resilience and Acquisition

  • Evolve supply chain in defense procurement from one-time design and awards to continuous compliance that fosters an innovation ecosystem.
  • Create a marketplace for compliant components that enables defense manufacturers and governments to foster innovation, experimentation and rapid fielding of new capabilities.
  • Build the tooling to enable defense contractors to see and manage their supply chains using Altana’s deep tier visibility, analysis and collaboration flows connecting component makers, manufacturers, and certification providers with the public sector.

Lead a High-Impact Product Team

  • Set the product strategy and roadmap for these areas.
  • Partner closely with engineering, design, data science, and government affairs to translate policy mandates and operational realities into product capabilities that work at the scale governments require.
  • Be the connective tissue between Altana's enterprise product work and its government missions — ensuring that what enterprises submit and what governments receive tells a coherent, trusted story.

Who You Are

You understand how customs and border authorities actually work. You’ve spent 8+ years at the intersection of trade, customs enforcement, or border security technology — understanding the operational constraints, the data limitations, and the political realities from the inside. You know the difference between a manifest and an entry summary. You’ve seen how targeting and clearance decisions get made, and you understand why the systems that support them weren’t built for what’s being asked of them today.

You think in networks, not transactions. You understand that trade is inherently a network system — and that the most consequential risks (evasion, illicit finance, undervaluation, COO laundering, supply chain manipulation) hide in the connections, not the individual records. You’re energized by graph-based analytics, AI-driven pattern detection, and the opportunity to give border officers a view of global commerce that’s never existed before.

You can hold policy and product in your head at the same time. You’ve translated high-level mandates — forced labor enforcement, counternarcotics, trusted-trader modernization, revenue protection — into concrete product features. You know how to write a requirement an engineer can build, and how to explain a data architecture to a customs official who has never written a line of code.

You build for many authorities, not one. You’re comfortable designing for agencies across developed and emerging economies — with different legal regimes, data-sovereignty requirements, languages, and levels of digital maturity — and finding the common platform beneath the local variation.

You lead teams that build, not just describe. Your team defines system interfaces, drafts API specs, and prototypes workflows before production code is written. You hold yourself and your team to shipping things that work in the real world.

You’re tech-enabled and obsessed with UX. You understand the plumbing — APIs, EDI, ETL/ELT, JSON — but you’re equally obsessed with the user experience. You hate clunky integration projects. You believe that even the most complex border workflows can be made to feel like magic with the right product thinking.

Clearance is a plus, but not required. Some of our government work requires eligibility for a security clearance; eligibility for (or an existing) U.S. security clearance, or a prior successful Customs and Border Protection/DHS background investigation, is a strong plus. For engagements with international customs authorities, relevant local eligibility and the ability to work within each authority’s security requirements is what matters most.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in customs enforcement, border security technology, trade compliance, or trade facilitation
  • 7+ years of product management experience, ideally spanning complex enterprise or government systems
  • Direct experience with customs agency operations, trusted-trader/pre-clearance programs, or trade facilitation modernization initiatives — in the U.S. or internationally
  • Familiarity with targeting systems, risk scoring, and enforcement workflow design in a customs, border, or law enforcement context
  • Working knowledge of trade data structures: entry summaries, manifests, advance ship notices, HS/HTS classification, and country-of-origin determinations
  • Experience with revenue protection (undervaluation, transshipment/COO laundering, HS misclassification) and/or enforcement missions (counternarcotics, forced labor, TBML, trade diversion) is a strong plus
  • Experience delivering products across multiple countries or agencies, including emerging-market contexts, is a plus
  • Prior experience with API-based integrations, data pipeline architecture, or enterprise system implementation
  • Eligibility for a U.S. security clearance, or an existing clearance / CBP background investigation, is a plus

Our Values

Our values are the core beliefs that shape who we are, what we stand for, and how we behave.They form the foundation of Altana’s culture and integrity and guide how we hire, design, build, and connect with each other and our customers.

  • Trust: Our customers and partners entrust us with missions of the highest importance. We honor that by keeping our word, meeting commitments, and ensuring every action we take reinforces confidence in us. We rely on each other to deliver, to speak openly, and to hold ourselves accountable.
  • Resilience: In a world of uncertainty and complexity, our work must withstand challenges, evolve with conditions, and ensure reliability over time. Resilience is both how we operate and what we deliver. It’s how we respond when things don’t go to plan –– we adapt, we support each other, and we keep moving forward.
  • Stewardship: We are stewards of every mission we touch. Because our work impacts lives and futures, we hold ourselves accountable to delivering mission impact and never compromising. Our responsibility extends beyond individual projects to the broader system of global trade. We believe that stewardship starts from within so that we can bring focus, creativity, and excellence to our work. Each of us is personally responsible for fostering a workplace where people can thrive. And we are stewards of the greater good of the company. By holding ourselves and each other accountable, we build a culture of innovation and collective success that reflects the scale of our mission.
  • Courage: Courage is what unlocks the seemingly impossible for our customers. It’s the core value that drives us make bold moves and take on big, complicated network problems—the ones others avoid. We know success isn't guaranteed, but we have the audacious vision to believe a solution is possible and to build it. Courage fuels our growth mindset. It means embracing challenges that make us stronger, and it’s demonstrated by how we approach hard conversations and complex projects.

At Altana, we believe that a diverse workforce enables greater creativity, performance, and adaptability. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome you to join us as you are. Our employment opportunities and decisions are based on business needs and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, family care or medical leave status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by the laws or regulations in the areas in which we operate. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, in any situation.

Offers related to employment at Altana will come from an Altana.ai email address. We will never ask for payment as part of the interview or onboarding process.

title: Product Engineer (m/f/d)
description:

Our HTGF Portfolio of startups offers excellent opportunities and is always hiring talented people.

Product Engineer (m/f/d)

At Stackgini we are building the AI operating system for Autonomous Enterprise IT.

IT landscapes of large enterprises have never been under more pressure. Thousands of applications to govern. Major transformations to manage. Growing regulatory complexity on one side, business units shipping AI prototypes in days on the other. And in the middle: enterprise IT teams still managing and collecting tech demands manually, managing the complexity of highly integrated processes and systems.

Stackgini changes this fundamentally. Stackgini's system understands its customers' enterprise tech landscape from the ground up, from technical configuration to application documentation, from individual IT demands to dependencies across the entire tech portfolio, with the depth of knowledge of a senior IT expert and the speed of a machine. If you had unlimited budget, you would hire a dedicated IT expert for every IT demand. With Stackgini, this is now possible.

Some of the largest organizations in this world trust Stackgini including DAX-40 and Fortune-500 customers like Siemens Healthineers or REWE.
We're a small, talent-dense team of >10, building what we believe will change how the world's largest companies operate. We are growing fast, and the people joining now are the ones who set the standard - for the product, the culture, and our category. Stackgini will be the place where you will do the most meaningful work of your career.

Tasks

The role

A Product Engineer at Stackgini owns features end to end. You take a customer problem, scope it with Product & CSM, design the solution, build it across the stack, ship it, and stay close to it after release. Recent examples: Product Engineers shipped Decisions and Approvals (a feature for routing IT requests through multi-step approval workflows), built evaluation infrastructure to benchmark agent recommendations against expert baselines, and agentic IT solutions research with our inhouse developed agent tool-use.

You are close to users. You join customer calls, run user tests, read support context, and you use that input to decide what should exist and how it should behave. The person building the feature is expected to shape the feature.

We have more good ideas than hands. For most reasonable feature ideas the question is not whether we build them, but when. Product Engineers are the people who turn that prioritization into shipped product quickly, without lowering the bar.

The AI work

AI is core to our product, but we don't run agents for everything. We use them where they create real value. For that we built our own LLM harness from hard-earned production experience: maximum freedom for the model, without compromising on enterprise control, governance or EU data residency.

What this means for you: you work hands-on with these new technologies, you run evals instead of trusting demos, and you know how to put this stuff into production reliably. Agent output gets benchmarked against expert-curated baselines, and failure modes get named, measured and fixed. If you are obsessed with how AI systems behave, fail and improve, this is the place for you.

How we ship

  • Small teams of 2 to 3 engineers around a topic. We deploy continuously to production.
  • We use AI tools heavily, and you have freedom in which ones (e.g. Cursor, Claude, Codex). Around that we run a strong operating system: clear ticket context, focused branches, AI review before human review, screenshots or videos for product changes, manual product testing before release, production verification after.
  • The engineer who ships a change owns it in production. If something breaks, you lead the fix.

Requirements

What we need from you

Nobody at 11 people knows everything. We hire people who dive in and own outcomes.

  • 3 to 6 years of full-stack experience shipping production software people actually use.

You'll stand out if

Our stack

Kotlin (Spring Boot) & Python · TypeScript (React/Next.js) · PostgreSQL · AWS (Fargate, ECS) & Terraform · GitHub Actions · Azure (OpenAI) · AWS (Bedrock)

Benefits

Working here

We work from our office in Berlin (hybrid, but most engineering happens in-person). The team spends free-time together several times a month, shares lunch, and works closely on hard problems. No politics, no long meetings - we move fast and make decisions at the whiteboard. You'll be one of 11 people, which means your work ships to customers within days, not quarters.

  • Attractive compensation package including employee stock options
  • Hybrid work with a modern office in Berlin
  • 30 days of vacation and day off on your birthday
  • Budget for self-improvement and dedicated time for learning & innovation

Ready to make an impact? Join us at Stackgini and be part of something extraordinary!

title: Senior Hardware Engineer
description:
About Eridu

Eridu is a Silicon Valley-based hardware startup pioneering infrastructure solutions that accelerate AI data centers to deliver Faster AI. Today’s AI performance is frequently limited by communication bottlenecks. Eridu delivers multiple industry-first innovations across silicon, packaging, software, and systems to deliver a step function in AI networking – a network switch that is an order of magnitude improvement in bandwidth and radix versus today’s “state of the art” switches. This is the first silicon and system designed from the ground up for AI and the increase in radix and throughput unlocks greater GPU utilization to speed training job completion times and tokens-per-second for more profitable inference. We do this while simultaneously reducing capital and power costs, improving reliability, simplifying operations and speeding AI data center deployments for faster time to revenue.

The company’s solutions and value proposition have been widely validated by leading hyperscalers.

The company has raised $200M to date including its most recent, oversubscribed Series A round led by Socratic Partners, John Doerr, Hudson River Trading, Capricorn Investment Group and Matter Venture Partners, with participation by SBVA, MediaTek, Bosch Ventures, TDK Ventures, Eclipse Ventures, and VentureTech Alliance, among others.

Eridu is led by a veteran team of Silicon Valley executives who have delivered multiple billion dollar product lines and led multiple companies to billion dollar exists, including serial entrepreneur Drew Perkins, co-founder of Infinera (NASDAQ: INFN), Lightera (acq. by Ciena), Gainspeed (acq. by Nokia) and Mojo Vision (the world’s leading micro-LED company). The company is in execution mode and has a world-class engineering team with decades of experience in state-of-the-art silicon, packaging, optics, software, and systems. Eridu has also assembled a world class IP, design and manufacturing ecosystem to execute on its vision, and counts TSMC as a key partner in our journey.

Visit our website to learn mo


Position Overview

As a Hardware Engineer in our Systems Engineering group, you will be responsible for delivering systems and sub-assemblies, taking them from concept to production. These hardware designs incorporate high-speed optical and electrical I/O, processing and management components and will require careful consideration of power, cooling, reliability and overall cost.


Your responsibilities will span from hardware definition to design, qualification and product release. To deliver these systems, you will need to collaborate with architecture, semiconductor, software and manufacturing team members and external partners. This is an exciting, hands-on design position that will require your creativity and attention to detail.

Responsibilities:
  • Work cross-functionally to turn high-level concepts into detailed Hardware Specifications
  • Architect the design to meet all functional, quality, compliance, cost and schedule targets
  • Develop technology de-risk plans through supplier evaluations and early prototypes.
  • Work with our partners through schematic entry, layout and manufacturability reviews
  • Develop comprehensive test plans (including EDVT, MDVT, EMI/EMC) to validate the design
  • Validate hardware prototypes in the lab using analyzers and high-speed oscilloscopes.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelors in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering required, Master's preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience in system-level development, preferably within the server, computer, or network industries.
  • Experience designing and validating systems with standards-based optical interfaces (eg SFP+, QSFP+, etc)
  • Proficiency in high-speed technologies including Ethernet, SerDes, PCIe, etc.
  • A solid understanding of high-speed design and signal & power integrity considerations
  • Proficiency in control interfaces such as MDIO, SPI, I2C, JTAG.
  • Good understanding of FPGA design, Power circuits, Clocking, Mechanical/Thermal considerations
  • Outstanding knowledge of hardware design process and design practices, derived from a track record of delivering shipped products.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Why Join Us?

At Eridu, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of AI infrastructure, working with a world-class team on groundbreaking technology that pushes the boundaries of AI performance. Your contributions will directly impact the next generation of AI infrastructure solutions, transforming the performance of AI data centers.

The starting base salary for the selected candidate will be established based on their relevant skills, experience, qualifications, work location, market trends, and the compensation of employees in comparable roles.


Notice to Recruiting Agencies

Eridu does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles from staffing agencies or third-party recruiters. Any candidate submitted to Eridu without prior written authorization from our recruiting team will be considered unsolicited and will become the property of Eridu. Eridu reserves the right to pursue and hire such candidates without any obligation to pay fees. Recruiting agencies are expressly instructed not to contact hiring managers, employees, or executives regarding open positions.

Knowledge of environmental, infrastructure or utilities sectors.

The role

Legora builds AI software for legal work. Our customers trust us with highly sensitive information and expect us to demonstrate how we protect it. As we grow across markets, our governance, risk and compliance program needs to keep pace with the business and the scrutiny that comes with it.

We're looking for a Senior Manager or Director of GRC to lead that function. You will set the direction, develop the team and take responsibility for the quality and execution of our risk, compliance and assurance programs. You'll work closely with our CIO and leaders across Security, Engineering, Legal and the business to turn complex requirements into clear decisions and effective controls.

This role calls for someone who can lead a global program and get into the detail. You should be comfortable challenging an assessment, examining evidence, resolving a difficult audit issue and explaining a risk decision to an executive or customer. You will work closely with colleagues in Stockholm, making reliable overlap with European working hours essential.

What you'll do

  • Lead the GRC function. Set priorities, develop the team and establish clear ownership across the program. Build an operating cadence that keeps work moving and makes gaps, dependencies and decisions visible.

  • Own the assurance roadmap. Lead certification and audit programs across frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 and ISO/IEC 42001. Maintain a common set of controls and evidence that can support new products, markets and customer requirements.

  • Make risk useful to the business. Lead enterprise risk assessments and reporting. Give leadership clear recommendations on impact, treatment options and tradeoffs, and work with accountable owners to complete agreed actions.

  • Translate requirements into practice. Partner with Legal and technical teams on AI governance, regulatory obligations and policy. Make sure requirements become controls that teams can operate and demonstrate.

  • Represent our program externally. Lead complex conversations with auditors and customer security teams. Give Customer Trust clear, accurate evidence and a consistent account of our security and compliance posture.

  • Connect the program across teams. Work with Security, Engineering and business owners on resilience and recovery readiness. Bring third-party risk findings into the broader GRC program in partnership with the lead responsible for those assessments.

  • Improve how the work gets done. Partner with GRC engineering on automated evidence collection, control monitoring and repeatable workflows. Use AI where it improves quality or speed, with appropriate review and traceable evidence.

What you bring

  • Senior Manager: 8+ years in GRC, security risk, compliance or assurance, including experience leading programs and teams in fast-growing companies. You have owned major workstreams, set priorities and delivered results across functions.

  • Director: 12+ years in GRC, security risk, compliance or assurance, including experience leading a global or multinational GRC function. You have set strategy, developed teams and advised senior leadership on risk and assurance priorities.

We will assess level based on the scope you have owned, your leadership and your results, alongside years of experience.

Across both levels, you bring:

  • Experience leading GRC programs in global or multinational B2B businesses whose products or services handle highly sensitive information or support critical customer operations.

  • A record of leading and developing teams while remaining close to the work. You can set direction, hold a high quality bar and resolve problems without waiting for escalation.

  • Ownership of complex audit and certification programs, including the controls, evidence and remediation needed to make them work.

  • Sound technical and commercial judgment. You can work with engineers on how a control actually operates and with business leaders on the consequences of a risk decision.

  • Experience working across countries and functions, balancing customer expectations, regulatory requirements and the pace of a growing business.

  • Clear, precise communication. You can explain what matters, what remains uncertain and what decision is needed.

  • Practical experience using automation and AI to improve GRC work, with a clear view of where human judgment remains necessary.

Helpful experience

  • Experience with AI governance frameworks and assurance for AI products.

  • Experience serving law firms, financial institutions or other customers with demanding security and confidentiality requirements.

title: Software Engineer (Computer Use & Integrations) (m/w/d)
description:
Software Engineer – Backend (Computer Use & Integrations) (m/w/d)

Remote job

About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

What to expect as our Software Engineer – Backend (Computer Use & Integrations) (m/w/d):

  • Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

In this role, you can make an impact and grow with us as Software Engineer

You'll help build Recare's Operator, our agent that gets AI-generated clinical output into hospital systems by operating their existing software the way a person would, no bespoke interface required. It's the sharp end of our integration strategy: a Windows desktop application that automates UI interactions with hospital systems, running on doctors' devices and often inside RDP or Citrix environments. The first version is already live – you'll help expand its capabilities and make it reliable in production.

  • You build and improve integrations between hospital systems and Recare products.

  • You implement and harden computer-use automation flows so they work reliably in production, including edge cases, recovery, and safety rails.

  • You partner with clinical domain experts to turn ambiguous workflows into shippable plans and robust implementations that solve real customers' needs.

  • You contribute across the stack as needed, including our Go-based gateway.

  • You invest in observability foundations (logs, metrics, traces) so we can trust the system in production.

How we work:

  • AI-native – our engineers reach for frontier coding agents every day to move fast across the whole stack, and we want strong, opinionated views on how to wield them well.

  • Frontier models – we build on the best models available and adopt new capabilities as they ship, not a release later.

  • Human-in-the-loop by default – this is healthcare: AI proposes, people stay in control, and we design the approval and validation loops that make that real.

  • Unglamorous foundations – engineers get the time to build the eval harnesses, guardrails, and observability that make AI trustworthy in production, not just the feature on top.

  • Ship and observe – always deployable, telemetry-driven, fix in the open.

Requirements

Here's how we picture you as our Software Engineer

  • You're a builder with a hacker mindset: you default to building rather than waiting, and you're solution-oriented rather than problem-oriented.

  • You have professional backend experience in Go, Python, or TypeScript, and you can point to production software you shipped and owned.

  • You're comfortable working on integration-heavy systems: APIs, workflows, data models, auth, and real-world edge cases.

  • You're pragmatic about reliability: you care about monitoring, debugging, test coverage, and making systems operable.

  • You're excited to use AI coding agents daily and have opinions on how to use them effectively.

  • You're ambitious but frustration-tolerant. Hospital IT is complicated and progress is hard-won; you stay relentless, get your hands dirty, and iterate until it works.

  • You communicate confidently in English and collaborate well across Product, Engineering, and Operations.

Nice to have:

  • German language skills.

  • Experience with Electron or TypeScript on the desktop side.

  • Experience with healthcare IT systems (HIS, KIS, PVS, EMR) and interoperability standards such as HL7 v2 or FHIR.

title: Senior Construction Materials Testing & Inspection Technician (VDOT Certified)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Construction Materials Testing & Inspection Technician to join our field services team.

This position is ideal for someone with a strong background in construction materials testing, VDOT inspection procedures, and field quality assurance who is ready to take on more responsibility.

We are specifically seeking an experienced technician who can work independently, perform testing and inspections accurately, and communicate effectively with contractors, project managers, and clients.

What You'll Do

  • Perform field testing and inspection of soils, aggregates, concrete, asphalt, and other construction materials.
  • Conduct inspections on commercial, residential, infrastructure, and VDOT-related construction projects.
  • Perform compaction testing, concrete sampling and testing, asphalt testing, and other materials evaluations in accordance with applicable standards.
  • Inspect construction activities for compliance with approved plans, specifications, VDOT requirements, and applicable testing procedures.
  • Document field observations, testing results, deficiencies, and corrective actions through accurate daily reports.
  • Communicate with contractors, project managers, engineers, and clients regarding testing requirements, field conditions, and inspection findings.
  • Identify potential construction quality issues and report concerns promptly.
  • Maintain testing equipment, calibration records, and required certifications.
  • Support and mentor less-experienced field technicians when needed.
  • Follow established safety procedures while working on active construction sites.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • At least 3–5 years of relevant experience in construction materials testing, construction inspection, or a closely related field.
  • Experience performing field testing and inspections independently.
  • Working knowledge of VDOT specifications, applicable ASTM/AASHTO standards, and construction quality control procedures.
  • Current VDOT certifications relevant to assigned inspection and testing responsibilities, particularly in soils, aggregates, asphalt, or concrete.
  • Ability to prepare accurate field reports and communicate professionally with project teams.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel to project sites throughout the region.
  • Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions and safely perform the physical requirements of field testing and inspection.

Highly Preferred Certifications

Candidates with multiple certifications in the following areas are strongly encouraged to apply:

  • VDOT Asphalt Field Level I and II
  • VDOT Soils and Aggregate Compaction
  • VDOT Concrete Field
  • ACI Concrete Field Testing Technician – Grade I
  • WACEL or NICET certifications related to construction materials testing
  • Nuclear Density Gauge Safety
  • OSHA10
  • VDOT Work Zone Traffic Control
  • VDOT GRIT or other relevant transportation inspection certifications

You do not need every certification listed above to be considered. We are especially interested in candidates who bring strong field experience and multiple current VDOT credentials.

AI training work uses human judgment to prepare examples, review model outputs, and give feedback that helps artificial intelligence systems improve. People with strong subject knowledge are needed because they can assess specialized work accurately and explain what a model got right or wrong.

title: Associate Manager - 21st Century Skills
description:
ASSOCIATE MANAGER - 21ST CENTURY SKILLS
We Want To Change The World. We Believe It Starts With Education.
In India, 100 million children from low-income communities grow up without access to the 21st-century skills they need to thrive — from emotional intelligence and digital literacy to everyday money management. This gap leads to a lifetime of limited opportunity, intergenerational poverty, and rising mental health concerns.
What Are We Doing?
At The Apprentice Project (TAP), we're building India's boldest bet on education equity — an AI-powered learning buddy that helps thousands of government school students unlock 21st-century skills. We don't just teach coding or financial literacy — we spark self-confidence, creativity, and lifelong curiosity in children who've been told to "stay in their lane."
We're not looking for employees. We're looking for co-builders — people who want to create generational change, one student at a time.
Who We're Looking For
We're looking for someone who can take a framework and make it real. The Associate Senior Manager owns the strategy and direction for TAP's 21st Century Skills work — your job is to translate that into curriculum that actually works in classrooms, activities that students genuinely engage with, and assessments that capture something meaningful. You think in systems but work in specifics. You're comfortable moving across multiple curriculum verticals, picking up implementation gaps quickly, and turning evidence into action. You don't need to have specialised in 21st Century Skills before — but you do need to be someone who gets things done, works well across teams, and brings rigour and ownership to everything you touch.
About The Role
Engagement: Consultant
Time Commitment: 25–30 hours per week
Reports to: Associate Senior Manager – Curriculum & 21st Century Skills
What You'll Do
Curriculum Implementation
  • Translate the 21st Century Skills framework into practical curriculum activities, projects, assessments, and rubrics.
  • Work closely with curriculum Team Leads to embed Critical Thinking, Communication, Collaboration, and Problem-Solving authentically within their curricula.
  • Support PBL and interdisciplinary initiatives where 21st Century Skills can be meaningfully developed.
  • Develop tools, templates, examples, and guidance to support consistent implementation across teams.
Quality & Review
  • Conduct regular implementation and curriculum quality checks across verticals — Science, Coding, Financial Literacy, Visual Arts, and others.
  • Review lesson plans, projects, activities, assessments, and student work for effective 21st Century Skills integration.
  • Identify implementation gaps and provide practical, evidence-based recommendations.
Data & Improvement
  • Use student work, implementation data, feedback, and research to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Track implementation patterns across verticals and surface insights that inform curriculum decisions.
Coordination & Ownership
  • Coordinate with curriculum, Program Implementation, Product, and Technology teams as required.
  • Own timelines, follow-ups, stakeholder coordination, and closure of implementation actions.
Who You Are
  • 1–3 years of experience in curriculum design, education, programme implementation, instructional design, or related fields.
  • Prior specialisation in 21st Century Skills is not mandatory — strong experience in curriculum implementation, stakeholder management, assessment, PBL, or education programmes is preferred.
  • Strong structured thinking and problem-solving skills — you translate frameworks into practical tools, not just documents.
  • Data-informed and comfortable analysing student work and implementation evidence.
  • Strong ownership, independence, and bias for action.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Comfortable working across multiple teams and managing ambiguity.
Skills You Bring
  • Curriculum Implementation: Ability to take a skills framework and embed it practically into activities, projects, and assessments across multiple verticals.
  • Structured Thinking: Strong analytical approach to identifying gaps, developing tools, and improving implementation quality.
  • Stakeholder Management: Comfortable working across curriculum, program, product, and technology teams — managing multiple relationships and workstreams simultaneously.
  • Communication: Clear and confident communicator — in written guidance, review feedback, and cross-functional coordination.
What Success Looks Like
  • Consistent implementation of the 21st Century Skills framework across curriculum verticals.
  • High-quality integration of 21st Century Skills into activities, projects, assessments, and PBL.
  • Regular identification and closure of implementation gaps.
  • Useful tools and guidance adopted by curriculum teams.
  • Evidence-based recommendations leading to measurable curriculum and implementation improvements.
Why Join Us?
Because this role sits at the heart of what makes TAP's curriculum distinctive. The 21st Century Skills framework is what separates TAP's learning experience from everything else available to children in government schools — and your job is to make sure that difference actually shows up in classrooms. You'll work across every curriculum vertical, influence how thousands of students develop critical thinking, collaboration, and problem-solving, and help build an implementation system that scales. If you want your curriculum work to have reach and impact — this is the place.
What You Can Expect?
  • Cross-vertical exposure: Work across Science, Coding, Financial Literacy, Visual Arts, and more — building a broad and deep understanding of curriculum implementation.
  • Real ownership: Drive implementation quality and gap closure with genuine autonomy.
  • Collaborative environment: Work closely with curriculum leads, program teams, and product — your insights will directly shape decisions.
  • Flexible engagement: Consultant arrangement with meaningful time commitment and structured outcomes.
  • Sector-aligned compensation: Competitive consultant rate in line with experience and nonprofit standards.
You can always reach out to us for any questions on hr@theapprenticeproject.org
